blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个看不见的图表,一个起始节点,美元,和一个终点节点,美元,一个语言模型能够产生最短的路径,从美元到美元? 以前的工作发现,模型未能将这一任务作为图表尺度来学习. 我们显示,这一失败有两个原因:监督信号和象征。 首先,我们理论上建立并实证地证明多键预测(MTP)的有效性,并表明MTP的好处是地形不可知的。 其次,我们引入了替代的象征性表示,并表明这两个原因是正交的。 使用这些方法,我们突破了以前工作所观察到的缩放墙,一致而稳定地学习如何以远超以前极限的尺度解决任务.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Can a language model learn to search? A direct way to answer this is to test whether the model can recover a shortest path in an unseen graph from a symbolic description alone.
Here, success would not measure world knowledge or memorization, but whether the model can carry out a multihop computation over structure it has not seen before.
Our purpose is not to benchmark models but to understand why the task is hard to learn despite being within the capacity of small transformers.
Prior work has studied learnable search in controlled settings as a model for general planning and multihop reasoning ( bachmann2024the ; saparov2025transformers ; cohen2025spectral ) , outlined below.
blocks.zh:
一个语言模型能学会搜索吗? 直接回答这一点的一个方法是测试该模型是否能够仅从一个象征性的描述中从一个看不见的图表中恢复最短的路径.
在这里,成功不会衡量世界知识或记忆,而是该模型是否能够在之前从未见过的结构上进行多跳计算.
我们的目的不是为模型确定基准,而是理解为什么尽管在小型变压器的能力范围内,这项任务仍难以学习。
先前的工作研究了在可控环境下的可学习搜索作为一般规划和多跳推理的模型(bachmann2024the; saparov2025transformers; cohen2025光谱),概述如下.

blocks.en: A multihop reasoning task is a tuple ( 𝒲 , q , a ) (\mathcal{W},\,q,\,a) where 𝒲 \mathcal{W} is a world model (a set of facts, axioms, etc.), q q is a query, and a a is a target answer. The task is solved by a sequence of k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 inferential steps that connect q q to a a , each licensed by some relation or rule derivable from 𝒲 \mathcal{W} . Importantly, 𝒲 \mathcal{W} induces a latent reasoning graph, 𝒢 = ( 𝒩 , ℰ ) \mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{N},\,\mathcal{E}) , where nodes are reasoning states and edges are viable inference steps. The task solution is a path π = q ​ u 1 ​ … ​ u k − 1 ​ a \pi=qu_{1}\ldots u_{k-1}a . When k > 1 k>1 , a a cannot be directly inferred from q q in a single step, but must be found by discovering a path π \pi in 𝒢 \mathcal{G} which connects q q to a a . This is graph search; the difficulty of which is characterized by the topology of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , with the branching factor and the path length k k determining the size of the search space. As the reasoning graph is latent, its topology is unknown, and we can not make topological assumptions. Crucially, search as a process requires no prior knowledge of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} ’s topology: it discovers π \pi by traversal alone. This makes graph search a natural theoretical model for multihop reasoning as it captures the essential structural and compositional difficulty without presupposing topological properties (unstated in prior work; C ).

blocks.en: Studying multihop reasoning using natural language data with LLMs introduces confounds that obscure whether a model is genuinely traversing a reasoning graph, as it may produce the ‘answer’ via memorized semantic shortcuts rather than structural inference; shortcuts which come from co-occurrences in the inaccessible training data ( ju-etal-2024-investigating ; balesni2024lessons ; yang-etal-2025-large ) . Indeed, LLMs often ignore relational structure necessary for multihop reasoning in favour of semantic shortcuts, even when it is explicitly given ( huang2024can ; xu2025when ; guan2025attention ) .
blocks.zh: 使用自然语言数据与LLMS进行多跳推理的研究,提出了一些困惑,模糊了一个模型是否真正在翻转一个推理图,因为它可能通过记忆的语义快捷方式而不是结构推论产生"答案";快捷方式来自无法获取的培训数据(ju-etal-2024-调查;balesni2024lessons;yang-etal-2025-great)中的共演. 事实上,LLMS常常忽略多跳推理所必需的关系结构,而倾向于语义快捷键,即使明确给出(huang2024can;xu2025 when ;guan2025 attention ).

blocks.en: These confounds motivate the use of a highly controlled environment to study multihop reasoning via graph search, which we inherit ( bachmann2024the ; saparov2025transformers ,  § 1.1 ) . Graph search in this environment is not easy for an LM to learn. bachmann2024the found the existence of a structural shortcut that can prevent learning the task on a specific graph topology with next-token prediction (NTP), which can be ameliorated via certain training conditions (§ 1.2 ). However, even with better training conditions, prior work has found the models fail to learn this task as graphs scale in size and path length, hitting a scaling wall at ≈ \approx 50 nodes, where learning becomes increasingly unstable ( frydenlund-2025-language ; saparov2025transformers , especially their Fig. 6) .
blocks.zh: 这些混乱促使人们利用高度控制的环境,通过图谱搜索来研究多跳推理,我们继承了这些推理(bachmann2024the;saparov2025 transfers ,§1.1). 在此环境中的图搜索对 LM 不容易学习 。 Bachmann2024the发现了一种结构快捷键的存在,它可以阻止在特定的图形地形学上学习任务,并用下个托肯预测(NTP),通过某些训练条件(§1.2)可以改善. 然而,即使训练条件较好,前期工作也发现模型未能以图标大小和路径长度来学习这项任务,在QQ\\大约50个节点撞上了一个缩放墙,在那里学习变得越来越不稳定(friendlund-2025-language ; saparov2025 transfers),尤其是他们的Fig. (原始内容存档于2018-03-06). 6).

blocks.en:
We investigate and break through this scaling wall . As prior work has identified an issue with NTP, and suggested MTP as a potential solution, we
begin by considering if NTP is the cause of poor scaling. To do this, we extend the results of bachmann2024the to general topologies (§ 2 ), and then elucidate how MTP overcomes the issues of NTP in a (nearly) topological-agnostic manner, and the various benefits this has for learnability (§ 2.1 ).
We then hypothesize two other suspects: the causal constraint and lack of permutation-invariance. These motivate the development of alternative tokenization methods (§ 3 and 4 ). Together, these methods allow us to stably learn the task at scale.
blocks.zh:
我们调查并突破这个缩放墙。 由于先前的工作已经查明了与《不扩散条约》有关的问题,并建议将《不扩散条约》作为潜在的解决办法,我们
首先是考虑NTP是否是比例差的原因。 为此,我们将Bachmann2024的结果扩大到一般地形学(§2),然后阐明中期计划如何以(近)地形学-不可知性的方式克服NTP问题,以及这对可学习性的各种好处(§2.1)。
然后,我们假设了另外两个嫌疑人:因果限制和缺乏常态变化。 这些都推动了其他象征性方法的发展(第3和第4节)。 这些方法共同使我们能够从规模上深入了解这项任务。

blocks.en:
Prior work has eliminated obvious alternative suspects: model size and scratchpads ( saparov2025transformers ) .
Larger models do not improve training as the graph scales. This aligns with our strong empirical results with small models (implying larger models are unnecessary), and theoretical results that transformers with O ⁡ ( log ⁡ k ) O(\log k) layers can express the task ( pmlr-v235-sanford24a ; sanford2024understanding ; frydenlund-2024-mystery ; merrill2025a ) . 1 1 1 This fact immediately rules out the possibility of true path-length generalization OOD performance under a statically sized transformer. As prior work has found the task unlearnable at scale in-domain, we focus on solving the problem in-domain, as that is a prerequisite to OOD performance . See limitations in B . Test-time compute via scratchpads/CoT is not a viable solution. We show that a BFS scratchpad, while learnable, introduces its own tokenization difficulties. Critically, it also reduces the latent reasoning graph to a linear chain, breaking the theoretical model ( L.4 ).
blocks.zh:
先前的工作消除了明显的替代嫌疑人:型号尺寸和刮伤板(saparov2025 Transfers ) .
较大的模型不会像图表尺度那样改进培训。 这与我们与小模型的强经验结果一致(隐含的较大模型是不必要的),与 O →(log → k) O (\log k) 层的变压器可以表达任务( pmlr-v235-sanford24a; sanford2024 understand; fropdenlund-2024-mystery; mrill2025a)的理论结果. . 1 1 页:1 这一事实立即排除了在静态大小变压器下实现真实路径长度通用OD性能的可能性. 由于先前的工作已经发现这个任务在域内是无法学习的,所以我们专注于解决域内的问题,因为这是OD性能的先决条件. 见B节中的限制。 通过抓盘/CoT进行测试时间计算不是一个可行的解决办法。 我们显示,一个BFS的抓刀虽然可以学习,但引入了它自己的象征性困难。 关键的是,它还将潜在的推理图简化为线性链,打破了理论模型(L.4 ).

blocks.en: Each graph is tokenized as a list of edges, E = [ ‘ u i u j | ’ : ∀ ( u i , u j ) ∈ ℰ ] E=[\,\text{`}u_{i}\,u_{j}\,|\text{'}:\,\forall\,(u_{i},\,u_{j})\in\mathcal{E}\,] where ‘|’ is the end-of-edge marker. The list is shuffled before concatenation to avoid providing structural information ( bachmann2024the ) , e.g. ordered by BFS from s s ( ge-etal-2025-graph ) . The source-side prefix is the concatenation [ Q , E ] [Q,E] ( frydenlund-2024-mystery ) . The target-side is π \pi tokenized with start- and end-of-task tokens. As the source-side must be supplied, we restrict prediction to the target-side ( O ). Thus, the task must be learned from the supervision provided by the single path, π \pi .

blocks.en: The graphs are synthetically generated; nodes are sampled from a global node vocabulary, 𝒩 b ⊆ 𝒱 \mathcal{N}_{b}\subseteq\mathcal{V} , and the edges are sampled via some topology-specific process. Nodes are represented by their one-hot IDs and are thus semanticless in that there is no relationship between nodes, i.e. ‘atomic facts’. This prevents homophily shortcuts ( huang2024can ; mcpherson2001birds ; xu2025when ; guan2025attention ) . Thus, the model must learn to solve the task via the structural information provided by the prefix alone. We generate unique instances during training ( saparov2025transformers ; frydenlund-2025-language ) . This is critical to avoid spurious correlations ( frydenlund-2024-mystery ; wang2023can ) .
blocks.zh: 图表是合成生成的;节点从一个全局节点词汇N b ⊆ V\ mathcal{N}_{b}\ subseteq\ mathcal{V}中抽取,边缘通过一些地形特定过程抽取. 节点由它们的单热ID代表,因此没有语义,因为节点之间没有关系,即`原子事实 ' 。 这样可以防止同源快捷键(huang2024can; mcpherson2001birds; xu2025 when ; guan2025 attention ). 因此,模型必须学会通过单靠前缀提供的结构信息来解决任务. 在训练期间我们产生独特的案例(saparov2025 Transfers;frienddenlund-2025-language). 这对避免虚假的关联关系(frienddenlund-2024-mystery ;wang2023can )至关重要.

blocks.en: This is an implicit latent multihop reasoning task, excluding inference-time procedures such as beam search or explicit intermediate token generations via scratchpads or CoT ( pan2026opening ; li2025implicit ; nye2022show ; wei2022chain , L.4 ) . As we train on many different graphs and evaluate on unseen graphs, this is the in-context setting of the task ( noroozizadeh2025deep , C.4 ) . This contrasts with the in-weights setting, which trains on a single graph and evaluates on unseen paths. Altogether, this setting allows us to isolate the defining challenge of multihop reasoning: the ability to compose and chain individual inference steps into a coherent solution path ( C ).
blocks.zh: 这是一个隐含的潜伏多跳推理任务,排除了推断时间程序,如光束搜索或通过刮痕板或CoT(泛2026打开;li2025隐含;nye2022show;wei2022chain ,L.4)的显式中间符号代代. 我们用许多不同的图表来训练,用看不见的图表来评价,这就是任务的内文设置(noroozizadeh2025diep , C.4 ). 这与体重不足的设定形成对比,这种设定在单一图上进行训练,并在隐形路径上进行评估. 总而言之,这种设置使我们能够隔离Multihop推理的决定性挑战:将个人推论步骤编成一个连贯的解决方案(C)的能力。

bachmann2024the introduced the adversarially designed path-star task to undermine the SSE under NTP with star-shaped graphs (Fig. 8 ). Each graph has a centre node, s s , with d d arms of length k k . The query is ( s , t ) (s,\,t) , where t t ends an arm, making π \pi the arm containing t t . Let d ⁡ ( u i ) d(u_{i}) be the degree of node u i u_{i} . Then d ⁡ ( s ) = d d(s)=d and all other nodes have degree 2 or 1. This topology creates an unsympathetic interaction with NTP due to teacher-forcing , which conditions each prediction on the prior ground-truth sequence ( williams1989learning ) . Consider p ⁡ ( u i | π < u i , t , ℰ ) p(u_{i}\,|\,\pi_{<u_{i}},\,t,\,\mathcal{E}) when 1 < i ≤ k − 1 1<i\leq k-1 . By conditioning on the subpath, π < u i \pi_{<u_{i}} , the model can trivially predict that u i u_{i} follows u i − 1 u_{i-1} via the single edge ( u i − 1 , u i ) ∈ ℰ (u_{i-1},\,u_{i})\in\mathcal{E} as d ⁡ ( u i − 1 ) = 2 d(u_{i-1})=2 . Such a prediction does not support learning multihop reasoning and, this shortcut, called the Clever Hans Cheat (CHC), will absorb all terms except p ⁡ ( u 1 | s , t ) p(u_{1}\,|\,s,\,t) ,

However, the CHC not only reduces the amount of supervision, but also the type. Consider the remaining term, p ⁡ ( u 1 | s , t ) p(u_{1}\,|\,s,\,t) . Now consider the terms the CHC absorbed. Each term requires reconstruction of a subpath, each one hop shorter than the last, e.g. p ⁡ ( u 2 | s ​ u 1 , t ) p(u_{2}\,|\,su_{1},\,t) requires | π ⁡ ( u 2 , t ) | = k − 1 |\pi(u_{2},\,t)|=k-1 , etc. Thus, if not for the CHC, these terms would have provided a mixture of supervision at k ′ = 2 , … , k − 1 k^{\prime}=2,\,\dots,\,k-1 hops, as each term is a decomposed subtask ,

blocks.en:
The complete failure to learn on path-star graphs can be ameliorated by
training on a mixture of hop lengths, i.e. mixed multihop training (MMHT; A.1 ). frydenlund-2025-language showed that this can be achieved in multiple ways: by sampling graphs of k ′ ≤ k k^{\prime}\leq k or sampling an arm-interior node to be the target, t ′ t^{\prime} . These methods explicitly mix values of k ′ ≤ k k^{\prime}\leq k at the population level or inner-sample.
This can also be achieved implicitly intra-sample via MTP, which is equivalent to token masking and discrete diffusion ( D.7 ), or by training on different topologies (§ 2 ). Thus, both the density and the type of supervision matter.
The importance of MMHT for efficient multihop learning has been established for other tasks ( pmlr-v235-sanford24a ; pmlr-v291-wang25a ; yao-etal-2025-language-models ) . 2 2 2 pmlr-v235-sanford24a introduced a simple in-context trace-back task called Khops . They used an inner-sample mixture of k k but did not experimentally validate its importance. We perform such an experiment in L.1.3 , which shows that the training requires an exponential number of steps as k k grows without MMHT.
blocks.zh:
在路径星图上完全无法学习的情况可以通过下列方法得到改善:
混合跳步训练,即混合跳步训练(MMHT;A.1)。 Frifdenlund-2025语言显示,这可以通过多种方式实现:通过k ' k k k^{\prime}\leq k的采样图或取样作为目标的臂前节点 t′prime}. 这些方法在人口一级或内样本中明确混合了k ' ≤ k k kprime}\leq k的值.
这也可以通过MTP(相当于象征性的遮盖和离散扩散(D.7))或通过不同地形的培训(第2节)间接地实现。 因此,监督的密度和类型都很重要。
MMHT对其他任务(pmlr-v235-sanford24a;pmlr-v291-wang25a;yao-etal-2025-语言模型)对于高效的多跳学习的重要性已经确立. 2 2 pmlr-v235-sanford24a引入了名为Khops的简单内文追溯任务. 他们使用了kk的内-样本混合物,但没有实验验证其重要性. 我们在L.1.3中进行这样的实验,这说明在kk生长而无MMHT时,训练需要指数级的步骤.

blocks.en: frydenlund-2025-language considered MTP as it induces MMHT; while insufficient alone to break the scaling wall, this motivates a analysis of when the CHC induces topological shortcuts and prevents MMHT under NTP (§ 2 ). 3 3 3 This is significant for a secondary reason; bachmann2024the proved the existence of an adversarial topology for learning under NTP, and speculated that it will affect a broader set of tasks. This has had a large impact, with many follow-ups proposing novel methods designed to overcome this problem ( D.4 ). We then show MTP overcomes this by simultaneously increasing supervision density and inducing implicit MMHT, with both benefits nearly topology-independent (§ 2.1 ).
blocks.zh: Frydenlund-2025语言认为MTP是诱导MMHT的;虽然单靠它不足以打破缩放壁,但是这激发了对CHC何时诱导地形捷径和在NTP下防止MMHT的分析(§2). 3 3 3 出于次要原因,这一点很重要;Bachmann2024证明了NTP下存在一种敌对的学习地形,并推测这将影响更广泛的一组任务. 这产生了很大影响,许多后续行动提出了旨在克服这一问题的新办法(D.4)。 然后,我们显示中期计划通过同时增加监督密度和诱导隐含的MMHT来克服这一问题,两者都几乎是独立于地形的(第2.1节)。

blocks.en: We then hypothesize two further suspects for the scaling wall: the causal constraint of causal LMs and permutation sensitivity. These motivate the development of alternative tokenization schemes which prove highly effective, breaking the scaling wall (§ 3 and § 4 ). However, we find evidence that their success is not fully explained by their motivating hypotheses (§ 6 ).
blocks.zh: 然后,我们假设还有两个关于缩放墙的嫌疑人:因果LMs和穿透灵敏度的因果关系限制。 这促使人们制定其他的象征性计划,这些计划证明非常有效,打破了缩放墙(§3和§4)。 然而,我们发现有证据表明,它们的成败并没有充分解释其动机假设(第6节)。

blocks.en: As we have shown, multiple choice nodes induce implicit MMHT, but this is topology-dependent for NTP. Thus, MTP has multiple advantages over NTP for this task: (1) It has optimal SSE with respect to the sampled path, (2) it induces implicit MMHT, and, importantly, (3) these advantages are nearly topologically independent. We empirically verify that MTP outperforms NTP on shortest path search and other symbolic multihop tasks (§ 6 , L.1 , L.2 , and L.3 ).
blocks.zh: 正如我们所显示的,多个选择节点会诱导隐含的MMHT,但这对NTP来说依赖于地形. 因此,中期计划在这项任务上比国家中期计划有多种优势: (1) 在抽样路径方面,它具有最佳SSE,(2) 它诱导隐含的MMHT, 重要的是,(3) 这些优势在地形学上几乎是独立的。 我们通过经验核实,在最短的路径搜索和其他象征性的多跳任务(第6、L.1、L.2和L.3节)上,中期计划的绩效超过NTP。

blocks.en: We motivated the study of graph search as a theoretical model for multihop reasoning because the latent reasoning graph has unknown topology, thus making topological assumptions impermissible (§ 1 ). Given that our theoretical model was constructed to be agnostic to topology, and our finding that the theoretical advantages of MTP share this agnosticism, we conjecture that the advantages of MTP uncovered here apply to any multihop reasoning task. This would make MTP a principled objective for any multihop reasoning task in general. Evaluating this is non-trivial, as our results rest on each target token corresponding to exactly one hop, which is untrue for natural language ( B ).
blocks.zh: 我们鼓励研究图表搜索作为多跳推理的理论模型,因为潜在的推理图表有未知的地形学,因此使得地形学假设是不允许的(§1). 鉴于我们的理论模型被构建成不可知论到地形学,以及我们发现中期计划的理论优势与这种不可知论相同,我们推测在这里发现的中期计划的优势适用于任何多机推理任务. 这将使中期计划成为任何一般的多跳推理任务的原则目标。 评估这一点是非三角性的,因为我们的结果取决于每个目标符号,恰好相当于一个跳,这对自然语言来说是不真实的(B)。

blocks.en: A preliminary glance at Fig. 2 shows that MTP improves learnability at scale. However, the results remain noisy with high variance across seeds. This motivates investigating two further hypotheses.

blocks.en: 3 The Causal Constraint, Sparsity, and Fragmented Routing
blocks.zh: 3,因果约束,平和,断裂的游击

blocks.en: Causal LMs derive expressive power from sequential computation, but are restricted to prior tokens only ( vaswani2017attention ) . frydenlund-2024-mystery ; saparov2025transformers identified that the causal constraint hinders information routing. We show this problem is severely compounded with fragmented routing due to an interaction between the causal constraint, graph sparsity, and tokenization. The model must route information across edges, which can only occur after an edge is observed. Since our graphs are sparse and E E is shuffled (to prevent structural shortcuts), the edge stream forms many disconnected components until most of E E is seen. 5 5 5 Non-sparse graphs only support tiny shortest paths, and thus do not support investigating scalability with k k . As a result, routing is deferred until most of E E has been processed, exhausting the model’s sequential computation (Fig. 11 in F ).
blocks.zh: Causal LMs通过顺序计算获得表达力,但仅限于前兆(vaswani 2017atenty ). flordenlund-2024-mystery; saparov2025 Transfers 发现因果限制阻碍了信息路由. 我们显示,由于因果限制、图纸卷缩和象征性化之间的相互作用,这一问题与支离破碎的路线严重复杂化。 模型必须穿越边缘路由信息,这只能在观察到一个边缘后发生. 由于我们的图表稀少,E E被洗涤(以防止结构快捷键),边缘流形成许多断开的组件,直到看到E E的大部分. 5 5 5 非散射图只支持最小最短的路径,因此不支持使用 k k 来调查可伸缩性. 因此,路线被推迟到EE的大部分处理完毕之后,使模型的顺序计算(F.图11)耗尽。

blocks.en: The causal constraint can be bypassed via repeating inputs ( xu-etal-2024-reading ; springer2025repetition ; kukic-etal-2026-sequence ) . Thus, if we tokenized the input as [ Q , E , E ] [Q,\,E,\,E] , then the second edge list can fully observe the first. However, E E provides an inconsistent scaffold, so we consider the node list, N N , as [ Q , E , N ] [Q,\,E,\,N] for a consistent means of accumulating edge information. N N is sorted by order of appearance of each node in the shuffled E E , i.e. E E is shuffled, but N N is ordered relative to E E .
blocks.zh: 因果关系可以通过重复输入(xu-etal-2024-reading ;springer2025-readment ;kukic-etal-2026-sequence )绕过. 因此,如果我们将输入表示为[Q,E,E][Q,\,E,\,E],那么第二个边缘列表就可以完全观察第一个. 然而,E E提供了一个不一致的脚手架,所以我们认为节点列表N N,作为[Q,E,N] [Q,\,E,\,N],用于一个连贯的积累边缘信息的手段. N N在洗涤的E E 中按照每个节点的外观顺序排序,即E E 被洗涤,但N N 相对于E E 被订购.

blocks.en:
To test the hypothesis that the node list bypasses issues relating to routing, we consider both causal LMs and prefix LMs without causal masking on the source-side prefix ( raffel2020exploring ; saparov2025transformers ) .
Thus, if the only benefit to using the edge list is that it avoids routing issues, then we would expect to see performance gains with the causal LM over a baseline, but not the prefix LM.
We refer to experiments that include the node list as ‘+ N N ’ compared to the baseline of only [ Q , E ] [Q,\,E] .
blocks.zh:
为了检验节点列表绕过与路由有关的问题的假说,我们既考虑因果LMs,也考虑前缀LMs,而不在源边前缀上出现因果遮掩(raffel2020exploring;saparov2025 transfers ).
因此,如果使用边缘列表的唯一好处是避免了路由问题,那么我们期望看到因果LM的性能增益超过一个基线,而不是前缀LM.
我们把列入节点清单的实验称为`N ' ,而基准仅为[Q、E][Q、\、E]。

blocks.en: 4 Positional Embeddings and Permutation Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 4 定位嵌入和穿透敏感性

blocks.en:
Non-causal models like prefix LMs have been explored both to remove the attention restriction (as per above) and for their perceived permutation invariance ( frydenlund-2024-mystery ; saparov2025transformers ) . Permutation invariance is important; it reduces the space of possible tokenization orderings and spurious correlations.
Since permutation invariance of ℰ \mathcal{E} is inherent to the task, this inductive bias is well-motivated. However, prior work failed to adequately address this, as a more clandestine issue breaks permutation invariance: positional embeddings ( chen2023positional ) . This is clandestine as positional embeddings are ubiquitous in LMs given their necessity for serial tokenization.
blocks.zh:
研究了前缀LMs等非致病模型,以去除注意力限制(如上)和其感知的穿透性变异性(flordenlund-2024-mystery;saparov2025 transfers ). 长期性变化很重要;它缩小了可能的象征性命令和虚假关联的空间.
由于E\mathcal{E}的变位是任务所固有的,这种诱导性偏差具有良好的动机. 然而,先前的工作未能充分解决这一问题,因为一个更隐秘的问题打破了内在变化:位置嵌入(chen2023 propositional)......。 这是秘密的,因为位置嵌入在LMs中是无处不在的,因为它们需要序列标记。

blocks.en:
Standard transformers take a T T -length sequence of content token IDs x x alongside positional IDs ϕ \phi .
Tokenizing an edge as ‘ u u v v |’ means any node ID recurring at multiple positions is only distinguishable through ϕ \phi .
Positional embeddings are thus necessary because tokens are not unique , but they break the desired permutation invariance, so we make every ‘token’ unique without ϕ \phi .

Thus, we have moved from sequential annotation (SEAN) to structural annotation (STAN). However, only edges contain 3 tokens of information. For other tokens, we replicate content tokens as padding. For node list tokens, where x i = u x_{i}=u , we use z ^ i = [ x i , x i , ‘ / ’ ] \hat{z}_{i}=[x_{i},x_{i},\text{`}\texttt{/}\text{'}] , where ‘ / ’ is the node-marker, making 𝒩 \mathcal{N} permutation-invariant. As we were already concatenating content and positional embeddings, the primary change is how the input sequence is presented, not the model itself .
We use ‘STAN’ instead of ‘permutation invariance’ to separate the method from the motivating hypothesis, since STAN can apply to causal LMs, which are incapable of permutation invariance. STAN has the practical benefit of reducing the sequential tokenization of E E to 1 / 3 1/3 the original length.

blocks.en: 5 Methodology
blocks.zh: 5. 方法

blocks.en: We consider three topologies: Erdős-Rényi graphs (ERG), Euclidean graphs (EG), and path-star graphs (PSG) ( erdds1959random ; penrose2003random ; bachmann2024the ) . We use NTP during inference. We consider the per-token accuracy (ACC) and the per-sequence accuracy (SACC), which is correct if all tokens are correct. Both depend on a ground-truth sequence. As the shortest path is not unique, the task accuracy is whether a valid shortest path was generated (TACC) ( N ). Each experiment is performed with 5 trial seeds and evaluated on b = 10 b=10 k ( 𝒢 b , π b ) (\mathcal{G}_{b},\,\pi_{b}) instances.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑三个地形:Erdás-Rényi图(ERG)、Euclide图(EG)和路径-星图(PSG)(Erdds1959random;penrose2003random;Bachmann2024the)。 我们用NTP进行推论 我们认为,如果所有符号都正确,则准确无误。 两者都取决于地面真实的顺序。 由于最短路径并非独一无二,任务准确性在于是否生成了有效的最短路径(TACC)(N.). 每个实验用5个试种子进行,并用b=10 b=10 k(Gb, πb) (\mathcal{G}_{b},\,\pi_{b})例评价.

blocks.en: Among the ablations, including the node list ( + N +N ) has the most dramatic effect. Since + N +N still improves performance with a prefix LM, its benefit extends beyond bypassing the causal constraint (this does not rule out that it also provides that benefit for causal LMs). Despite this, + N +N alone leaves models noisy across trials. STAN resolves this variance and induces the expected behaviour where convergence scales with k k , but does not consistently outperform the baseline. We also observe divergent trends between causal and prefix LM ablations, with causal LMs showing clearer trends, indicating a clear performance difference due to the different model parametrizations (Fig. 20 , K.2 ).
blocks.zh: 其中,包括节点列表(+N+N)在内,具有最戏剧性的效果. 由于+N+N仍然用前缀LM来改进性能,其好处超越了绕过因果约束(这并不排除它也为因果LMs提供了好处). 尽管如此,单是+N+N就让模型在各种试验中产生噪音. STAN解决了这一差异,并诱导了汇合尺度与 k k 的预期行为,但并非一贯超过基线。 我们还观察到因果和前缀LM擦伤之间的不同趋势,因果LM显示更明确的趋势,表明由于不同的模型变形(图20,K.2.)而有明显的性能差异。

blocks.en: STAN and N N together significantly improve learnability for prefix LMs; consistently solving it in a fraction of the steps and leading to expected scaling behaviour (Fig. 3 ). In solving the variance issue, we have greatly decreased the cost of future experimentation ( J.1 ). As expected, the prefix LMs outperform the causal LMs (Fig. 3 vs. Fig. 4 ). However, the fact that STAN also improves the causal LMs implies either that permutation invariance is not why it is effective or that causal LMs can, at least partially, get these benefits despite not being capable of true permutation invariance.
blocks.zh: STAN和N N加在一起,大大提高了前缀LM的学习能力;在部分步骤中持续解决,并导致预期的缩放行为(图3 ). 在解决差异问题时,我们大大降低了今后试验的费用(J.1)。 如预期,前缀LMs超过了因果LMs(图3对图4 ). 然而,STAN也改进了因果关系的LMs,这意味着要么是长期变异不是它有效的原因,要么是因果关系至少可以部分地获得这些好处,尽管不能真正地进行长期变异。

blocks.en: We demonstrate that MTP outperforms NTP on average across scales and methods, and that this difference increases as k k and | 𝒩 | |\mathcal{N}| grow, thereby verifying its usefulness for scaling the task. This also indicates that MTP and the alternative tokenization are orthogonal methods, and thus solve different underlying issues. While we see less difference between NTP and MTP on EGs (Fig. 21 in K.3 ), we see a dramatic difference between them with PSGs in the following Section.
blocks.zh: 我们证明,中期计划在尺度和方法上平均超过国家贸易点,随着 k k 和 | N |\ mathcal{ N}| }| }| }|  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow  grow }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| 这还表明,中期计划和替代象征性方法都是正统方法,因此解决了不同的根本问题。 虽然我们看到在EGs上NTP和MTP之间的差别较小(K.3图21),但我们在下面一节中看到它们与PSG的差别很大。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Baseline ( | 𝒩 | ∈ { 30 , 40 , 50 } |\mathcal{N}|\in\{30,\,40,\,50\} ) and ablation ( | 𝒩 | = 50 |\mathcal{N}|=50 ) results using prefix LMs on ERGs for the shortest-path task. Each experiment represents different seeds, illustrating the large variance.
blocks.zh: 图2:基线(XQ N { { 30, 40, 50}} { mathcal{ { in } 30,\, 40,\, 50}})和衰竭(XX N = 50 { mathcal{ N}|=50 〕)的结果,在ERGs上使用前缀LMs进行最短路径的任务. 每个实验代表不同的种子,说明巨大的差异.

blocks.en: Figure 3: STAN and N N results using prefix LMs on ERGs. The experiments at | 𝒩 | = 50 |\mathcal{N}|=50 (blue) are also shown in Fig. 2 , demonstrating a dramatic improvement in learning and variance compared to the baselines. This then allows us to scale to much larger graph sizes: 50 50 through 75 , 100 75,\,100 , and 125 125 . Fig. 2 and Fig. 4 display a max of 75k steps vs. 25k here, showing a large difference between models.

blocks.en: 6.1 Path-Star Graphs
blocks.zh: 6.1 路径星图

blocks.en: For all PSG experiments, we use L = 8 L=8 , a max of 50k steps, and no true curriculum learning. We consider models with a max k ∈ [ 6 , 15 ] k\in[6,\,15] and a max d ∈ [ 2 , 10 ] d\in[2,\,10] . By construction, the size of each graph is coupled to k k and d d s.t. | 𝒩 | = d ​ k + 1 |\mathcal{N}|=dk+1 . Thus, our largest experiments consider | 𝒩 | = 151 |\mathcal{N}|=151 .
blocks.zh: 对所有PSG实验,我们使用L=8 L=8,最大50k步,没有真正的课程学习. 我们考虑的模型最大值为K[6,15] k\ in [6,\,15] 和最大值为d[2,10] d\ in [2,\,10] 。 按构造,每个图的大小与 k k k 和 d d s. t. | N | = d k + 1 |\ mathcal{ N}|=dk+1  . 因此,我们最大的实验 考虑 | N | = 151 |\ mathcal{ N}|=151  .

blocks.en: Figure 5: STAN and N N results on PSGs. Each colour increments d d . Notice that in the STAN and N N setting, MTP makes the task trivial to learn across all scales (please zoom in for the MTP results).
blocks.zh: 图5:STAN和N在PSG上的结果. 每个颜色递增d. 注意到在STAN和N N 的设定中,中期计划使任务变得微不足道,无法在所有尺度学习(请放大中期计划结果)。

blocks.en: Figure 6: The PSG experiment where k = 9 k=9 and d = 8 d=8 from Fig. 5 . Here, three seeds learn the task, and two seeds do not. Jumps in SACC indicate learning the task for a specific k ′ k^{\prime} and d ′ d^{\prime} graph size.
blocks.zh: 图6:K=9k=9,d=8d=8的PSG实验图5. 在这里,三个种子学会了任务,两个种子没有. 在 SACC 中跳跃表示学习特定 k ' k^{\prime 和 d ' d^{\prime 大小的任务 。

blocks.en:
Our results are shown in Fig. 5 . To our knowledge, these are the first results to consistently solve PSGs using NTP beyond k = 4 k=4 hops with only inter-sample MMHT
and no other methods such as MTP, diffusion, RL, or novel architectures ( D.4 ).
As such, these results provide strong counterevidence to claims that NTP is insufficient to learn to plan ( bachmann2024the ; wu2024can ) . We can consistently scale NTP to | 𝒩 | = 65 |\mathcal{N}|=65 ( k = 8 k=8 and d = 8 d=8 ) with STAN and + N N , but these are insufficient alone to scale higher. Also applying MTP makes the task trivial across all scales. The fact that PSGs have the largest disparity between NTP and MTP conforms with theory, as PSGs are adversarial to NTP. An explanation for the size of this disparity is that PSGs allow solutions which do not generalize to arbitrary topology, e.g. the model can identify all final nodes by their degree, d = 1 d=1 , then walk back all arms to s s in parallel to identify the correct arm ( frydenlund-2024-mystery ) .
blocks.zh:
我们的结果见图5。 据我们所知,这些是第一个使用超过 k = 4 k = 4 hop 的 NTP 持续解析 PSG 且只使用 inter- sample MMHT 的结果
没有其他方法,如中期计划、传播、RL或新建筑(D.4)。
因此,这些结果为NTP不足以学习计划的说法提供了有力的反证(bachmann2024the;wu2024can ). 我们可以用STAN和+N N 一致地将NTP缩放到 QQ = 65 |\ mathcal{ N}|=65 (k = 8 k = 8 和 d = 8 d = 8 ),但这些单靠它们不足以提升比例. 采用中期计划也使这项任务在所有规模上都变得微不足道。 核供应国集团与中期计划之间最大的差距符合理论,因为核供应国集团与核供应国集团是对立的。 对这种差异大小的解释是,PSG允许不通俗到任意地形的解决方案,例如模型可以按其程度识别所有最终节点,d=1d=1,然后将所有臂向后平行行走以识别正确的手臂(flordenlund-2024-mystery).

blocks.en: We observe the expected pattern where task difficulty grows with k k and | 𝒩 | |\mathcal{N}| ; however, it is not gradual, but spikes sharply. To explain this, we consider the model’s learning dynamics, and Fig. 6 reveals why. Here, rises in SACC between plateaus correspond to the model incrementally learning to solve the task at d ′ < d d^{\prime}<d and k ′ < k k^{\prime}<k , from smallest to largest. Once solved at d ′ d^{\prime} or k ′ k^{\prime} , those samples provide a near-zero loss and cease contributing to the learning signal. Thus, the models have locked themselves out of a hop-mixture including lower k ′ k^{\prime} terms. Without the lower- k ′ k^{\prime} terms, models behave as if MMHT was never provided ( bachmann2024the ; frydenlund-2025-language ) , thus explaining the spikes. We confirm this by training on a restricted MMHT sampling only k ′ ∈ [ 6 , 9 ] k^{\prime}\in[6,\,9] rather than k ′ ∈ [ 3 , 9 ] k^{\prime}\in[3,\,9] . These models fail to learn the task, just as if they had no MMHT (Fig. 22 in K.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们观察到任务难度随着k k 和 | N |\ mathcal{ N}| }| }| }| }| }| }| }|  grows  grows  grows  grows  grows  grows  grows  grows  grows }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| | }| }| }| }| }| | | }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }|  it }| }|  it }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| it }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| 为了解释这一点,我们考虑了模型的学习动态,图6揭示了原因。 这里,高原之间的SACC上升与逐步学习解决从最小到最大任务的模式相对应。 这些样本一旦在d ' d ' prime 或 k ' k ' k ' prime 中解析出来,就会造成近乎零的损失,不再有助于学习信号。 因此,这些模型将自己锁定在了跳动混合中,包括较低的k ' k^{\prime}条件。 没有下-k ' k^{\prime] 术语,模型的行为就像从未提供MMHT(bachmann2024the;frienddenlund-2025-language),从而解释了尖峰. 我们通过对限制的MMHT采样只进行k ' [6,9] k^{\prime}\in [6,\,9] 而不是k ' ∈ [3,9] k^{\prime}\in [3,\,9] 的培训来证实这一点。 这些模型无法学习任务,就像没有MMHT一样(K.4图22).

blocks.en: This confirms the importance of MMHT, while providing a new insight in that the actual mixture distribution is also critical. It also exposes two related issues: poor learning dynamics with NTP and failure to learn a generalized solution. Importantly, the latter issue can occur only if the models fail to generalize their partial solutions at lower k ′ k^{\prime} to larger k ′ k^{\prime} (as Fig. 6 demonstrates).
blocks.zh: 这证实了MMHT的重要性,同时提供了新的见解,即混合物的实际分布也至关重要。 它还暴露了两个相关的问题:与NTP的学习动力差和无法学习通用解决方案. 重要的是,只有在模型未能将其部分溶液在k ' k^{\prime] 下到更大的k ' k^{\prime}(如图6所示)时,才会出现后一问题。

blocks.en: The CHC is a topological shortcut which causes the model to lose almost all supervision on PSGs. This lockout phenomenon has a different root cause but leads to a similar loss of supervision and poor learning dynamics. However, lockout may not be topology-dependent. We find that models can get stuck at high ACC without meeting the > 95 % >95\% TACC threshold. At such times, less than 1 % 1\% of the targets are contributing to the loss ( pezeshki2021gradient ) . Thus, such models have failed to generalize and may have locked themselves out of learning from the easier samples required for generalization.
blocks.zh: CHC是一个地形学的快捷键,它使得模型几乎失去对PSG的所有监管. 这种隔离现象有着不同的根源,但会导致类似的监督缺失和学习动力差. 然而,隔离可能不依赖地形。 我们发现模型可能会在不达到 > 95% > 95+% TACC阈值的情况下被卡在高的ACC上. 不到1%的目标导致损失(pezshki2021gradient), 因此,这种模型未能概括,可能无法从概括所需的较容易的样本中学习。

blocks.en:
Sampling different graph sizes k ′ k^{\prime} induces an explicit MMHT, which we have shown is insufficient for learning with PSGs and NTP at scale.
MTP induces an implicit MMHT, and does not lead to lockout.
Thus, a final benefit of MTP is that the objective remains challenging – so you don’t lose your loss.
blocks.zh:
取样不同的图大小 k ' k^{\prime} 诱导一种明显的MMHT, 我们已经表明,这不足以在规模上与PSG和NTP学习.
MTP诱导一种隐含的MMHT,不会导致关闭.
因此,中期计划的最终好处是目标依然具有挑战性 — — 所以你不会失去你的损失。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We make several contributions showing that MTP and alternative tokenization enable learning latent multihop graph search at scale. We demonstrate the utility of shortest-path generation on unseen graphs as a controlled setting of latent multihop reasoning in transformer LMs. We extend bachmann2024the ’s adversarial path-star analysis to general topologies via a formal notion of choice nodes, characterizing precisely when and why supervision degrades under NTP. Our central finding, established both theoretically and empirically, is that MTP substantially improves supervision for this task through increased supervision density, mixed-hop supervision, and better learning dynamics, and, importantly, these advantages hold regardless of the underlying graph topology.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了几项贡献,表明中期计划和替代的符号化能够大规模学习潜在的多跳图搜索。 我们在看不见的图表上展示了最短路径生成的效用,作为变压器LMs中潜在多跳推理的可控环境. 我们通过一个正式的选择节点概念,将Bachmann2024的对抗性路径星分析扩展到一般的地貌学,准确描述监管在NTP下退化的时间和原因。 我们从理论和经验上得出的中心结论是,中期计划通过提高监督密度、混合监督以及更好的学习动态,大大改进了对这项任务的监督,而且重要的是,无论基本图表地形如何,这些优势都具有。

blocks.en:
Multihop reasoning is intrinsically graph-structured, so our results on shortest-path search using MTP should extend to multihop reasoning more broadly. We empirically verify that similar benefits exist for MTP on other multihop reasoning tasks, including Khops ( pmlr-v235-sanford24a ) , Khops-Gen (a novel variant), and a BFS scratchpad variant of shortest-path search ( L.1 , L.2 , and L.3 ).
That MTP’s advantages hold irrespective of topology was, itself, an unexpected finding.
Our theoretical model was constructed to be topology-agnostic and we did not expect MTP to inherit this property, which leads us to conjecture that MTP’s benefits apply to any multihop reasoning task ( B ).
blocks.zh:
Multihop推理是内在的图式结构,所以我们使用MTP最短路径搜索的结果应该更广泛地扩展到Multihop推理. 我们经验性地核实,在其它多跳推理任务方面,中期计划也有类似的好处,包括Khops(pmlr-v235-sanford24a),Khops-Gen(一种新颖的变体),以及BFS最短路径搜索的刮片变体(L.1,L.2和L.3)。
中期计划的优势,不论地形如何,本身就是一个意外的发现。
我们的理论模型被构建为地形学-不可知论,我们并不期望中期计划会继承这一财产,这使我们推测中期计划的好处适用于任何多跳推理任务(B ) 。

blocks.en:
A major trend in prior work is to use CoT or scratchpads to solve difficult reasoning tasks ( nye2022show ; wei2022chain ; cho2024arithmetic ; alberghi2025on ; zhang2026dagmath ; xu2026no ) , which changes how the task can be expressed, and thus its learnability ( wies2023subtask ; dziri2023faith ; feng2023towards ; merrill2024the ; abbe2024how ; li2024chain ; kim2025transformers ) .
The BFS scratchpad we consider in L.3 is learnable, but its sequence length makes training impractical and it does not overcome the scaling wall.
More critically, it reduces the latent reasoning graph to a linear chain, breaking the theoretical model of § 1 , reducing it to the multihop backtrack of Khops-Gen.
Showing that the latent solution is the scalable solution bucks this trend.
blocks.zh:
前期工作的一个主要趋势是使用CoT或抓板来解决困难的推理任务(nye2022show ; wei2022chain ; cho2024arithmetic ; alberghi2025on;zhang2026dagmath;xu2026no),这改变了任务如何表达,从而改变了任务的可学习性(wies2023子任务;dziri2023信仰;feng2023towards;mrill2024the;abbe24how;li2024chain;kim2025 transfers ).
我们在L.3中考虑的BFS抓图可以学习,但其序列长度使得训练不切实际,无法克服缩放墙.
更为关键的是,它将潜在的推理图简化为线性链条,打破了§1的理论模型,将其简化为Khops-Gen的多跳回轨迹.
表明潜在的解决方案是可伸缩的解决方案为这一趋势提供了资金。

blocks.en:
While MTP yields strong theoretical and empirical gains, it alone does not break the scaling wall of prior work.
This motivated us to search for other suspects, and we identified two: the causal constraint of causal LMs, which results in a fragmented routing problem, and positional embeddings, which break the permutation invariance.
These hypotheses motivated two simple modifications: the node list ( + N +N ), for routing, and structural annotation (STAN), for permutation invariance, which we isolate with ablations over causal vs. prefix LMs, with and without + N +N and STAN.
blocks.zh:
虽然中期计划在理论和经验上取得了很大成果,但单靠中期计划并不能打破以往工作的缩水墙。
这促使我们寻找其他嫌疑人,我们确定了两个:因果LM的因果制约,导致路由问题支离破碎,以及位置嵌入,打破了通畅性变异.
这些假设激发了两个简单的修改:节点列表(+N +N),用于路由,结构注释(STAN),用于演化变异,我们在因果对前缀LMs上用缩写来隔离,有和没有+N +N和STAN.

blocks.en:
We find that both lead to strong empirical gains, allowing us to consistently learn the task at graph sizes well beyond the limits of prior work, and, together with MTP, to break the scaling wall.
Scaling to 2.5 × 2.5\times the size while training in 1 / 3 1/3 as many steps (Fig. 2 vs. Fig. 3 ) is a substantial gain given that the scaling trend is super-linear (Fig. 3 ).
However, the ablations provide counter-evidence to these hypotheses: + N +N improves prefix LMs, which should be unaffected by the causal constraint, and STAN improves causal LMs, which are incapable of true permutation invariance.
Both methods are highly effective, but their benefits must extend beyond the hypotheses that motivated them.
Why they work so well, especially in combination, remains an open question ( B ).
blocks.zh:
我们发现,两者都带来了强有力的经验成果,使我们能够以远远超出以前工作的限度的图表大小不断学习这项任务,并与中期计划一道打破缩放墙。
放大到2.5×2.5\乘以1/3 1/3的训练(图2对图3)是很大的收益,因为升级趋势是超线性(图3)。
然而,擦伤为这些假说提供了反证:+N +N改进了前缀LMs,它应该不受因果限制的影响,STAN改进了因果LMs,这些因果LMs是无法进行真实的变异的.
这两种方法都非常有效,但其好处必须超越促使它们发展的假设。
为何工作如此顺利,特别是结合使用,仍然是一个未决问题(B)。

blocks.en:
Path-star graphs have received significant attention, spurring many follow-up works proposing novel methods to address their adversarial nature to NTP ( D.4 ).
While PSGs are useful in exposing supervision pathologies, they can be solved in ways that may not reflect arbitrary reasoning or planning. We strongly caution against using PSGs as a benchmark. As we show, the task is trivial, given the proper conditions. Thus, the main benefit of PSGs is as a tool for studying those conditions ( bachmann2024the ; xu2026depth ) .
We also caution against viewing the results on PSGs with NTP as a generalizable limitation of NTP. As we show, these limitations are limited to a specific adversarial topology, and NTP is actually sufficient for learning (at moderate scales and under the correct conditions).
However, our results do support the claim that MTP is much more efficient than NTP at learning multihop graph search, and that this matters at scale.
blocks.zh:
路径星图受到很大关注,促使许多后续作品提出新的方法,以解决其对NTP的对抗性(D.4).
虽然临时自治机构在揭露监督病理方面是有用的,但它们的解决方式可能并不反映任意推理或规划。 我们强烈告诫不要将临时自治机构作为基准。 正如我们所显示的那样,鉴于适当的条件,这项任务是微不足道的。 因此,PSGs的主要好处是作为研究这些条件的工具(bachmann2024the;xu2026 deep.).
我们还告诫不要把《不扩散条约》作为《不扩散条约》的一个普遍限制,看待《不扩散条约》对《不扩散条约》的执行情况。 正如我们所显示的,这些限制仅限于特定的对抗性地形,而NTP实际上足以学习(在中等尺度和正确条件下).
然而,我们的结果确实支持这样的说法,即MTP在学习多跳图搜索时比NTP高效得多,而这在规模上很重要.

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools for code generation, proof generation and verification, and minimal writing and editing. In particular, we used LLMs to assist in coding; however, this was done only for small sections of code at a time, allowing for human verification. We engaged an LLM to verify the validity of our proofs (which led to various improvements). We used AI to make the illustrations but not the plots , which were manually done to ensure integrity. For the writing component, AI was mostly used to make arguments more succinct to meet space limitations in the main paper and help with the appendices. This was monitored closely. We also used the AI tool Grammarly for proofreading. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including any artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

blocks.en: A.1 A Note on MMHT and Curriculum Terminology
blocks.zh: A.1 关于MMHT和课程术语的说明

blocks.en:
MMHT has been called ‘composition’ or ‘subtask decomposition’ ( frydenlund-2025-language ; wies2023subtask ) . Others have called it a ‘curriculum’ in a broad sense, or ‘implicit curriculum via data mixture’ ( pmlr-v291-wang25a ; yao-etal-2025-language-models ) . Subtask decomposition addresses how a task can be recursively decomposed and how this can be expressed implicitly and intra-sample via sequential supervision, which is a property of the task. Curriculum learning is generally explicit and inner-sample, and more often concerned with the order the samples are presented in, i.e. easy to hard ( bengio2009curriculum ) .
Thus, we use ‘mixed multihop training’ as a generic name to cover both inner- and intra-sample data mixing, which is not concerned with order or explicitness, or with whether the specific task is compositional (the task can be fuzzily compositional ( frydenlund-2025-language ) ).
blocks.zh:
MMHT被称为"组合"或"子任务分解"(frienddenlund-2025-language ; wies2023 subtask ). 其他人称之为广义的 " 课程 " ,或称 " 通过数据混合而隐含的课程 " (pmlr-v291-wang25a;yao-etal-2025-language-models)。 子任务分解涉及一个任务如何可以递归分解,以及如何通过顺序监督(这是任务的财产)来隐含地表达和内部样本. 课程学习一般是明晰的和内样的,更经常地关注样品的排列顺序,即容易硬化(Bengio2009 curriculum ).
因此,我们使用“混合多跳训练”作为通用名称,以涵盖内和内样本数据混合,这与顺序或明确性无关,也与具体任务是否是组成(任务可以是模糊的构成(friendlund-2025-language ))有关。

blocks.en: We employ a true curriculum data sampling algorithm for sampling path lengths. Because tasks can also have implicit MMHT due to being truly compositional or via MTP this distinction is important.
blocks.zh: 我们使用真实的课程数据取样算法来取样路径长度。 由于任务具有真正的组成性或通过中期计划,任务也可能隐含MMHT,因此这种区分很重要。

blocks.en: In general, ‘curriculum’ is an overloaded term, and no longer applies to a specific pre-training supervision method ( bengio2009curriculum ) . It can be applied to in-context learning ( luo-etal-2025-lets ; ma-etal-2025-problem ; lee2025distinct ) . hao2025training used a masking curriculum where parts of reasoning traces are systematically removed to promote the model relying on continuous CoT inputs instead. It can also be applied across tasks in a multitask setting ( liu2026language ) . Note that they use ‘curriculum’ to describe a phenomenon where models naturally learn tasks in order of difficulty, instead of the curriculum being a form of training supervision.
blocks.zh: 一般来说,“curriculum”是一个超载术语,不再适用于具体的培训前监督方法(bengio2009curriculum)。 可用于内文学习(luo-etal-2025-lets;ma-etal-2025- problem ;lee2025i). hao2025训练使用一个遮掩式课程,其中部分推理痕迹被系统地去除,以依靠连续的CoT输入来推广模型. 它也可以在多任务设置( liu2026 language ) 中跨任务应用. 请注意,他们使用 " curriculum " 来描述一种现象,即模型自然地按照难度学习任务,而不是课程作为一种培训监督的形式。

blocks.en: Appendix B Further Discussion of Contributions, Limitations, and Scope
blocks.zh: 附录B 关于缴款、限制和范围的进一步讨论

blocks.en: We summarize our contributions for quick reference.
blocks.zh: 我们总结了我们的贡献,以便迅速参考。

blocks.en:
1. Theoretical Model Framing. We spell out the theoretical model underlying the study of multihop reasoning via shortest-path search, which prior work assumes but leaves unstated.
We inherit this controlled setting ( bachmann2024the ; saparov2025transformers , C ) . 2. Topological shortcuts under NTP. We generalize the Clever Hans Cheat from path-star graphs to arbitrary topologies via choice nodes, giving an SSE of c ⁡ ( π ) c(\pi) which is thus strongly topology-dependent under NTP (§ 2 ). bachmann2024the ’s speculation that the problem is broad has spurred much follow-up work ( D.4 ); by characterizing exactly when the CHC arises, and how it affects learning, we delimit its extent. 3. MTP is optimal, NTP is not. We prove that MTP attains an optimal SSE and hop mixture over the sampled path, giving k ⁡ ( k + 1 ) / 2 − ( k − c ⁡ ( π ) ) k(k+1)/2-(k-c(\pi)) terms after correcting for those the CHC absorbs (§ 2.1 and I ).
This residual topological dependency is linear, and thus dominated by the quadratic MTP terms as k k grows, making MTP nearly topology-independent while NTP remains strongly topology-dependent (§ 2.1 ).
We also show that masked discrete diffusion yields a strict subset of MTP’s terms ( I.1 ). 4. A novel MTP method. We introduce a probabilistic listwise Plackett-Luce formulation of Ranking-into-the-Future, in contrast to the non-probabilistic pairwise and listwise losses of frydenlund-2025-language and zuhri2025predicting respectively ( H ). 5. Fragmented routing and the node list. We show that the causal constraint is severely compounded by graph sparsity and edge-list shuffling, deferring routing until most of E E has been observed and exhausting the model’s sequential computation (§ 3 ).
This motivates including the node list ( + N +N ) to bypass the causal constraint and accumulate edge information. 6. Permutation sensitivity and structural annotation. Positional embeddings break the permutation invariance inherent to the task (§ 4 ).
This motivates structural annotation (STAN), which makes each edge a unique super-token , removing positional leakage. 7. Breaking the scaling wall. This is the focus of this work. Prior work could not stably learn the task beyond 50 50 nodes.
STAN and + N +N account for the largest empirical gains, and together with MTP they break this wall.
We show that (a) we learn stably up to | 𝒩 | = 125 |\mathcal{N}|=125 in about 1 / 3 1/3 the steps (§ 6 ). Note that the scaling trend is super-linear (Fig. 3 ), so scaling to 2.5 × 2.5\times the graph size is a substantial gain ; (b) the variance issue between seeds reported by prior work is solved, greatly reducing the cost of running future experiments ( J.1 ); (c) MTP beats NTP across scale with this gap growing with k k and | 𝒩 | |\mathcal{N}| ; (d) the performance of MTP is orthogonal to the tokenization. Thus, they solve different underlying scaling problems ; and (e) we solve path-star graphs with NTP well beyond prior work using only inter-sample MMHT and MTP makes them trivial at all scales. 8. Auxiliary tasks ( L ). We consider three further latent multihop tasks: Khops ( L.1 ) ( pmlr-v235-sanford24a ) , Khops-Gen (a generative variant we introduce, L.2 ), and a BFS scratchpad (BFS-SP, L.3 ).
These serve two purposes.
First, they show that MTP’s benefits are not limited to shortest-path search, but hold across symbolic multihop tasks.
Second, they let us show that while BFS-SP is learnable, it suffers its own tokenization issues and its sequence length grows too quickly to scale. More importantly, we show it collapses the latent reasoning graph into a linear chain, which breaks the established theoretical model. ( L.4 ). Thus, it is not a viable ‘solution’.
We show this by reducing it to Khops-Gen.
Additionally, we find that hop-length is not the only dimension of difficulty that matters, as mixed multi-length training (MMLT, L.1.1 ) is necessary for learning Khops-Gen.
blocks.zh:
一、导 言 理论模型浮雕. 我们阐述了通过最短的路径搜索研究多跳推理的基础理论模型,之前的工作假设了这个模型,但没有说明。
我们继承了这个控制的设置(bachmann2024the;saparov2025 transfers , C.). 2. NTP下的地形捷径. 我们通过选择节点将聪明汉斯·凯特从路径星图概括为任意的地形,从而给出一个在NTP(§2)下高度依赖地形的c →(π) c(\pi)的SSE。 巴赫曼2024的猜测是问题广泛刺激了许多后续工作(D.4 ) ; 通过精确描述CHC出现的时间以及它如何影响学习,我们划定了它的范围。 3. 中期计划是最佳的,国家中期计划不是。 我们证明,MTP在样本路径上实现了最佳SSE和跳动混合物,在纠正CHC吸收的词语(§2.1和I)之后,给出 k → (k + 1) / 2 → (k → c ) → (π) → (k +1) → (k-c (\pi)) 。
这种残余的地貌依赖是线性的,因此随着kk的增长,以四面体的中期计划术语为主,使得中期计划几乎地貌独立,而NTP则仍然高度地貌依赖(§2.1.).
我们还表明,蒙面分散的传播产生严格的中期计划条款(I.1 )。 4. 一个全新的中期计划方法。 我们引入了一种概率列表式的Plackett-Luce配方Ranking-into-the-Future, 与非概率对称和列表式的Fripdenlund-2025语言损失和zuhri2025预测(H )相对应。 5. 断路和节点清单。 我们显示,由于图表的伸缩和边缘列表的摇摆,将路径推延到EE大部分被观察到并用尽模型的顺序计算(§ 3),导致因果关系的制约严重加重。
这激励包括节点列表(+N +N)绕过因果制约并积累边缘信息. 6. 持久性敏感性和结构注释。 位置嵌入会打破任务固有的内在变化(§4).
这激发了结构注释(STAN),使每个边缘都成为独特的超托,消除位置渗漏. 7. 打破缩放墙。 这是这项工作的重点。 先前的工作无法在50个节点后稳定地学习任务。
STAN和+N+N是最大的经验收益,它们与中期计划一起打破了这堵墙.

第二,它们让我们表明,虽然BFS-SP是可学习的,但它会遇到其自身的象征性问题,其序列长度增长太快,无法扩展。 更重要的是,我们显示它使潜在的推理图崩溃成线性链条,这打破了既定的理论模型。 (第L.4条)。 因此,这不是可行的 " 解决办法 " 。

blocks.en:
Theoretical Model Framing. We spell out the theoretical model underlying the study of multihop reasoning via shortest-path search, which prior work assumes but leaves unstated.
We inherit this controlled setting ( bachmann2024the ; saparov2025transformers , C ) .
blocks.zh:
理论模型浮雕. 我们阐述了通过最短的路径搜索研究多跳推理的基础理论模型,之前的工作假设了这个模型,但没有说明。
我们继承了这个控制的设置(bachmann2024the;saparov2025 transfers , C.).

blocks.en: Topological shortcuts under NTP. We generalize the Clever Hans Cheat from path-star graphs to arbitrary topologies via choice nodes, giving an SSE of c ⁡ ( π ) c(\pi) which is thus strongly topology-dependent under NTP (§ 2 ). bachmann2024the ’s speculation that the problem is broad has spurred much follow-up work ( D.4 ); by characterizing exactly when the CHC arises, and how it affects learning, we delimit its extent.
blocks.zh: NTP 下的地形快捷键. 我们通过选择节点将聪明汉斯·凯特从路径星图概括为任意的地形,从而给出一个在NTP(§2)下高度依赖地形的c →(π) c(\pi)的SSE。 巴赫曼2024的猜测是问题广泛刺激了许多后续工作(D.4 ) ; 通过精确描述CHC出现的时间以及它如何影响学习,我们划定了它的范围。

blocks.en:
MTP is optimal, NTP is not. We prove that MTP attains an optimal SSE and hop mixture over the sampled path, giving k ⁡ ( k + 1 ) / 2 − ( k − c ⁡ ( π ) ) k(k+1)/2-(k-c(\pi)) terms after correcting for those the CHC absorbs (§ 2.1 and I ).
This residual topological dependency is linear, and thus dominated by the quadratic MTP terms as k k grows, making MTP nearly topology-independent while NTP remains strongly topology-dependent (§ 2.1 ).
We also show that masked discrete diffusion yields a strict subset of MTP’s terms ( I.1 ).
blocks.zh:
MTP是最佳的,NTP不是。 我们证明,MTP在样本路径上实现了最佳SSE和跳动混合物,在纠正CHC吸收的词语(§2.1和I)之后,给出 k → (k + 1) / 2 → (k → c ) → (π) → (k +1) → (k-c (\pi)) 。
这种残余的地貌依赖是线性的,因此随着kk的增长,以四面体的中期计划术语为主,使得中期计划几乎地貌独立,而NTP则仍然高度地貌依赖(§2.1.).
我们还表明,蒙面分散的传播产生严格的中期计划条款(I.1 )。

blocks.en: A novel MTP method. We introduce a probabilistic listwise Plackett-Luce formulation of Ranking-into-the-Future, in contrast to the non-probabilistic pairwise and listwise losses of frydenlund-2025-language and zuhri2025predicting respectively ( H ).
blocks.zh: 小说MTP方法. 我们引入了一种概率列表式的Plackett-Luce配方Ranking-into-the-Future, 与非概率对称和列表式的Fripdenlund-2025语言损失和zuhri2025预测(H )相对应。

blocks.en:
Fragmented routing and the node list. We show that the causal constraint is severely compounded by graph sparsity and edge-list shuffling, deferring routing until most of E E has been observed and exhausting the model’s sequential computation (§ 3 ).
This motivates including the node list ( + N +N ) to bypass the causal constraint and accumulate edge information.
blocks.zh:
断裂的路由和节点列表. 我们显示,由于图表的伸缩和边缘列表的摇摆,将路径推延到EE大部分被观察到并用尽模型的顺序计算(§ 3),导致因果关系的制约严重加重。
这激励包括节点列表(+N +N)绕过因果制约并积累边缘信息.

blocks.en:
Permutation sensitivity and structural annotation. Positional embeddings break the permutation invariance inherent to the task (§ 4 ).
This motivates structural annotation (STAN), which makes each edge a unique super-token , removing positional leakage.
blocks.zh:
常态敏感性和结构注释. 位置嵌入会打破任务固有的内在变化(§4).
这激发了结构注释(STAN),使每个边缘都成为独特的超托,消除位置渗漏.

blocks.en:
Breaking the scaling wall. This is the focus of this work. Prior work could not stably learn the task beyond 50 50 nodes.
STAN and + N +N account for the largest empirical gains, and together with MTP they break this wall.
We show that (a) we learn stably up to | 𝒩 | = 125 |\mathcal{N}|=125 in about 1 / 3 1/3 the steps (§ 6 ). Note that the scaling trend is super-linear (Fig. 3 ), so scaling to 2.5 × 2.5\times the graph size is a substantial gain ; (b) the variance issue between seeds reported by prior work is solved, greatly reducing the cost of running future experiments ( J.1 ); (c) MTP beats NTP across scale with this gap growing with k k and | 𝒩 | |\mathcal{N}| ; (d) the performance of MTP is orthogonal to the tokenization. Thus, they solve different underlying scaling problems ; and (e) we solve path-star graphs with NTP well beyond prior work using only inter-sample MMHT and MTP makes them trivial at all scales.
blocks.zh:
打破缩放墙。 这是这项工作的重点。 先前的工作无法在50个节点后稳定地学习任务。
STAN和+N+N是最大的经验收益,它们与中期计划一起打破了这堵墙.
我们显示, (a) 我们的学习是尖锐的, 请注意,缩放趋势是超线性的(图3),因此缩放到2.5×2.5\时,图大小是一个很大的增益;(b) 解决了先前工作报告的种子之间的差异问题,大大降低了未来实验的成本(J.1);(c) MTP以 k k 和 Q |\ mathcal{ N}| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| 因此,它们解决了不同的基本的缩放问题;和(e) 我们用NTP来解决路径-星图,远远超出了先前的工作范围,只使用跨样本的MMHT和MTP使其在所有尺度上都变得微不足道。

blocks.en:
Auxiliary tasks ( L ). We consider three further latent multihop tasks: Khops ( L.1 ) ( pmlr-v235-sanford24a ) , Khops-Gen (a generative variant we introduce, L.2 ), and a BFS scratchpad (BFS-SP, L.3 ).
These serve two purposes.
First, they show that MTP’s benefits are not limited to shortest-path search, but hold across symbolic multihop tasks.
Second, they let us show that while BFS-SP is learnable, it suffers its own tokenization issues and its sequence length grows too quickly to scale. More importantly, we show it collapses the latent reasoning graph into a linear chain, which breaks the established theoretical model. ( L.4 ). Thus, it is not a viable ‘solution’.
We show this by reducing it to Khops-Gen.
Additionally, we find that hop-length is not the only dimension of difficulty that matters, as mixed multi-length training (MMLT, L.1.1 ) is necessary for learning Khops-Gen.
blocks.zh:
辅助任务 (L). 我们考虑了另外三项潜在的多跳任务:Khops(L.1)(pmlr-v235-sanford24a),Khops-Gen(我们引入的基因变体,L.2),以及BFS抓刀(BFS-SP,L.3)。
这有两个目的。
首先,它们表明,中期计划的好处并不限于最短的路径搜索,而是跨越象征性的多跳任务。
第二,它们让我们表明,虽然BFS-SP是可学习的,但它会遇到其自身的象征性问题,其序列长度增长太快,无法扩展。 更重要的是,我们显示它使潜在的推理图崩溃成线性链条,这打破了既定的理论模型。 (第L.4条)。 因此,这不是可行的 " 解决办法 " 。
我们通过把它缩小到Khops -Gen来显示这一点。
此外,我们发现,跳动长度并不是困难的唯一方面,因为混合多长度培训(MMLT,L.1.1)是学习Khops-Gen所必需的。

blocks.en:
This work considers a scaling issue encountered in prior work.
We overcame that scaling wall via both alternative tokenization and MTP. The fact that MTP’s advantages are nearly topology-independent is an unexpected finding. We analyzed MTP to explain why it ameliorates a known, topology- specific pathology, and the topology-independence fell out of that analysis.
However, this leads to a natural conjecture.
We motivated graph search as a model for multihop reasoning precisely because the latent reasoning graph has unknown topology, so no topological assumptions are permissible.
If MTP’s advantages do not depend on topology, then they should hold for any multihop reasoning task, making MTP a principled training objective for multihop reasoning in general.
Had this been our starting hypothesis, this would be a different paper, with methodology built around testing that conjecture rather than around scaling.
blocks.zh:
这项工作考虑了在以前的工作中遇到的尺度问题。
我们通过替代标志化和中期计划克服了那堵墙。 MTP的优势几乎是地形学独立的,这是一个出乎意料的发现. 我们分析了中期计划,以解释为什么它能改善已知的、特定的地貌病理学,而地貌独立则从这种分析中消失。
然而,这导致了一种自然的猜想.
我们激励图搜索作为多跳推理的模型,正是因为潜在的推理图有未知的地形,所以不允许任何地形假设.
如果中期计划的好处不取决于地形,那么他们应该坚持任何多跳推理任务,使中期计划成为一般多跳推理的原则性训练目标。
如果这是我们最初的假设,那将是一个不同的文件,其方法围绕着假设而不是尺度的测试。

blocks.en:
Evaluating it is non-trivial.
Our results rest on the fact that each target token corresponds to exactly one hop, so a window spanning k k tokens also spans k k hops.
This correspondence breaks for natural language.
A potential solution is non-contiguous windows ( liu2025lmtp ) , but designing hop-aligned targets for arbitrary tasks would itself be a non-trivial research contribution. So it remains a conjecture and not an established claim.
blocks.zh:
评估它是非部落性的。
我们的结果取决于一个事实,每个目标标志 完全对应一个跳, 所以一个窗口 横跨 k k 标志 也跨 k k hops。
此函断为自然语.
一个潜在的解决方案是非毗连窗口(liu2025lmtp),但为任意任务设计hop-accessed目标本身将是一种非三角研究贡献. 因此,这仍然是一种推测,而不是一项既定的索赔。

blocks.en:
Regardless, this paper would still be necessary.
It is by investigating the scaling issue that we establish MTP’s benefits, both theoretically and empirically.
But MTP alone does not break the scaling wall.
The tokenization methods account for the majority of the empirical gains, and they are orthogonal to MTP, so any work concerned with scaling must consider both.
This orthogonality makes our methodology disjointed,
but this is a reflection of the underlying causes being disjointed.
This also means MTP’s benefits hold independently of our tokenization changes. A paper on MTP alone would be cleaner, but, unfortunately, the most interesting finding is not necessarily the most important one in terms of performance gain.
blocks.zh:
无论如何,这份文件仍然是必要的。
我们正是通过调查规模问题,从理论上和经验上确定中期计划的好处。
但是,单靠中期计划并不能打破缩放墙。
象征性方法占经验收益的大多数,它们与中期计划是正统的,因此,任何与规模扩大有关的工作都必须考虑到两者。
这种矫形 使我们的方法脱节,
但这反映了根本原因的脱节。
这也意味着中期计划的好处独立于我们的象征性变化。 单是一份有关中期计划的文件是比较干净的,但不幸的是,最有意义的结论不一定是业绩收益方面最重要的结论。

blocks.en:
The most significant limitation is that our motivating hypotheses do not fully explain why STAN and + N +N work so well. Both methods are well motivated.
Fragmented routing and the loss of permutation invariance are real properties of the setting, and we show that both hold (§ 3 , § 4 ).
The question is not whether these issues exist, but the extent to which they contribute to the scaling wall.
blocks.zh:
最重要的限制是,我们的动机假设不能充分解释为什么STAN和+N+N工作如此良好。 这两种方法都有很好的动机。
断裂的路由和断断续续的失落是设置的实际属性,我们表明两者都坚守(§3,§4).
问题不在于这些问题是否存在,而在于它们在多大程度上促成了墙的缩小。

blocks.en:
We ablate using two model parameterizations in an attempt to answer this, since each hypothesis predicts where its method should have no effect.
The causal constraint does not apply to prefix LMs, and causal LMs cannot be permutation-invariant.
The design is thus falsifiable, but it falsified our own explanations. + N +N still improves prefix LMs, and STAN still improves causal LMs.
Importantly, the counter-evidence shows that each benefit extends beyond its motivating hypothesis, not that the hypothesis is wrong. Indeed, prefix LMs outperform causal LMs on ERGs (Fig. 3 vs. Fig. 4 ), which shows that the causal constraint matters. Note that both issues ultimately stem from the causal constraint;
Fragmented routing arises from the interaction of causal masking with graph sparsity and tokenization, and permutation invariance requires both the removal of causal masking and positional embeddings.
Thus, while this design can falsify a hypothesis, it cannot isolate the two, since changing the parameterization changes the conditions for both at once.
blocks.zh:
我们利用两个模型参数化来解答这个问题,因为每个假设都预言其方法应该在哪里没有效果.
因果限制不适用于前缀LMs,因果LMs不能具有穿透-内变性.
设计因此是伪造的,但是它伪造了我们自己的解释。 N+N仍然改进前缀LM,STAN仍然改进因果LM.
重要的是,反证据显示,每个好处都超出了其动机假设,而不是假设是错误的。 事实上,前缀LMs在ERGs上超过了因果LMs(图3对图4),这表明因果制约很重要. 注意到这两个问题最终都是由因果关系引起的;
断裂的路由产生于因果遮盖与图纸的螺旋和标致化的相互作用,而穿透变异既需要去除因果遮盖和位置嵌入.
因此,虽然这种设计可以伪造一个假说,但不能孤立两者,因为改变参数化会同时改变两者的条件.

blocks.en:
STAN in particular is hard to ablate further as it does three modifications that are intrinsically coupled: it moves positional information into the annotation channel, it makes E E permutation-invariant, and it reduces E E to 1 / 3 1/3 its length. Length is an interesting factor as it affects expressiveness ( sanford2024understanding ; merrill2024the ; london2025pause ) . yehudai2026depth likewise changed the tokenization and the token count together and attributed the gain to the tokenization.
Note also that + N +N increases the sequence length while STAN decreases it, and both improve performance; thus, raw length changes alone do not explain their performance.
Also, STAN removes the variance across trials and induces the expected behaviour, where convergence scales with k k (§ 6 ).
The baseline does not behave this way. 6 6 6 This may be an artifact of the max-step cut-off. However, as the spiked PSGs results show, training longer may not necessarily show a gradual pattern. A task whose difficulty grows with the number of hops should look like the former, not the latter.
The deficiency therefore lies in the original tokenization rather than in the task, even if we cannot say precisely what that deficiency is.
blocks.zh:
特别是STAN很难进一步退缩,因为它做了三个内在结合的修改:它将位置信息移动到注释通道中,它使E 演化-变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变体变 长度是一个有趣的因素,因为它会影响表达性(sanford2024 understanding ; mirill2024 the ; London2025pause ). yhudai2026 深度同样改变了 标志和标志计数 并把收益归结为标志。
也注意+N+N会增加序列长度,而STAN会减少序列长度,两者都会提高性能;因此,仅凭原始长度变化并不能解释它们的性能.
此外,STAN消除了各种试验的差异,并诱发预期行为,即与kk(第6节)的趋同尺度。
基线不这样做。 6 6 6 6 这也许是最大步断的文物。 然而,正如激增的方案支助组的结果表明,培训时间更长不一定显示出一种渐进模式。 任务难度随着跳跃次数的增加而增加,应该看起来像前者,而不是后者.
因此,缺陷在于最初的象征,而不是任务,即使我们不能准确地说出缺陷是什么。

blocks.en:
We thus have strong positive empirical results but a negative result for our hypotheses.
We leave closing this gap to future work.
We note four things.
First, the ablations still establish the tokenization as a cause of the scaling wall.
The same model, task, and data learn differently under different tokenizations, so the failure lies in the tokenization and what remains open is which of its properties is responsible.
Second, fragmented routing and the loss of permutation invariance are real issues, so these experiments were necessary regardless of which hypothesis ultimately explains the gains.
Third, neither method breaks the theoretical model ( L.3 ).
Finally, we emphasize that the MTP results are theoretically grounded and orthogonal to the tokenization, and thus hold with or without STAN and + N +N .
blocks.zh:
因此,我们有很强的积极经验结果,但对我们的假设来说却是消极结果。
我们把缩小这一差距留给今后的工作。
我们注意到四件事。
首先,烧伤仍使标志化成为缩放墙的一个原因。
同样的模型,任务,和数据在不同的符号化下学习不同,因此失败在于符号化,仍然开放的是哪个属性负责.
第二,零散的路由和断层变异的丧失是真正的问题,所以无论哪一种假设最终能解释收益,这些实验都是必要的.
第三,这两种方法都不打破理论模型(L.3).
最后,我们强调,中期计划的结果在理论上是有根据的,对象征意义是正统的,因此与STAN和+N+N不相容。

blocks.en:
We observe the lockout phenomenon only on PSGs .
This is a novel finding, only made visible by scaling NTP on PSGs beyond prior work (as prior models fail to the CHC before lockout can manifest).
Unlike the CHCH, its mechanism, where targets of different lengths cease contributing once solved, is not obviously tied to the PSG topology.
However, since PSGs are an adversarial topology to learning under NTP, we may only see this phenomenon in this adversarial setting.
We suspect looped models would solve this, as tying parameters across hops forces the model to reuse the same computation across hops ( giannou2023looped ; pmlr-v235-back-de-luca24a ; yang2024looped ; fan2025looped ; saunshi2025reasoning ; zhu2025scaling ) . We do not test this as it would require training an entirely new set of models.
Note that this concerns in-domain learning dynamics and is separate from the case for looped models in OOD settings (below).
blocks.zh:
我们只看到PSG的封锁现象。
这是一个新发现,只有在先前工作范围之外的PSG上缩放NTP才显露出来(因为之前的模型在锁定显示之前会失败给CHC).
与商用六氯环乙烷不同,其不同长度的目标一旦解决即停止贡献,其机制显然没有与PSG地形挂钩。
但是,由于在NTP下学习时,PSG是一种对抗性的地形学,所以我们只能在这种对抗性环境下看到这种现象.
我们怀疑环绕的模型会解决这个问题,因为横跨跳动的绑定参数迫使模型在跳动(giannou2023looled;pmlr-v235-back-de-luca24a;yang2024looled;fan2025looled;saunshi2025Reasoning;zhu2025scaling)之间重复同样的计算. 我们不测试这一点,因为它需要培训一套全新的模式。
请注意,这涉及域内学习动态,与OD环境(以下)中循环模型的情况不同。

blocks.en:
We cannot fully formalize learnability. We demonstrate scalability trends empirically.
On the theoretical side, we formalize some characteristics of learnability, showing that sequential sample efficiency is strongly topology-dependent under NTP, but becomes nearly topology-independent and increases substantially under MTP.
However, other characteristics that affect learnability remain unformalized, such as the number of paths from a choice node ( xu2026depth ) .
We thus cannot formalize learnability, and so scalability, as one can for simpler tasks ( pmlr-v291-wang25a ) .
Given the theoretical model, such a formalization would be a holy grail for learnability theory. We make partial progress towards this;
however, the larger point, and a key takeaway from our work, is
that precisely specifying learnability for this task is very difficult.
blocks.zh:
我们不能使学习正式化。 我们以经验证明可扩展性趋势。
在理论方面,我们正式确定一些可学习性特征,表明相继抽样效率在NTP下强烈依赖地形学,但在MTP下却变得几乎是地形学独立的,并且大大提高.
然而,影响可学习性的其他特征仍然没有正规化,例如选择节点的路径数量(xu2026 deep ).
因此,我们无法将可学习性正规化,因此,可扩展性,因为可以执行更简单的任务(pmlr-v291-wang25a) 。 。 。
鉴于这种理论模式,这种形式化将是学习能力理论的神圣特征。 我们在这方面取得了部分进展;
然而,我们工作中最重要的一点,就是
确切指明这项任务的可学习性是非常困难的。

blocks.en: We address other limitations, which we consider as questions of scope.
blocks.zh: 我们处理其他局限性,我们认为这些局限性是范围问题。

blocks.en:
Why did you not consider out-of-distribution generalization? Our focus is the scaling wall, which is an in-domain failure. Prior work could not learn the task at scale even when training and testing on the same distribution.
Solving the scaling issue in-domain is a prerequisite to asking anything about OOD.
While this makes OOD evaluation an obvious next step, it also places it beyond the scope of the motivating phenomenon of this work.
Moreover, OOD evaluation is not trivial.
There are at least three OOD dimensions, and each is difficult to evaluate for its own reasons.
blocks.zh:
你为什么不考虑分配外的概括? 我们的焦点是缩放墙,这是域内故障。 即使在同一分布上进行培训和测试,以前的工作也无法大规模地学习任务。
解决域内规模化问题是询问任何关于OD的前提.
虽然这使OD评价成为下一个明显步骤,但它也使OD评价超越了这项工作的推动范围。
此外,OD评价并非微不足道。
至少有三个OD维度,每个维度因自身原因难以评价.

blocks.en:
The first is path length and graph size.
This requires positional embeddings capable of length generalization ( ruoss-etal-2023-randomized ; li2024functional ) .
We use learnt embeddings because they carry no inductive bias, which lets us rule them out as a cause of the scaling wall.
Using OOD-capable embeddings only makes sense now that the scaling wall is solved, and would have otherwise been a confound for the question we were asking.
Beyond this, we know a static model cannot scale to arbitrary k k , so looped models would be required ( giannou2023looped ; saunshi2025reasoning ; fan2025looped ) .
But looped models tie parameters across latent hops, which changes in-domain learnability in its own right.
Any OOD result would thus be entangled with an in-domain change, which is a further confound.
In both cases, we would have to train an entirely new set of models, as this cannot be evaluated with the ones we have. Note this is the only OOD question that actually concerns scale.
blocks.zh:
第一个是路径长度和图表大小。
这需要能够长度泛化(ruoss-etal-2023-randomized ; li2024功能)的位置嵌入.
我们使用所学的嵌入法是因为它们没有诱导性偏差,这使得我们排除了它们作为缩放墙的原因。
使用OOD-能力嵌入物,只有在缩放墙已经解决后才有意义,否则我们所问的问题就会陷入混乱。
除了这个, 我们知道一个静态模型不能缩放到任意的 k k , 因此需要循环模型( giannou2023looled ; saunshi2025 reasoning ; fance2025looled ) 。
但循环的模型将参数绑定在潜伏的跳跃上,这本身会改变域内学习能力.
因此,任何OD结果都将与域内变化纠缠在一起,这又是一个困惑。
在这两种情况下,我们都必须培训一套全新的模式,因为不能用我们已有的模式来评估。 请注意,这是唯一一个实际涉及规模的OD问题。

blocks.en:
The second is topology. saparov2025transformers consider exactly this, training on one topology to test generalization to another, and it did not solve the scaling wall.
It also raises the question of which topologies support generalization to others.
Our analysis of choice nodes suggests trees may be the best candidate, but this is beyond the in-domain scaling issue.
blocks.zh:
二是地形学. saparov2025的转换器考虑的正是这一点,在一个地形学上进行培训,以测试对另一个地形的概括,它并没有解决缩放墙.
这也提出了一个问题,即哪些地形支持对他人的概括。
我们对选择节点的分析表明,树木可能是最佳候选人,但这超出了域内规模问题的范围。

blocks.en:
The third is task.
Does learning to search help on other graph tasks?
Search is a fundamental building block, so it is reasonable to expect that it does, but this too is beyond the scaling question.
blocks.zh:
第三是任务。
在其它图表任务上学习搜索帮助吗 ?
搜索是一个根本的构件,所以可以合理地预期它确实存在,但这也超出了规模化的问题.

blocks.en:
Why did you not consider other topologies? Adding topologies multiplies the experiments required, leading to experimental scope creep.
We consider three topologies, whereas prior work prioritize one ( bachmann2024the ; saparov2025transformers ) .
This is because we wish to answer questions about how topology affects scale.
The CHC ( bachmann2024the ) and our generalization to arbitrary topology make path-star graphs the most adversarial topology to NTP, which is why they get so much attention in the paper.
We then show MTP is nearly topology-independent.
Path length is what matters for scaling, so the relevant topologies are those supporting long paths.
This rules out dense and small-world graphs, where most paths are short.
It also makes deep trees computationally prohibitive, since long paths require exponentially more nodes. We would consider any topology with a property expected to contradict the theory, but testing topologies without such a reason has diminishing returns at a large computational cost in our experimental setup( J.1 ).
blocks.zh:
你为什么不考虑其他的地形? 添加地形使所需的实验成倍增加,导致实验范围蠕动.
我们考虑三个地形,而以前的工作则优先考虑一个(bachmann2024the;saparov2025 transfers).
这是因为我们希望回答关于地形学如何影响规模的问题。
CHC(bachmann2024the)和我们对任意地形学的概括,使得路径-星图成为NTP最敌对的地形学,这就是为什么他们在报纸上得到如此多的注意.
然后我们显示MTP几乎是 地形独立的。
路径长度是缩放的要紧所在,因此相关的地形是支持长路径的.
这排除了密集的和小世界的图表,其中大部分路径短.
它还使深层树木在计算上令人望而却步,因为漫长的路程需要以指数表示的更多节点。 我们认为,任何具有预期与理论相矛盾的地貌学,但无此理由的地貌学试验,在我们实验设置中,以巨大的计算成本降低了回报(J.1)。

blocks.en:
Why did you not consider other tasks? Connectivity, connected components, and reachability all reduce to shortest path search, so a model that learns that should learn these.
However, determining the correct tokenization for these tasks is non-trivial, as we see both with direct shortest path and the BFS scratchpad.
Weighted shortest paths in the style of Dijkstra’s algorithm further require tokenizing edge weights, which introduces a representational choice we would then have to control for. Our focus is not on benchmarking language models on various graph tasks.
blocks.zh:
你为何不考虑其他任务? 连通性,连通性组件,可达性都减少到最短的路径搜索,所以一个应该学习这些的模型.
然而,确定这些任务的正确标志性是非三角性的,我们既看到最短的直接路径,也看到BFS抓图。
Dijkstra的算法风格中最短的加权路径进一步要求标定边重,这引入了我们当时必须控制的代表性选择。 我们的重点不是将各种图表任务的语言模型作为基准。

blocks.en: Why not report FLOPs? We report steps rather than throughput because our claim concerns supervision; thus, FLOPs are not the appropriate metric. This is not a benchmarking paper.
blocks.zh: 为什么不报告FLOPs? 我们报告的步骤而不是吞吐量,因为我们的主张涉及监督;因此,FLOP不是适当的衡量标准。 这不是一份基准文件。

blocks.en:
Why not consider other MTP methods? We introduce a novel MTP without comparison to other methods.
Ours is designed to support our theory. All we need to demonstrate is that such a method exists and performs well.
This is not a benchmarking paper of MTP methods on this task.
Readers wanting a rank-based MTP evaluated on natural language data should see zuhri2025predicting .
blocks.zh:
为什么不考虑其他中期计划方法? 我们引进了一个新的中期计划,而没有与其他方法相比。
我们的理论是为了支持我们的理论。 我们需要证明的是,这种方法是存在的,而且运作良好。
这不是中期计划方法关于这项任务的基准文件。
读者希望根据自然语言数据评估基于等级的中期计划,

blocks.en:
Why did you not consider discrete diffusion? We do consider it, theoretically.
Masked discrete diffusion models (MDM) induce MMHT in the same way MTP does ( D.7 ), and produce a subset of the MTP cost terms for this task ( I.1 ).
However, MDM changes both the loss and the model parameterization at once, combining a masking-based loss with a non-causal architecture.
This is not a controlled comparison, and inducing the same cost terms does not imply the same expressibility or learnability ( svete2026on ) .
More importantly, MDM can potentially generate in any order.
This admits the reverse ‘solution’, where the path is produced from t t back to s s for PSGs ( bachmann2024the ) . This requires no multihop reasoning, and thus potentially bypasses the very thing we care about. Thus, they are a much harder model to study even in controlled settings.
blocks.zh:
你为什么不考虑分散传播? 我们确实认为,理论上。
遮盖的离散扩散模型(MDM)以同样方式诱导MMHT(D.7),并为这项任务产生一个MTP成本术语的子集(I.1 )。
然而,MDM同时改变损失和模型参数化,将基于遮掩的损失与非因果关系架构相结合.
这不是一种可控的比较,而相同的成本条件并不意味着同样的可表达性或可学习性(svete2026on)。
更重要的是,MDM可以按任何顺序生成.
这承认了反之的“解决方案”,即路径由 t t 生产回 s 为 PSG (bachmann2024 the ) 。 这不需要多跳推理,从而有可能绕过我们所关心的事物。 因此,即使是在受控制的环境中,它们也是一种更难研究的模式。

blocks.en:
Why did you not use LLMs or larger models? Prior work has already shown that LLMs cannot solve the task on path-star graphs ( bachmann2024the ; xu2026depth ) , and that model size is not why the task is hard to learn at scale ( saparov2025transformers ) .There is no benefit in repeating established negative results.
Small models can express the problem, and we show they can learn it at scale.
A separate question is whether our methods transfer to larger or pretrained models.
MTP has been part of foundation models for some time ( liu2024deepseek ; xiao2026mimo ; team2026qwen3 ) , and the node list is easily applicable to LLMs.
STAN induces a new input format, and there is no reason to expect this to harm a larger model trained from scratch.
Applying STAN to a pretrained LLM may be an engineering problem, but that sits outside the question of learnability, and is not a claim we make.
The purpose of this work is not to benchmark LLMs on the task, but to understand why the task is hard to learn, which requires a controlled setting LLMs are ill-suited for ( C ).
blocks.zh:
你为什么不使用LLMS或更大的模型? 先前的工作已经表明,LLMs无法解决路径-星图上的任务(bachmann2024the;xu2026 deep ),而模型大小并不是任务在尺度上难以学习的原因(saparov2025 transfers ). 重复既定的负面结果没有任何好处。
小模型可以表达问题,我们显示他们可以大规模学习.
另一个问题是,我们的方法是转移到更大的模型上还是预先训练的模型上。
MTP一段时间以来一直是基础模型的一部分(liu2024deepseek;xiao2026mimo;team2026qwen3),节点列表很容易适用于LLMs.
STAN诱导新的输入格式,没有理由期望这会伤害一个从零开始训练的更大的模型.
将STAN应用到经过预训的LLM上可能是一个工程问题,但这不在于学习能力问题,也不是我们提出的主张.
这项工作的目的不是将LLMs作为任务的基准,而是理解为什么任务难于学习,这就要求有控制的设置LLMs不适合(C).

blocks.en:
Why did you not probe the model or use explainability methods? Because the experimental design makes them unnecessary. Probing is required when a correct output does not entail that the intended computation occurred, as memorization, world knowledge, or surface heuristics can produce it.
This is why we spend so long on the theoretical model ( C ).
Assumptions 1–5 remove these ( C.3 ). As test graphs are unseen, the edge set exists only in the current input, and a correct path entails a multihop search over it. Task performance is therefore direct evidence of the behaviour being studied, rather than a proxy for it. Fig. 6 is an example of this: SACC decomposed by k ′ k^{\prime} and d ′ d^{\prime} reads out which sub-problems the model has solved and when it acquires them, and the restricted MMHT experiment ( K.4 ) confirms the reading by intervention. We claim that latent multihop computation occurs, not how the model computes it, and nothing in this work depends on the latter.
blocks.zh:
你为什么不探测模型 或使用解释方法? 因为实验设计使得它们没有必要. 当正确的产出不要求进行预期的计算时,就要求进行试验,因为记忆、世界知识或表面修养可以产生这种结果。
这就是为什么我们在理论模型上花这么长时间(C.
假设1-5去掉这些(C.3)。 由于测试图是看不见的,边缘集只存在于当前输入中,正确的路径需要对其进行多跳搜索. 因此,任务业绩是所研究行为的直接证据,而不是其代名词。 费格。 6就是这方面的一个例子:SACC分解由k ' k^{\prime}和d′prime}读出模型已经解决的子问题和获得这些子问题,限制的MMHT实验(K.4)通过干预证实了读取. 我们声称,潜在的多跳计算发生,而不是模型如何计算它,在这项工作中,没有什么要依赖后者。

blocks.en:
Is it not already known that MTP helps on this task? That MTP helps is known; why it helps is not fully known, and prior results were tied to specific topologies, PSGs, at small scales. bachmann2024the proposed ‘teacherless’ training for path-star graphs and attributed its benefit to avoiding the CHC, but did not give a full account.
The CHC results from a bad interaction with teacher-forcing, yet removing teacher-forcing entirely is not the answer.
Teacherless training induces only the k k terms where i = 1 i=1 in Eq. 3 , which are the hardest, as they condition on no target-side tokens, whereas the remaining terms require 1 < i ≤ j 1<i\leq j , and thus use partial teacher-forcing. frydenlund-2025-language also used MTP without giving a complete explanation. gloeckle2024better speculated that MTP upweights informally defined ‘choice points’, which are not the choice nodes we define ( D.6 ). huang2026transformers proved that MTP and NTP induce different learning dynamics for d = 2 d=2 , k = 2 k=2 PSGs (concurrent to this work).
The scaling wall only appears as the graphs grow, and xu2026depth learned PSGs up to k = 5 k=5 with NTP alone.
The small-scale MTP results should be compared against this NTP result.
Results at these scales are therefore not results about the phenomenon we address.
We give the mechanism for general topologies, show that the benefit does not depend on the topology, and demonstrate this at scales far beyond these works.
Several other works have applied MTP to PSGs ( D.4 ), but did so to benchmark a method rather than to explain why MTP helps.
blocks.zh:
难道不知道中期计划有助于完成这项任务吗? 中期计划的帮助是众所周知的;为什么它的帮助并不完全为人所知,先前的结果与具体的地形,即PSG,在小尺度上是联系在一起的。 Bachmann2024提议对路径星图进行 " 无师资 " 培训,并将这一培训的好处归因于避免了CHC,但并未给出充分的说明。
CHC与教师强制互动不佳,但完全取消教师强制并不是答案.
无师资培训只诱导k词,其中i=1 i=1在Eq. 3中是最困难的,因为它们不附带目标方标志,而其余的词则需要1 < i j 1 <i\leq j,从而使用部分教师强制。 Frydenlund-2025-language也使用MTP,但没有给出完整的解释. Gloeckle2024较好地推测, MTP升华量非正式地定义了“选择点”, huang2026transformers证明,MTP和NTP诱导不同的学习动力学 d = 2 d = 2,k = 2 k = 2 PSGs(此工作同时进行).
缩放墙只随着图表的增长而出现,xu2026深入学习的PSG高达k=5k=5,仅NTP.
应将小规模中期计划结果与这项国家中期计划结果进行比较。
因此,这些规模的结果不是我们处理的现象的结果。
我们赋予了一般地貌学的机制,表明利益并不取决于地貌学,并以远远超出这些作品的尺度来证明这一点.
其他几部作品将中期计划应用于方案支助组(D.4),但这样做是为了确定一种方法的基准,而不是解释中期计划为什么有帮助。

blocks.zh: 见法果. 7,进一步澄清工作范围.

blocks.zh: 图7:关于工作范围的说明

blocks.en: Appendix C Graph Search as a Theoretical Model of Multihop Reasoning
blocks.zh: 附录C 图表搜索作为多跳理性理论模型

blocks.en:
This section sets out the theoretical model we adopt.
Modelling multihop reasoning as graph search is common, but doing so commits one to a set of claims which are rarely stated. We first define a multihop reasoning task and the graph it induces, and show that the definition admits two settings depending on how the learning problem is defined ( C.1 ).
We then state the five claims the model commits us to, and justify them by establishing their prior use ( C.2 ).
We then expand on assumptions our own setting adds ( C.3 ).
Finally, we describe the second setting, in which the graph is held in the weights, and which supports answering different questions from our setting ( C.4 ).
blocks.zh:
本节阐述我们采用的理论模式。
将多跳推理建模为图搜索是常见的,但这样做会使一组权利要求成为一组很少被表述的权利要求。 我们首先定义一个多跳推理任务和它诱导的图表,并显示定义根据学习问题的界定方式(C.1 )接受两个设置.
然后,我们指出模式要求我们承诺的五项主张,并证明它们先前的使用是合理的(C.2)。
然后,我们进一步阐述我们自己的设定(C.3)。
最后,我们描述第二种设定,即图表按权重排列,支持回答与我们设定不同的问题(C.4)。

blocks.en: This section also acts as a tutorial to our experimental setup, which is inherited from prior work ( bachmann2024the ; saparov2025transformers ; frydenlund-2025-language ) .
blocks.zh: 本节也作为我们实验设置的教程,从之前的作品(bachmann2024the ; saparov2025 transfers ; flordenlund-2025-language )中继承下来.

blocks.en: C.1 Defining a Multihop Reasoning Task
blocks.zh: C.1 定义多跳程序

blocks.en:
In § 1 , we defined a multihop reasoning task as a tuple ( 𝒲 , q , a ) (\mathcal{W},\,q,\,a) .
We now expand on this.
blocks.zh:
在§1中,我们定义了多跳推理任务为tuple(W, q, a) (\mathcal{W},\,q,\,a).
我们现在扩大这方面的内容。

blocks.en:
𝒲 \mathcal{W} is any information which licenses inference, i.e. a set of facts, axioms, rules, or relations.
The task is solved by k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 inferential steps connecting q q to a a , where each step is licensed by 𝒲 \mathcal{W} .
