Thus, 𝒲 \mathcal{W} induces the reasoning graph 𝒢 = ( 𝒩 , ℰ ) \mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{N},\,\mathcal{E}) , and the solution is a path π = q ​ u 1 ​ … ​ u k − 1 ​ a \pi=q\,u_{1}\ldots u_{k-1}\,a in 𝒢 \mathcal{G} . 7 7 7 This connection is so ingrained that even the term ‘multihop’ invokes imagery of a graph structure. Hopping on what? Compare with the nearly synonymous but more neutral term ‘multistep’ reasoning. To our knowledge, there is no definitional difference between the two.
blocks.zh:
W \ mathcal{W} 是允许推断的任何信息, 即一系列事实、 原理、 规则或关系 。
任务由 k\\\ 1 k\ geq 1 引号步骤解决, 将 q 连接到一个 , 其中每个步骤由 W\ mathcal{ W} 许可 。
因此, W\ mathcal{W} 诱导推理图 G= (N, E)\ mathcal{(\ mathcal{N},\\,\ mathcal{E}), 解法为路径 Q = q u 1... u k - 1 a\pi=q\, u_{ 1\ ldots u_{k-1}\,a in G\mathcal{G}. 7 7 7 这种联系根深蒂固,甚至连`multiphop ' 一词都引用了图结构的图像。 喜欢什么? 与几乎同义但更中性的术语“多步”推理相比。 据我们所知,两者之间没有定义上的区别。

blocks.en:
𝒲 \mathcal{W} need not surface 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , which may instead have to be inferred.
This matters because inferring 𝒢 \mathcal{G} and traversing it are separate problems, and only the latter is unique to multihop reasoning.
Either way, π \pi is latent, and finding it is what makes the task multihop.
Importantly, the topology is not known in advance. 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is determined by 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , which is arbitrary, so no topology can be built into a solution method, even when 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is given explicitly and its topology is readable at inference.
blocks.zh:
W\ mathcal{W} 不需要表面 G\ mathcal{G}, 而可能必须推断 。
这很重要,因为推断 G\ mathcal{G} 和翻转它都是不同的问题, 只有后者是多跳推理所特有的.
无论哪种方式,\\pi是潜伏的,找到它就是任务多跳。
重要的是,地形学并不事先知道。 G\ mathcal{G}是由W\mathcal{W}决定的,它具有任意性,因此无法将地形构建成一个解法,即使G\mathcal{G}被明确给出,其地形可以推论读取.

blocks.en:
Multihop question answering (QA) is an important special case.
Here, 𝒲 \mathcal{W} is a knowledge base 𝔎 = ( 𝔈 , ℜ ) \mathfrak{K}=(\mathfrak{E},\,\mathfrak{R}) of entities 𝔈 \mathfrak{E} and relations ℜ \mathfrak{R} , q q is a question, and a a is its answer. 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is then a knowledge graph, with entities as nodes and relations as edges. 8 8 8 Note that 𝒢 \mathcal{G} may be inferred or explicitly given in multihop QA as well. Many methods construct an explicit graph from text before reasoning over it ( de-cao-etal-2019-question ; ding-etal-2019-cognitive ; cheng-etal-2024-structure ) , while others search over a given knowledge graph directly ( sun2024think ) . Thus, whether 𝒲 \mathcal{W} surfaces 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is independent of whether the task is posed in natural language. The task is solved by finding a path π = ( n 0 , n 1 , … , n k ) \pi=(n_{0},\,n_{1},\,\ldots,\,n_{k}) in 𝒢 \mathcal{G} s.t. n 0 n_{0} corresponds to q q and n k n_{k} corresponds to a a .
blocks.zh:
Multihop问答(QA)是一个重要的特例.
这里, W\ mathcal{W} 是一个知识库 K= (E, R)\ mathfrak{K} (\ mathfrak{E},\,\ mathfrak{R} 实体 E\ mathfrak{E} 和关系 R\ mathfrak{R}, q q 是一个问题, 一个是它的答案 。 G\mathcal{G} 然后是一个知识图,以实体为节点,以关系为边缘. 8 8 注意 G\ mathcal{G} 也可以在 multip QA 中推断或明确给出 。 许多方法先从文本中构建一个清晰的图表,然后再对其进行推理(de-cao-etal-2019- question ; ding-etal-2019-cognitive ;cung-etal-2024-structure ) ,而其他方法则直接搜索给定的知识图(sun2024think ) . 因此, W\ mathcal{ W} 是否表面 G\ mathcal{ G} 独立于任务是否以自然语言设置 。 任务通过在 G\ mathcal{G} s.t. n. n. n. n. k. \ pi= (n_{0},\,n_{1},\,\ ldots,\,n_{k} 中找到路径 = (n 0, n 1,..., n k)\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\\\\ k\ k\ k\ k\ k\\ k\\ k\\\\ k\

blocks.en:
However, in multihop QA, the graph is often a single static dataset.
This leads to two distinct theoretical models. 𝒲 \mathcal{W} can either be supplied as many independent instances, which supports inference over an unobserved 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , or as a single fixed (partially) observed dataset to be learnt during training. 9 9 9 Again, this is regardless of whether 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is explicitly given or inferred. Call these the in-context and in-weights settings ( noroozizadeh2025deep ) . 10 10 10 Both settings require memory and differ only in where it resides. In-context, 𝒲 \mathcal{W} is held in the hidden states, and is thus transient and rebuilt for each instance. In-weights, 𝒲 \mathcal{W} is held in the parameters, i.e. parametric memory , and is thus persistent and shared across instances. Note that this is not LLM ‘in-context learning’. We do not apply an unseen task to a pretrained LLM; rather, we train small LMs from scratch.
They are related, as both must produce in-context representations to solve the task. In-context, 𝒲 \mathcal{W} varies across instances, so memorization is not viable and the model must compute over the provided context.
In-weights, 𝒲 \mathcal{W} is the same for every instance, so memorization is viable and, indeed, is necessary.
Note that the task definition is agnostic to this choice, as the split arises from how the learning problem is set up, i.e. what varies across the data and what is fixed.
Thus, the same definition yields two distinct theoretical models, each of which supports answering different questions ( C.4 ).
blocks.zh:
然而,在Multihop QA中,该图往往是单一的静态数据集.
这导致了两个截然不同的理论模型. W \ mathcal{ W} 可以提供很多独立实例, 支持对一个未观察的 W\ mathcal{ W} 的推论, 也可以提供在训练中学习的单个固定( 部分) 观察数据集 。 9 9 再说一遍,无论G\ mathcal{G}是明确给出的还是推断的。 将这些设置称为内饰和内重设置( noroozizadeh2025diep ). 10 10 两种设置都需要内存,仅在其居住地点有所不同. 文本中, W\ mathcal{W} 保存在隐藏的状态中, 因此是短暂的, 并为每个实例重建 。 在量子中,W\ mathcal{W}在参数中被持有,即参数内存,因此是持久性的,并在各个实例中共享. 请注意,这不是LLM ' in-context学习 ' 。 我们并不对经过预先训练的LLM进行无形的任务;相反,我们从零开始训练小型LMs。
它们是相互关联的,因为两者必须提出解决这项任务的内在说明。 in-context, W\ mathcal{W} 各个实例不同, 所以记忆是不可行的, 模型必须按所提供的上下文计算 。
重量级, W\ mathcal{W} 在每个实例中都是相同的, 因此记忆是可行的, 而且确实是必要的 。
注意任务定义对于这个选择是不可知的,因为分裂产生于学习问题的设置方式,即数据的不同和固定的.
因此,同一定义产生了两个不同的理论模型,每个模型都支持回答不同的问题(C.4)。

blocks.en: C.2 The Underlying Claims
blocks.zh: C.2 基本索赔

blocks.en:
Modelling multihop reasoning as graph search reduces to the following five claims. Claim 1. All multihop reasoning tasks induce a reasoning graph. Claim 2. All multihop reasoning tasks require traversal of the reasoning graph. 11 11 11 Claim 2 concerns what the task requires, not how the model achieves it.
A model may produce a a without composing at all, e.g. by exploiting a statistical correlation between q q and a a .
This is a shortcut, and is the failure mode we study.
Note that this differs from composing during training and storing the result, which we return to in C.4 . Claim 3. Search is a specific type of traversal often used in multihop reasoning. Claim 4. A theoretical model of multihop reasoning must apply to an arbitrary reasoning graph. Claim 5. Graph search is such a model.
blocks.zh:
将多跳推理建模为图表搜索,则减少到以下5项索赔。 1. 所有多跳推理任务都催生出一个推理图。 索赔 2. 所有多跳推理任务都要求对推理图进行翻转。 11 11 索赔2涉及任务要求,而不是模型如何实现。
一种模型可能会产生一种完全没有的组合,例如利用qq和a之间的统计关系。
这是一个捷径,是我们研究的失败模式。
请注意,这与培训和储存结果时的编组不同,我们回到C.4中。 索赔 3. 搜索是多跳推理中常用的一种特定的曲面类型. 索赔 4. 多跳推理的理论模型必须适用于任意推理图. 索赔 5. 图表搜索就是这样一种模式。

blocks.en: All multihop reasoning tasks induce a reasoning graph.
blocks.zh: 所有多跳推理任务都会诱导一个推理图.

blocks.en:
All multihop reasoning tasks require traversal of the reasoning graph. 11 11 11 Claim 2 concerns what the task requires, not how the model achieves it.
A model may produce a a without composing at all, e.g. by exploiting a statistical correlation between q q and a a .
This is a shortcut, and is the failure mode we study.
Note that this differs from composing during training and storing the result, which we return to in C.4 .
blocks.zh:
所有多跳推理任务都需要翻转推理图. 11 11 索赔2涉及任务需要什么,而不是模型如何实现.
一种模型可能会产生一种完全没有的组合,例如利用qq和a之间的统计关系。
这是一个捷径,是我们研究的失败模式。
请注意,这与培训和储存结果时的编组不同,我们回到C.4中。

blocks.en: Search is a specific type of traversal often used in multihop reasoning.
blocks.zh: 搜索(Search)是Multihop推理中常用的一种特定的曲面类型.

blocks.en: A theoretical model of multihop reasoning must apply to an arbitrary reasoning graph.
blocks.zh: 多跳推理的理论模型必须适用于任意推理图.

blocks.en: Graph search is such a model.
blocks.zh: 图表搜索就是这样的模式。

blocks.en:
We use the term ‘claim’ to unify these five ideas, as they are not of the same kind.
Claims 1 and 2 hold by construction from the definition ( C.1 ).
Claim 3 is definitional, and that search is often used is established by the literature.
Claim 4 is a modelling assumption; one could instead want a restricted model, whereas we require generality because 𝒲 \mathcal{W} is arbitrary.
Claim 5 is the resulting theoretical choice, and follows from search assuming no structure in 𝒢 \mathcal{G} while isolating the behaviour we study.
blocks.zh:
我们使用`要求 ' 一词来统一这五个想法,因为它们不是同一种。
根据定义,索赔1和2按建筑施工(C.1)。
主张3是定义性的,而搜索经常被文献所确定.
索赔4是一种建模假设;相反,人们可能想要一种限制性模型,而我们则需要概括性,因为W\mathcal{W}是任意的。
第5项要求是由此而产生的理论选择,它源于假定G\mathcal{G}中无结构的搜索,同时隔离我们研究的行为。

blocks.en:
To our knowledge, no prior work explicitly states all five claims.
However, there is a long history of prior work which assumes one or more of them, and we justify the claims by establishing their prior use.
Because multihop reasoning and graph search are very broad areas, these claims are often not the focus of -- or even stated in -- prior work, and thus must be inferred from their methods. 12 12 12 This is not a comprehensive survey, and even wider claims, such that all of general problem solving can be modelled as graph search, go back to the dawn of AI ( newell1972human ; newell2007computer ) .
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,以前没有一项工作明确说明所有这五项要求。
然而,过去的工作历史悠久,假定其中一种或多种,我们通过证明这些要求的事先用途来证明这些要求的合理性。
由于多跳推理和图搜索是非常广泛的领域,这些说法往往不是前作的重点,甚至没有在作品中说明,因此必须从其方法中推断. 12 12 这不是一个全面的调查,甚至更宽泛的说法,以至于所有一般问题解决都可以作为图搜索的模式,追溯到AI的黎明(Newell1972human;Newell2007 computer ).

blocks.en: C.2.1 Claims 1, 2, and 3

Claims 1, 2, and 3 are highly coupled, and prior work generally supports them together.
As noted, the quantifiers in Claims 1 and 2 are by construction, so prior work serves to establish coverage, i.e. specific cases where multihop reasoning induces a reasoning graph or requires traversal.
Claim 3 follows from elementary graph search algorithms, and prior work establishes that this also holds in the multihop context.
blocks.zh:
第1、第2和第3项索赔密切相关,以前的工作一般都支持它们。
如前所述,索赔1和2中的限定词是通过施工确定的,因此,先前的工作有助于确定涵盖范围,即多跳推理引致推理图或需要转录的具体案例。
第3项索赔来自基本图表搜索算法,先前的工作证实,这在多跳语境中也存在。

blocks.en:
For Claim 1, the reasoning graph is often implicit.
However, it can also be explicit, and appears under various names such as a ‘knowledge graph’, ‘knowledge base’, or ‘entity graph’.
Prior work which constructs an explicit graph from implicit information provides evidence for the existence of an underlying reasoning graph.
Works which support Claims 1 through 3 fall into three groups: those which construct an explicit graph from unstructured text, those which surface reasoning structure at inference time, and those which search over a given graph directly.
blocks.zh:
对于索赔1,推理图常常是隐含的。
然而,它也可以是明确的,并且以各种名称出现,如“知识图表”、“知识基础”或“实体图表”。
从隐含信息中构建一个明确图表的前期工作为存在一个基本推理图提供了证据。
支持索赔1至3的工程分为三组:用结构不整齐的文字构建明确图表的工程、在推断时表面推理结构的工程和直接搜索某一图表的工程。

blocks.en:
Constructing an explicit reasoning graph. yang-etal-2018-hotpotqa introduced one of the earliest multihop question-answering datasets for LLMs.
They explicitly constructed their dataset as a graph in which edges represent Wikipedia hyperlinks and nodes are the first paragraph of each article (Claim 1).
They studied question answering, which they framed as a search on the reasoning graph (Claim 2).
They also demonstrated that different kinds of questions induce different types of multihop reasoning tasks; however, traversal or search is a necessary subroutine in each of these (Claims 2 and 3).
blocks.zh:
构建一个明确的推理图. yang-etal-2018-hotpotqa引入了LLMs最早的多跳问答数据集之一.
他们明确地将数据集构建为图表,其中边缘代表维基百科超链接,节点是每篇文章的第一段(Claim 1).
他们研究了回答问题,并把它描述为对推理图的搜索(索赔2)。
他们还表明,不同类型的问题会引发不同类型的多跳推理任务;然而,逆向或搜索是每一类中必要的子程序(索赔2和3)。

blocks.en:
de-cao-etal-2019-question framed multihop question answering as ‘an inference problem over a graph’, i.e. search over a graph (Claim 3).
To support this, they converted text to an explicit graph, with nodes representing named entities and edges as relations between them (Claim 1).
Similarly, ding-etal-2019-cognitive constructs and searches over a ‘cognitive’ graph (Claims 1 and 2).
blocks.zh:
de-cao-etal-2019- question将Multihop问题作为“一个图表的推论问题”回答,即一个图表的搜索(索赔3)。
为了支持这一点,他们将文本转换成一个明确的图表,以代表被命名实体和边缘的节点作为它们之间的关系(索赔1)。
同样,ding-etal-2019的认知构造和搜索也用一个 " 认知 " 图表进行(索赔1和2)。

blocks.en:
sun-etal-2018-open used text to augment missing gaps in a knowledge base, demonstrating that the graph can mix both explicit (knowledge base) and implicit (inferred from text) graph structures (Claim 1).
They also plainly stated the relation that multihop question answering has to graph traversal: ‘many questions require multi-hop reasoning, which follows a path from a seed node mentioned in the question to the target answer node’ (Claim 2).
Note that Claim 3 can also be inferred from this, if finding the path is non-trivial.
blocks.zh:
Sun-etal-2018-open使用文本来扩大知识库中缺失的空白,表明该图既可以混合显性(知识基础),也可以混合隐性(从文本中推导)图表结构(索赔1)。
他们还明确指出,Multihop问题回答必须用图解答: " 许多问题需要Multi-hop推理,从问题中提到的种子节点到目标答案节点的路径。
请注意,如果找到路径是非部落性的,也可从中推断出索赔3。

blocks.en:
Further evidence for Claims 1, 2, and 3 similar to the above works can be found in ( das2018go ; lin-etal-2018-multi ; sun-etal-2019-pullnet ; saxena-etal-2020-improving ; luo2024reasoning ; han-etal-2025-reasoning ; yang-etal-2025-large ) .
Also consider cheng-etal-2024-structure , who developed a method which ‘explicitly converts unstructured text into a graph via LLMs and instructs them to navigate this graph using task-specific strategies to formulate responses’ specifically for multihop tasks.
blocks.zh:
与上述工作类似的第1、2、3项索赔的进一步证据可见于(das2018go;lin-etal-2018-multime;sun-etal-2019-pulnet;saxena-etal-2020-改进;luo2024解释;han-etal-2025-解释;yang-etal-2025-problem).
也考虑Cung-etal-2024架构, 他开发了一种方法, “通过 LLMs 将无结构文本明确转换成图表,

blocks.en:
Surfacing the reasoning graph at inference time. Not only have these claims been observed in the literature since the dawn of the LLM age, but Claims 1 and 2 are implied by the most ubiquitous method employed for solving multihop reasoning tasks with LLMs: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) ( wei2022chain ) .
CoT combines prompting with test-time compute.
The CoT chain generates a reasoning path.
Thus, CoT explicitly surfaces an underlying latent path in the latent graph, which assumes such a graph exists (Claim 1) and that traversal is required (Claim 2).
Follow-up work extended this by surfacing more complex structures such as trees and full graphs ( yao2023tree ; besta2024graph ; jin-etal-2024-graph ; wen-etal-2024-mindmap , Claims 1 and 2) .
These structures require search to traverse (Claim 3), leading to the direct incorporation of actual search algorithms such as breadth- or depth-first search (BFS or DFS) into the inference procedure ( yao2023tree ) . han-etal-2025-reasoning considered prompting an LLM to explicitly generate a fine-grained graph over which reasoning is then conducted, and compared this to CoT, ToT, and GoT for various multihop reasoning tasks, including search (Claims 1, 2, and 3).
blocks.zh:
推论时冲出推理图. 自LLM时代开始以来,这些主张不仅在文献中被观察到,而且第1和第2项主张被最普遍的方法所暗示,即用LLMs: Chain-of-Thought (CoT)(wei2022chain )来解决多跳推理任务。
COT结合了提示和测试时间计算.
COT链生成推理路径.
因此,COT在暗图中明确显示一条潜在的路径,假定存在这种路径(索赔1),并且需要逆行(索赔2)。
后续工作通过铺设更复杂的结构,如树木和全图(yao2023tree;besta2024graph;jin-etal-2024-graph;wen-etal-2024-mindmap,Claim 1 and 2)来扩展这一点。
这些结构需要搜索进行转录(索赔3),从而直接将实际搜索算法,如广度或深度第一搜索(BFS或DFS)纳入推论程序(yao2023tree ). han-etal-2025-推理被认为促使LLM明确生成一个精细的图表,然后进行推理,并与CoT、TOT和GOT进行比较,以完成各种多跳推理任务,包括搜索(索赔1、2和3)。

blocks.en:
Searching over a given graph. sun2024think introduced ‘think-on-graph’, which treats an LLM as an agent that searches over an explicit knowledge graph for multihop reasoning.
They motivated this by identifying that other methods which use a knowledge graph do not search over the graph directly but rather retrieve information from the graph, which is then incorporated into the prompt context.
This converts the graph to a different format which is easier to incorporate into an LLM.
However, by doing this, the LLM is then forced to perform search over a latent sub-graph, thus inducing a ‘loose coupling’ with the original explicit graph.
To solve this, their method forces the model to perform beam search over the explicit knowledge graph using test-time compute.
This work thus addresses how the reasoning graph can be treated as implicit or explicit, and the relation of search to reasoning (Claims 1, 2, and 3).
blocks.zh:
搜索一个给定的图表。 Sun2024think引入了“用图思考”,
他们之所以这样做,是因为确定使用知识图的其他方法并不直接在图上搜索,而是从图上检索信息,然后将信息纳入及时的背景。
这样可以将图表转换成另一种格式,更容易纳入LLM。
然而,通过这样做,LLM就被迫在一个潜伏的子图上进行搜索,从而诱导了与原始的显式图的`loose 耦合 ' 。
为了解决这个问题,他们的方法迫使模型使用测试时间计算在显式知识图上进行光束搜索.
因此,这项工作涉及如何将推理图视为隐含或明示,以及搜索与推理的关系(索赔1、2和3)。

blocks.en: C.2.2 Claims 4 and 5
blocks.zh: C.2.2 第4和第5项索赔

blocks.en:
Not all multihop reasoning tasks are framed as search tasks.
For example, arithmetic, aggregation, and analogical reasoning all require multihop reasoning but not ‘search’.
However, solving each of these requires traversing the reasoning graph (this is why Claims 2 and 3 are separate).
An arithmetic expression induces a chain or tree of operations, given by the expression itself, and aggregation induces a set of nodes sharing a relation.
This structure is known in advance, and can thus be built into a solution method as an inductive bias.
Search assumes no such structure.
blocks.zh:
并非所有的多跳推理任务都被设定为搜索任务 。
例如,算术、聚合和模拟推理都要求多跳推理,而不是“搜索”.
然而,解决每一项问题都需要翻转推理图(这就是为什么索赔2和3是分开的)。
一个算术表达式会诱导一个链条或一棵由表达式本身给出的操作树,聚合诱导一组节点共享一个关系.
这种结构是事先已知的,因此可以作为一种诱导偏差被构建成一种溶液方法.
搜索假设没有这样的结构 。

blocks.en:
Claim 4 largely follows from the definition, as 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is determined by 𝒲 \mathcal{W} and 𝒲 \mathcal{W} is arbitrary ( C.1 ).
It is a modelling assumption rather than a corollary because a restricted model is a legitimate thing to want, e.g. one covering only the structures induced by a particular class of questions.
We require generality, as we are modelling multihop reasoning rather than a subclass of it. cheng-etal-2024-structure make the diversity explicit, acknowledging ‘the diversity of queries and their corresponding graph structures’, and categorizing reasoning tasks such that each ‘is aligned with a unique graph structure’, including graph sorting, graph querying, and logical inference.
blocks.zh:
索赔4主要按照定义,因为G\ mathcal{G}是由W\mathcal{W}确定的,W\mathcal{W}是任意的(C.1)。
这是一种建模假设,而不是必然结果,因为一个受限制的模型是人们想要的合法事物,例如只涵盖某一类问题引起的结构。
我们需要概括性,因为我们是模拟多跳推理,而不是它的一个子类。 Cung-etal-2024-架构明确了多样性,承认`查询及其对应的图表结构的多样性',并对推理任务进行分类,使每个`与独特的图表结构一致',包括图表排序、图表查询和逻辑推论。

blocks.en:
Claim 4 is uncontroversial, but can be violated in practice.
The path-star literature illustrates this danger, as the topology admits solutions which exploit it and do not generalize. The reverse ‘solution’, which requires no multihop reasoning is the prime example ( bachmann2024the ) , but other non-generalizable solutions exist as well ( frydenlund-2024-mystery ) .
Thus, results obtained under one topology need not hold under another.
A theoretical model which assumed a topology would then describe that topology rather than multihop reasoning in general.
blocks.zh:
主张4没有争议,但实际上可以违反.
路径星文学说明了这种危险,因为地形学承认了利用这种危险而不加以概括的解决办法。 反之的“解决方案”不需要多跳推理,
因此,在一个地形学下取得的结果不必被另一个地形所控制。
一个假设地形学的理论模型将描述这种地形学而不是一般的多跳推理。

blocks.en:
Claim 4 gives rise to Claim 5.
Search assumes no topology, and is thus defined for an arbitrary reasoning graph.
Importantly, search enables this while also allowing us to isolate the behaviour we want to study.
This is because search depends only on the structure of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} ; to find π \pi , we need to know which nodes connect to which, and nothing about what any node means.
We can thus define the task as a multihop traversal over a structural description of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , without retrieval, entity resolution, or language generation.
blocks.zh:
第4项索赔引起第5项索赔。
搜索假设没有地形学,因此被定义为任意推理图.
重要的是,搜索能够实现这一点,同时也使我们能够孤立我们想要研究的行为。
这是因为搜索只取决于 G\ mathcal{ G} 的结构; 要找到 \\\ pi, 我们需要知道哪个节点连接到哪个节点, 而没有任何节点的含义 。
因此,我们可以将任务定义为跨 G\ mathcal{G} 结构描述的 multip traversal , 而无需检索、 实体解析或语言生成 。

blocks.en:
This provides a clean window into how models learn structural reasoning, i.e. whether the model learns to traverse 𝒢 \mathcal{G} .
Consider a search task defined with and without isolating structural traversal from these other aspects.
If a model does better with them, the gain cannot have come from traversal, as traversal is what we isolated.
Thus, it came from bypassing traversal, i.e. a shortcut.
If a model does worse, then the added aspects are the cause, and they are worth studying on their own.
Thus either case justifies isolating traversal. Note that this justifies isolation, but this doesn’t imply that
traversal does not interact with these other aspects. However, such interactions should be studied under a separate theoretical model, which we will discuss in C.4 .
blocks.zh:
这为模型学习结构推理提供了干净的窗口,即模型是否学习过G\ mathcal{G}.
考虑确定一项搜索任务,同时不将结构横贯于这些其他方面。
如果一个模型比他们更好的, 收益不可能来自逆流, 因为逆流是我们孤立的。
因此,它来自绕行,即捷径。
如果一个模型做得更糟,那么附加的方面就是原因,它们值得自己研究.
因此,无论哪种情况,都有理由孤立曲折。 需要注意的是,
过渡性不与这些其他方面相互作用。 然而,这种相互作用应在一个单独的理论模式下加以研究,我们将在C.4中讨论。

blocks.en:
The works above used graphs as a practical model in order to develop methods.
Graph search has also been used as a theoretical model.
blocks.zh:
上面的作品将图表作为实用模型,以开发方法.
图表搜索也被用作理论模型.

blocks.en:
saparov2025transformers stated this most directly.
They noted that search ‘is the backbone of many reasoning problems as it is equivalent to proof search in a simplified logic which is a subset of almost any logic’.
Thus, ‘the model must solve this task if there is any chance to generalize to more complex search and reasoning tasks’.
blocks.zh:
萨帕罗夫2025译者最直接地指出这一点.
他们指出,搜索`是许多推理问题的主干,因为它等同于简化逻辑中的证据搜索,而简化逻辑几乎是任何逻辑的一个子集'。
因此,`如果有机会概括为更为复杂的搜索和推理任务,模型必须解决这项任务'。

blocks.en:
bachmann2024the designed the path-star task as ‘a minimal setting that captures the core essence of what it means to solve problems with lookahead, without irrelevant confounding factors’.
They expected their failure result to extend to more general tasks such as story telling.
blocks.zh:
Bachmann2024设计了路径星任务,作为`一个最低限度的设定,它抓住了解决望头星问题的核心本质,没有无关的困惑因素'。
他们预计,他们的失败结果将扩大到诸如讲故事等更一般性的任务。

blocks.en:
khona2024toward framed their setup in order ‘to design and study an abstraction which enables a precise understanding of stepwise inference in Transformers’.
They argued that ‘tasks which see maximum benefit from stepwise inference can be cast as a graph navigation problem’, and gave examples such as the Tower of Hanoi.
blocks.zh:
Khona2024toward设计了它们的设置,以便`设计和研究一个抽象的概念,从而能够准确理解变形器的逐步推论'。
他们认为,`认为从逐步推论中获得最大好处的任务可以被作为图导航问题提出',并举出河内塔等例子。

blocks.en:
Note that prior work often considered graph search under the name planning ( bachmann2024the ; khona2024toward ) .
This speaks to the task being achieved latently across layers.
Planning requires committing to a path before acting on it, so if, instead, a model is allowed to act and revise that action, it is no longer a planning problem.
blocks.zh:
注意先前的工作常考虑在名称规划(bachmann2024the;khona2024toward )下进行图表搜索.
这说明正在各级潜在地完成的任务。
规划需要在采取行动之前走上一条道路,因此,如果允许一个模式采取行动并修改这一行动,就不再是一个规划问题。

blocks.en:
cohen2025spectral motivated the controlled setting, and chose graph search to instantiate it.
They noted there was no ‘quantitative, verifiable definition of planning or reasoning’, and that benchmarks ‘cannot distinguish “true reasoning/planning” from pattern matching or retrieval due to web-scale training and possible data contamination’.
Their solution was to ‘study language model internal dynamics in settings with carefully controlled, structured data’, using graph connectivity.
Similarly, sanford2024understanding asked ‘how can we analyze reasoning capabilities of neural networks?’ and answered that ‘one approach is to study algorithms executable with their internal representation’.
blocks.zh:
Cohen2025光谱激发了受控的设置,并选择了图搜索以即时化.
他们指出,没有`规划或推理的量化、可核查的定义 ' ,而且由于网络规模培训和可能的数据污染,基准`无法区分`真正的推理/规划'与模式匹配或检索 ' 。
其解决办法是利用图表的连通性, " 在有精心控制、结构化数据的环境下研究语言模型内部动态 " 。
类似地,Sanford2024 理解问到 : “ 我们如何分析神经网络的推理能力? ” , 并回答 : “ 一种方法是研究可以用其内部代表来执行的算法。 ”

blocks.en: Finally, Claim 5 concerns the theoretical model, and thus holds for both settings. noroozizadeh2025deep adopted the same model in-weights, describing path-finding on path-star graphs as ‘a (symbolic) implicit reasoning task’.
blocks.zh: 最后,索赔5涉及理论模式,因此适用于这两种情况。 noroozizadeh2025deep采用了相同的型号的重量级,将路径-星图上的路径搜索描述为`a(符号)隐含推理任务'.

blocks.en:
Importantly, while these works used graph search as a theoretical model, they did not formally specify it, leaving the underlying claims to be inferred.
This is why we state them here. Making the commitments explicit allows them to be discussed or rejected rather than left implicit.
Thus, future work can state which claims it adopts, and which it does not.
blocks.zh:
重要的是,虽然这些作品将图表搜索作为一种理论模型,但并未正式加以说明,因此只能推断所依据的索赔。
这就是为什么我们在这里说。 作出明确承诺,就可以讨论或拒绝这些承诺,而不是留有隐性。
因此,今后的工作可以说明它采取了何种主张,而它没有。

blocks.en: C.3 Our Instantiation
blocks.zh: C.3 我们的证据

blocks.en:
The claims above establish graph search as the theoretical model, i.e. they justify that this is the thing to study.
We now consider the assumptions we make when instantiating that model in practice.
That is, we still need an experimental setup which forces the model to solve the task by traversal alone. Importantly, each assumption is made because it prevents alternative ways to produce a correct answer without traversing. These assumptions are separate from the claims, as one can adopt the theoretical model but reject the instantiation. Importantly, these assumptions are not made to make the task easier to learn. Indeed, most restrict how the model must learn to solve the task by avoiding ‘solutions’ which do not require multihop reasoning or search.
blocks.zh:
上述主张将图表搜索确立为理论模型,即它们证明这是需要研究的事情。
我们现在考虑我们在实际中即时利用这一模式时所作的假设。
也就是说,我们仍然需要一个实验性设置, 迫使模型独自通过转弯来解决任务。 重要的是,每个假设都是因为无法以其他方式提出正确的答案而不发生逆转。 这些假设与主张是分开的,因为人们可以采用理论模型,但拒绝即时论. 重要的是,这些假设并不是为了使任务更容易学习。 事实上,多数人限制模型必须学会如何通过避免不需要多跳推理或搜索的“解决方案”来解决任务。

blocks.en:
Assumption 1: traversal is latent. We exclude chain-of-thought, scratchpads, and test-time search, so that the traversal occurs within the forward pass in a single step. bachmann2024the give the argument for why search on path-star graphs must be latent.
The first emitted token commits to an arm, so the target must already have been located before generation begins, and the search cannot be spread across the generated sequence. 13 13 13 This, and the fact that there are alternative potential paths, makes it a planning task.
blocks.zh:
假设1: 转动是潜在的。 我们排除了思维链,抓盘, 和测试时间的搜索, 这样,转盘在前方的通道内发生 一步。 Bachmann2024给出了为什么在路径星图上搜索必须是潜伏的论据.
第一个发射的信号承诺给一个手臂,所以目标必须在开始生成前就已经找到,而且搜索不能分散到生成的序列中。 13 13 以及存在其他潜在路径的事实,使其成为一项规划任务。

blocks.en:
By enforcing that the model performs a latent computation of the path, we prevent a solution via enumeration.
When test-time compute is permitted, the model easily learns the one-hop adjacency and then walks from the start node until it reaches the target. The walk is not quite Markovian, as the model learns not to repeat paths it has already produced, and we never train it to do this.
This finds a path without performing multihop reasoning. khona2024toward observed the same ordering in a setting which permitted test-time compute, where their models first learned to avoid generating edges that do not exist in the graph, and only later learned to reach the goal node.
blocks.zh:
通过强制要求模型对路径进行潜在的计算,我们通过点数来阻止解决方案.
当测试时间计算被允许时,模型很容易学习到一跳的附位,然后从起始节点走到到达目标. 步行并不是马可维亚式的,因为模型学会了不重复它已经产生的路径,我们从不训练它这样做.
找到一条不进行多跳推理的路径 。 khona2024toward在允许测试时间计算的环境中观察到同样的命令,他们的模型首先学会避免产生图中不存在的边缘,后来才学会达到目标节点.

blocks.en:
Test-time compute admits a second kind of solution.
Here the model does perform multihop reasoning, but it does so over a known structure. An example of this is using a BFS scratchpad reduces the search state to a linear chain which the model then follows via a multihop traversal.
As such, it cannot model multihop reasoning in general (Claim 4).
We demonstrate that a BFS scratchpad does this, thus breaking the theoretical model (and that it does not scale, making it an impractical ‘solution’ to boot; L.3 , L.4 ).
blocks.zh:
测试时间计算承认第二种解决方案.
这里的模型确实进行多跳推理,但通过已知的结构进行. 一个例子是使用一个 BFS 抓图将搜索状态降低为线性链,然后模型通过多跳的转盘跟踪。
因此,它不能在一般情况下模拟多跳推理(索赔4)。
我们证明,BFS抓刀会这样做,从而打破了理论模型(而且它没有规模化,使它成为一个不切实际的`解决 ' ;L.3,L.4)。

blocks.en:
Both solutions need test-time compute.
Thus, we disallow it and thus require a latent solution.
blocks.zh:
这两个解决方案都需要测试时间计算.
因此,我们反对,因此需要一种潜在的解决办法。

blocks.en:
Assumption 2: the target is a shortest path. We could instead ask for reachability, connectivity, or any path from s s to t t .
The problem is that these do not constrain the length of the output.
The model can then backtrack and wander, and the generated path itself provides test-time compute.
This thus allows for the enumeration solution above, where the walk is the generation.
Requiring a shortest path fixes the output length, thus preventing such a solution.
The model must instead compare the alternatives at each choice node, and it is this which makes the task a search.
blocks.zh:
假设2:目标是最短的路径. 我们可以要求达到可达性、连通性,
问题在于这些不会限制产出的长度.
模型随后可以回溯和漫游,生成的路径本身提供测试时间计算.
因此,在行走是一代人的地方,可以进行上面的查点。
需要一条最短的路径来固定输出长度,从而阻止这样的解决方案.
相反,模型必须比较每个选择节点的替代品,正是这个模式使得任务成为了搜索.

blocks.en:
Assumption 3: the edge list is shuffled. The edges are presented in a random order (§ 1.1 ).
If the order is allowed to carry information, then the edges can be listed in breadth-first order from s s ( ge-etal-2025-graph ) .
This gives the same structural reduction as the scratchpad above, except that it is supplied in the input rather than generated.
Randomizing the order prevents any such ordering. ge-etal-2025-graph compared BFS, DFS, and PageRank edge orderings against a shuffled list, and found BFS ordering improved shortest-path accuracy by 70.1%. yuan2024gracore similarly found that sequentially ordering node names outperformed random ordering, with the largest gains on path reasoning.
blocks.zh:
假设3:边缘列表被洗牌. 边缘按随机排列(§1.1).
如果命令被允许携带信息,那么边缘可以按照s(ge-etal-2025-graph)的宽度第一顺序列出.
这使得其结构与上面的抓图一样的减少,只是它是由输入而不是生成的.
随机命令可以阻止任何这样的命令. Ge-etal-2025-graph比较了BFS、DFS和PageRank边缘对洗牌列表的订购,发现BFS订购改进的最短路径精度为70.1%。 人民币2024Gracore同样发现,按顺序排列的节点名称比随机排列要好,在路径推理上收获最大.

blocks.en:
Assumption 4: nodes are semanticless. Node identifiers carry no relationship to one another, which prevents semantic and homophily shortcuts ( huang2024can ; mcpherson2001birds ; xu2025when ; guan2025attention ) .
One could retain semantics and audit each shortcut as it arises, but the set of possible shortcuts is not known in advance, whereas removing semantics guarantees their absence.
Without doing this, then producing a correct answer would not be direct evidence that a k k -hop traversal was performed.
Semantic relations between nodes allow the answer to be produced by other means, so accuracy no longer measures the behaviour we wish to study.
Removing semantics restores the correspondence, as the only information available is the structure given in the prefix.
Semanticless nodes require relabelling, since no natural corpus is semanticless.
One could relabel a natural graph and preserve its topology, but Assumption 5 requires a fresh graph for every instance, which a fixed corpus does not supply.
Synthetic data is therefore not an independent choice but a consequence of these two assumptions ( D.2 ).
blocks.zh:
假设4:节点是无语义的. 节点标识符相互之间没有关系,这可以防止语义和同源快捷键(huang2024can; mcpherson2001 birds; xu2025 when ; guan2025 attention ) .
人们可以保留语义学,并在出现时对每一个快捷键进行审计,但一套可能的快捷键是事先不知道的,而删除语义则保证它们不存在.
如果不这样做,那么得出正确的答案就不会是进行k-hop traversal的直接证据。
节点之间的语义关系允许通过其他方式生成答案,因此准确性不再衡量我们希望研究的行为.
删除语义可以恢复函文,因为唯一可用的信息是前缀给出的结构.
无语义节点需要重新贴标签,因为没有任何自然体是无语义的.
人们可以重新贴上自然图的标签并保存其地形,但假设5要求每个实例都有一个新的图,而固定体不能提供。
因此,合成数据不是独立的选择,而是这两个假设的结果(D.2)。

blocks.en:
Assumption 5: training instances are unique. Uniqueness addresses two separate problems, which arise at two different scales.
The first is an alternative solution, in-weights storage, where a fixed graph, or a small set of them, lets the model store the structure in its weights.
Either the answer is recalled outright, or the k k -hop composition is amortized over training, and the forward pass reduces to a lookup of its result.
Amortization requires a fixed graph, since the cost is paid once and reused across instances ( C.4 ).
Thus, this leaves the forward pass as the only place the traversal can occur, which is the object of our study.
The second is a learning problem.
A large but finite set of graphs is past the in-weights regime, but repeated subgraphs give spurious correlations ( frydenlund-2024-mystery ; wang2023can ) .
Generating every instance uniquely removes both, leaving the forward pass as the only place the traversal can occur.
blocks.zh:
假设5:培训是独特的。 独特性解决了两个不同的问题,这些问题在两个不同的尺度上出现.
第一种是替代溶液,内重存储,其中固定的图,或一组小的图,让模型将结构存储在重量中.
要么直接召回答案,要么在训练中摊还kk-hop成分,前传则减少对结果的期待。
摊销需要固定的图表,因为费用一次性支付,并跨例重复使用(C.4)。
因此,这留下了前进的路口,作为转弯的唯一地点,这是我们研究的目标。
第二是学习问题。
大量但有限的图集已经过了体重不足制度,但重复的子图给出了虚假的关联(frienddenlund-2024-mystery ;wang2023can ).
产生每一个实例都独具一格地消除了两者,留下前传作为转录唯一可能发生的地方.

blocks.en:
The last two assumptions are of a different kind from the first three.
Assumptions 1 to 3 would be adopted by anyone asking our question, whereas Assumptions 4 and 5 are specific to it.
Semantics and memorization are not confounds in general, and there are questions for which they are the object of study rather than something to be removed.
Dropping Assumption 5 gives rise to the in-weights setting, which we describe next ( C.4 ).
Assumption 4 is an independent choice within that setting, and multihop question answering drops both.
blocks.zh:
最后两个假设与前三个假设不同。
任何提出我们问题的人都会采用第1至第3条假设,而第4和第5条假设则是具体的。
语义学和记忆学一般不是混杂的,有些问题它们成为研究的对象,而不是被移除的东西.
Dropping Assumption 5 引发了负重设定,我们接下来对此进行描述(C.4 ).
假设 4 是一个独立选择 在该设置中, 和多跳问题回答同时下降。

blocks.en: C.4 The In-Weights Model
blocks.zh: C.4 内重模型

blocks.en:
Assumptions 4 and 5 are the ones most likely to give pause.
Recall that multihop question answering is the special case in which 𝒲 \mathcal{W} is a knowledge base, 𝔎 = ( 𝔈 , ℜ ) \mathfrak{K}=(\mathfrak{E},\,\mathfrak{R}) , so that the nodes of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} are entities and its edges are relations ( C.1 ).
Both assumptions are violated there.
Entities carry meaning and stand in relation to one another, and 𝔎 \mathfrak{K} is fixed and seen many times over training rather than generated anew for each question.
Thus, these two assumptions rule out the most ubiquitous multihop reasoning task in NLP.
blocks.zh:
假设4和5是最有可能暂停的。
回顾多跳问答是W\mathcal{W}是一个知识库的特殊情况,K=(E,R)\mathfrak{K}(\mathfrak{E},\,\mathfrak{R}),因此G\mathcal{G}的节点是实体,其边缘是关系(C.1).
这两个假设都在那里遭到违反。
K\mathfrak{K}在训练上被固定和多次看到,而不是为每个问题重新产生。
因此,这两个假设排除了NLP中最无处不在的多跳推理任务.

blocks.en:
The two settings support different questions.
We ask whether a model can learn to perform multihop traversal without memorization.
The in-weights setting asks how a model learns when memorization is allowed.
Importantly, the two settings have very different learning dynamics.
blocks.zh:
这两个设置支持不同的问题.
我们问一个模型是否能够学会在不记事的情况下 进行多跳曲。
体重不足的设定 问模型在允许记忆时如何学习.
重要的是,这两种环境的学习动态非常不同。

blocks.en:
noroozizadeh2025deep demonstrated how much this change matters.
They studied the path-star task with the graph held in the weights and learnt over training, rather than supplied in the context.
Importantly, theirs is a controlled study, and it is controlled in the same way ours is, so the only substantive difference is whether 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is supplied in the context or held in the weights.
The paths had a fixed length, so there is no MMHT. The train and test paths are disjoint, so they evaluate on held-out paths (though every edge was seen during training).
Whereas the original in-context task is unlearnable with NTP and without MMHT on small graphs, they easily scaled to massive graphs of up to 5 × 10 4 5\times 10^{4} nodes with k k of 6 to 10.
Thus, the task is the same and the controls are the same, so only the setting can account for this difference in results, which implies different learning dynamics.
blocks.zh:
noroozizadeh 2025 diep 证明了这一变化的重要性。
他们用加权图研究路径星任务,从培训中吸取教训,而不是在背景中提供。
重要的是,他们的研究是可控的,它被控制的方式与我们一样,所以唯一的实质性区别是G\mathcal{G}是在上下文中提供还是在重量中持有.
路径有固定长度,所以没有MMHT. 列车和测试路径是脱节的,因此他们在被搁置的路径上进行评估(尽管在训练中看到了每一个边缘).
虽然原始的内装式任务与NTP是不可学习的,在小图上没有MMHT,但是它们很容易缩放成高达5×10 4 5\times 10^{4}以k k为6到10的结点的大图.
因此,任务是相同的,控制是相同的,因此只有环境才能说明结果的这种差异,这意味着不同的学习动态.

blocks.en:
They attribute this to how the graph is stored.
The model organizes the node embeddings so that their geometry reflects the multihop structure of the graph.
This geometry arises from training on the individual edges alone, with no path supervision whatsoever.
Importantly, the multihop aspect of the task then collapses to a lookup at inference.
The composition still happens, but it is amortized over training rather than performed at inference.
This matters because multihop reasoning is generally taken to be a traversal performed at inference, and not the learning of compositional facts.
Thus, dropping Assumption 5 does not relax our setting, rather, it replaces it.
blocks.zh:
他们将此归因于图的存储方式.
模型组织节点嵌入,使其几何结构反映图的多跳结构.
这种几何学是单靠个别边缘的训练,没有任何路径监督.
重要的是,任务中的多跳部分随后倒向了一种推论。
组成情况仍然在发生,但因培训而摊销,而不是推论。
这一点很重要,因为多跳推理一般被认为是在推论中演绎的反演,而不是对组成事实的学习.
因此,放弃假设5并不能放松我们的设置,而是取代了它。

blocks.en:
The in-weights setting does not merely make traversal easier, it can remove the need for it.
This is counterintuitive given how the setting is generally studied.
Work on multihop QA holds the knowledge base in the weights, yet asks whether the model traverses it at inference, such as by locating a bridge entity within the forward pass ( yang-etal-2025-large ; balesni2024lessons ) .
Traversal is assumed to be the thing which is learnt, and a failure is read as an inability to compose.
However, the setting itself admits a solution in which no traversal occurs at inference, which is the remarkable finding of noroozizadeh2025deep .
A failure may then indicate that the structure was not stored, rather than that the model cannot traverse it.
Thus, an in-weights result may be about how structure is stored rather than about multihop reasoning as it is usually meant.
blocks.zh:
体重不足的设定不仅使转弯更加容易,而且能够消除对它的需求。
鉴于设置一般如何研究,这是反直觉的。
Multihop QA的工作在权重中占据了知识基础,然而却问模型是否在推论中经过它,比如在前方通道内定位一个桥体(yang-etal-2025-great;balesni2024lessons).
特拉弗萨尔被假定是学到的东西,失败被解读为无法作曲.
然而,环境本身也承认了一个无法推论的解决方案,这就是Noroozizadeh2025deep的显著发现。
如果失败,则可能表明该结构没有储存,而不是该模型无法穿过。
因此,不加权的结果可能是结构是如何存储的,而不是通常意义上的多跳推理.

blocks.en:
The two settings are therefore not variants of a single model, they are different models.
Which of the two a result is about determines what that result can be taken to show.
We strongly support noroozizadeh2025deep ’s emphasis on this point, where they wrote that ‘a takeaway from [their] work is to be deliberate not to conflate insights from the in-context setting with that of the in-weights setting (a distinction that is rarely made explicit in literature)’.
They give a fuller account of the distinction, along with an organized list of prior works under each setting, and we defer to it rather than duplicating it here.
blocks.zh:
因此,这两种设置并不是单一模型的变体,而是不同的模型.
这两种结果中的哪一种决定了可以显示的结果。
我们坚决支持Noroozizadeh2025深入强调这一点,他们写道:`从[他们]的工作中取走的,是有意的,不把从文字背景中的见解与体重背景的见解混为一谈(这种区别在文献中很少明确)。
它们更充分地说明了这种区别,并列出了每个背景之下以往的作品的有条不紊的清单,我们遵从这些清单,而不是在此重复。

blocks.en:
The two settings are best read as limits.
In the in-weights limit, 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is fixed and can be committed to memory in full, so traversal can in principle be eliminated.
In the in-context limit, 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is unseen and nothing about it can have been stored, so all of the structure must be computed at inference.
Most tasks of interest sit between the two.
Multihop QA is the clearest case, as the entities and relations are held in the weights, whereas the question, and often retrieved evidence, are supplied at inference.
Frequently occurring compositions may well be stored, whereas rare ones must be composed.
Note that we offer this as a conjecture about where real tasks sit rather than as a result.
blocks.zh:
这两个设置最好读作限制.
在负重限制中,G\ mathcal{G}是固定的,可以完全致力于内存,因此转录原则上可以消除.
在内文本限制中, G\ mathcal{G} 是不见的, 并且没有关于它的任何内容可以存储, 因此所有的结构都必须在推断时计算 。
大多数有关任务都位于两者之间。
Multihop QA是最清楚的案例,因为实体和关系都在权重中,而问题和经常检索到的证据则由推论提供。
经常出现的成分很可能被储存起来,而稀有的成分必须被储存起来。
请注意,我们提出这一点,是对实际任务所在而非结果的猜测。

blocks.en:
Semantics is an independent choice within the in-weights setting. noroozizadeh2025deep kept their nodes semanticless, and wang2026do compared semantic and semanticless representations of the same knowledge graph, so the setting does not require semantics.
Indeed, they found the natural language forms gave noisy scaling trends whereas random identifiers gave a clear and reproducible one, which they attribute to the information carried by the lexical form of the entity and relation names.
Multihop QA drops both.
However, retaining semantics makes auditing unavoidable, since the set of possible shortcuts is not known in advance.
This auditing is what limits the scale, and yang-etal-2025-large and balesni2024lessons are both restricted to two hops as a result ( D.2 ).
blocks.zh:
语义学是体重不足环境下的独立选择. noroozizadeh2025deep保持了他们的节点无语义,而wang2026do则比较了同一知识图中的语义和无语义表述,因此设定不需要语义.
事实上,他们发现,自然语言形式呈现出吵闹的缩放趋势,而随机识别特征则呈现出明确和可复制的趋势,他们将此归因于实体和关系名称的词汇形式所携带的信息。
Multihop QA同时减少.
然而,保留语义使得审计不可避免,因为一套可能的捷径是事先不知道的.
这种审计是限制规模的原因,Yang-etal-2025大和balesni2024lessons都因此被限制在两跳(D.2.

blocks.en:
minegishi2026emergent trained a single-layer transformer on two-hop compositions over a fixed relational graph, plus an analogical mapping between two copies of it, proving a in-weights setting that supports analogical reasoning.
They also formalized analogy as a functor between categories, and showed that it is acquired later than composition.
blocks.zh:
minegishi2026emergent在固定关系图上对一台单层变压器进行了双跳构件的训练,外加其两个拷贝之间的模拟映射,证明了支持模拟推理的不重设定.
他们还将类比形式化,作为分类之间的调味剂,并显示其获得时间晚于组成.

blocks.en:
wang2026do studied scale in the in-weights setting along a different axis, namely the parameter budget.
They trained on the individual triples of a fixed knowledge graph and tested on triples which follow from the latent rules the graph was generated under.
They found that the minimal parameter budget required scales linearly with what they call the graph search entropy, which is the entropy rate of a maximal entropy random walk over the graph, and that the largest model was not the best one.
blocks.zh:
Wang2026do按照不同的轴,即参数预算,在重量内设置中研究了尺度。
他们接受了关于固定知识图的三重体的个别培训,并接受了三重体的测试,这些三重体是根据该图根据潜在的规则产生的。
他们发现,最小的参数预算需要用他们称之为图搜索的Entropy的线性尺度,这是最大Entropy随机行走图上的Entropy率,最大的模型并不是最好的.

blocks.en:
zhong2025understanding studied multi-token prediction in the in-weights setting.
They found that multi-token prediction improved path prediction over next-token prediction, and that the gain was largest on the paths which required the most inference beyond what was observed in the training data.
They attribute this to a transfer layer which learns the powers of the adjacency matrix, which is the same object as the distance matrix our skips require the model to compute (§ 2.1 ).
The difference is where it resides, as the powers are stored in the weights of a single graph there, whereas here they must be computed within the forward pass for a graph which has never been seen.
Multi-token prediction thus helped in both settings, and by supplying supervision on the same structure, but the learning dynamics of the two settings differ.
blocks.zh:
Zhong2025理解研究了在体重环境下的多键预测.
他们发现,多键预测比下键预测改进了路径预测,在需要比培训数据所观察到的推断更推断的路径上收益最大。
它们将此归因于一个能学习辅助矩阵功率的传输层,这是与我们跳跃所需的距离矩阵相同的对象(§2.1).
其区别在于其存在的地方,因为权力储存在某一个图表的权重中,而在此,它们必须在前传中计算出一个从未见过的图表。
因此,在两种情况下,通过提供对同一结构的监督,多键预测都有帮助,但两种环境的学习动态有所不同。

blocks.en:
Given the different learning dynamics in the two settings, we strongly recommend that future researchers be very clear about which setting they are evaluating, as this detail is often a single line hidden in the method section, or is not stated at all and must be inferred from the experimental details. tong2026generalization illustrates the difficulty.
They considered generalization to unseen graphs and to longer path lengths for in-weights shortest path search.
Their use of multiple graphs makes the setup look like the in-context task, and the test graphs even have disjoint node sets, but the number of graphs is minimal, and the models were pretrained on random walks over all of them, so the graphs are only unseen during finetuning.
They found that models generalize across graphs, which is expected given that pretraining, but that even in the in-weights setting they fail to generalize to out-of-distribution lengths.
blocks.zh:
鉴于两种环境下的学习动态不同,我们强烈建议未来的研究人员要非常清楚地了解他们正在评价的是什么设定,因为这个细节常常是隐藏在方法一节中的单行,或者根本不被说明,必须从实验细节中推断出来. tong2026泛化说明了困难.
他们认为,对于体重不足者最短的路径搜索,一般化为看不见的图表和较长的路径长度。
他们使用多个图表使设置看起来像内文任务,测试图表甚至有脱节的节点集,但图表的数量很少,模型在随机行走时被预先训练过,因此图形只在微调时才被忽略.
他们发现模型泛指图表,考虑到这种预训,预计会如此,但即使在重量不足的情况下,它们也无法泛指分布长度。

blocks.en: Appendix D Extended Relevant Work
blocks.zh: 附录D 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en: D.1 Graphs and LLMs
blocks.zh: D.1 图和法学硕士

blocks.en:
There is a strong interest in applying LLMs to non-text-based tasks, despite LLMs being designed for and trained on language ( NEURIPS2020_1457c0d6 ) .
However, applying LLMs to graph-based tasks is challenging due to a mismatch between data and model design.
LLMs were designed to process sequential data.
Thus, graphs must be encoded linearly for an LM; however, there is no canonical linearization of a graph, and the chosen order has a large effect on performance ( fatemi2024talk ; ge-etal-2025-graph ; yuan2024gracore ) .
blocks.zh:
尽管LLMS是为语言设计和培训的(NEURIPS2020_1457c0d6 ),但对于将LLMs应用于非文本任务有着浓厚的兴趣.
然而,由于数据与模型设计不匹配,将LLMs应用于基于图表的任务具有挑战性.
LLMs旨在处理顺序数据。
因此,图必须用线性编码表示一个LM;然而,一个图没有线性编码,所选择的顺序对性能有较大影响(eatmi2024tal;ge-etal-2025-graphy;$2024gracore).

blocks.en: LLMs often perform surprisingly poorly on graph-based tasks ( wang2023can ; liu2023evaluating ; fatemi2024talk ; guo2023gpt4graph ; dai2024revisiting ; perozzi2024let ; ge-etal-2025-graph ; tang2025grapharena ) .
blocks.zh: LLMs在基于图表的任务(wang2023can; liu2023评价; 命运2024talk; guo2023gpt4graph ; dai2024revisiting; perozzi2024let; ge-etal-2025-graph ; tang2025grapharena)上经常表现出奇的差.

blocks.en:
Importantly, prior work has shown that LLMs fail to understand and exploit graph topology when it is given as part of the prompt ( huang2024can ; xu2025when ; guan2025attention ) .
Instead, LLMs largely ignore explicit structure in favour of inferring structure from node semantics ( huang2024can ) .
This is possible for some tasks due to local homophily, a phenomenon in which semantically similar nodes tend to connect more closely in natural data ( mcpherson2001birds ) . xu2025when corroborated these findings under different graph encodings, stating that ‘most structural encoding strategies offer marginal or even negative gains’ and that this was consistent across LLM sizes and even for a ‘reasoning’ model.
This led them to suggest that using structure is unnecessary for LLMs.
Also, the attention patterns of LLMs do not correspond to graph structures, implying a lack of traversal across the graphs to solve tasks ( guan2025attention ) .
blocks.zh:
重要的是,先前的研究表明,LLMs在作为提示的一部分(huang2024can;xu2025 when ;guan2025 attention )给出时,无法理解和利用图表地形。
相反,LLMS基本上忽略了明显的结构,倾向于从节点语义(huang2024can)推断结构.
在一些任务中,由于局部的同源性,这是有可能的,在这种现象中,在自然数据(mcpherson2001birds )中,类似集合的节点倾向于更紧密的连接. xu2025在不同的图表编码下证实这些发现时指出,`大多数结构编码战略都带来边际甚至负收益 ' ,这在LLM大小之间是一致的,甚至对于 " 合理 " 模式也是如此。
这使他们认为,对有限责任公司来说,没有必要使用结构。
此外,LLMS的注意模式与图表结构并不对应,意味着没有横跨图表来解决任务(guan2025attention).

blocks.en: Prior work has considered how to use natural language to describe graph structure and semantics ( ye-etal-2024-language ; chen2024llaga ; zhou-etal-2025-graph ) . dai2024revisiting showed the limits of using text descriptions of graphs for graph tasks.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作曾考虑过如何使用自然语言来描述图表结构和语义(ye-etal-2024-language; chen2024llaga;zhou-etal-2025-graph ). dai2024revisiting显示了为图表任务使用图表文字描述的限度.

blocks.en:
park2025iclr showed how in-context representations of graph structure emerge for graph navigation on grid topologies.
Note that here ‘in-context’ is in-context learning using LLMs.
The provided graph tokenization is a series of random walks over the graph.
Interestingly, this will act as a replication of the adjacency list, which will bypass the causal constraint as in § 3 .
This was followed up by lepori2026language , who showed that even though models can use in-context learning to represent graph structure, models often then fail to take advantage of this structure in downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
park2025iclr 显示在网格地形上如何出现图结构的内在文字表示。
请注意这里的“内文”是使用法学硕士的内文学习。
所提供的图示化是图上的一系列随机行走.
有趣的是,这将起到复制副词列表的作用,该列表将绕过第3款中的因果关系限制.
之后Lepori2026 language(英语:lepori2026 language)也对此进行了跟进,显示尽管模型可以使用内文学习来代表图表结构,但模型在下游任务中往往无法利用这种结构.

blocks.en: Even though knowledge graphs are a rich source of structured information, incorporating this into LLMs is an open problem ( ijcai2024p898 ; 10.1145/3626772.3657775 ; chen2024llaga ; wang2024llms ; luo2024reasoning ; kong2025gofa ; wu-etal-2025-graph , among many others) .
blocks.zh: 尽管知识图是结构化信息的一个丰富来源,但将其纳入LLMS是一个尚未解决的问题(ijcai2024p898;10.1145/3626772.3657775;chen2024llaga;wang2024llms;luo2024解释;kong2025gofa;wu-etal-2025-graph等).

blocks.en: D.2 Controlled Settings and Synthetic Data
blocks.zh: D.2 控制下的设置和合成数据

blocks.en:
Studying graph search in natural language introduces confounds that obscure whether a model is genuinely traversing the reasoning graph.
The latent graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is unknown and must be inferred from text; world knowledge and memorization can produce correct answers without actual path discovery; and surface-level correlations can yield shortcuts, particularly when k k is small.
There are also retrieval and reading-comprehension limitations which are unrelated to the multihop search process itself.
These confounds make it difficult to isolate the core difficulty of multihop reasoning.
blocks.zh:
研究自然语言的图表搜索引入了混淆,模糊了模型是否真正翻转推理图.
潜在的图 G\ mathcal{G} 是未知的,必须从文本中推断出来;世界知识和记忆可以在没有实际路径发现的情况下产生正确的答案;而表面水平的关联可以产生快捷键,特别是在 k k 小的时候.
也有检索和阅读理解的限制,这些限制与多跳搜索过程本身无关.
这些困惑使得多跳推理的核心难度难以分离.

blocks.en: We control for them by using language models trained from scratch on synthetic data, where there is no prior knowledge to exploit, the graph structure is explicit and varied, and the only path to a correct answer is structural traversal. This makes learnable graph search a controlled environment for studying multihop reasoning, where success is evidence of latent structural computation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过使用从零开始在合成数据上训练的语言模型来控制它们,在以前没有知识可以利用的地方,图表结构是明确和多样的,找到正确答案的唯一途径是结构的转弯. 这使得可学习的图表搜索成为研究多跳推理的可控环境,其中成功是潜在结构计算的证据.

blocks.en:
Controlled settings with synthetic data are widely used when studying reasoning in LMs. saparov2023language generated synthetic ontologies with fictional concept names in order to avoid confounds from knowledge acquired during pretraining, and analyzed the generated chain-of-thought rather than the predicted label.
More broadly, many used synthetic symbolic tasks to ensure a controlled environment when studying multihop reasoning ( zhang2022unveiling ; ramesh2024compositional ; khona2024toward ; wang2024grokking ) .
blocks.zh:
在LMs中研究推理时广泛使用带有合成数据的可控设置. saparov2023语言产生了带有虚构概念名称的合成本体学,以避免从在预训期间获得的知识中产生混乱,并分析了生成的思想链而不是预测的标签.
更广义地说,许多人在研究多跳推理(zhang2022unveilling ; rammesh2024compositional ; khona2024toward ; wang2024grokking )时,使用合成符号任务来确保控制环境.

blocks.en:
yang-etal-2025-large provides a nice comparison with our work under different motivations, as they studied the extent to which pretrained LLMs can perform latent multihop reasoning without shortcuts.
Considering LLMs introduces multiple practical issues, which we avoid.
First, they need to identify when and how LLMs employ shortcuts.
This leads them to focus their inquiry on a single type of shortcut based on co-occurrence information ( ju-etal-2024-investigating ) .
This doesn’t rule out other types of shortcuts.
Second, because LLM data is generally inaccessible, they must use a ‘proxy corpus’ to create a test set such that head and answer entities never occurred in the proxy corpus.
This does not rule out such co-occurrences happening in the true training data.
This co-occurrence-based filtering led to the creation of a small dataset, which only considers 1- and 2-hop questions.
Finally, as most LLMs default to using CoT, they need to suppress test-time compute behaviour by framing the question and prompting the model to ‘fill in the blank’ with an immediate answer.
They find that the specific semantics of the bridge entities is the largest determiner of performance.
For example, the best models perform latent multihop reasoning when bridging on a county but fail when bridging on a year.
This does not rule out that these models just have poor representations of years, which is a known issue ( yang2025number ; yuchi-etal-2026-llms ) .
blocks.zh:
Yang-etal-2025大调与我们在不同动机下的工作相比,
考虑法学硕士提出了我们避免的多种实际问题。
首先,它们需要确定LLMs何时以及如何使用快捷方式。
这使得他们将调查的焦点集中在基于共犯信息的单一类型的捷径(ju-etal-2024-调查)上.
这不排除其他类型的捷径。
第二,由于LLM数据一般无法获取,它们必须使用 " 代用体 " 来创建一套测试集,使代用体中从未出现头和答题实体。
这不排除在真正的培训数据中出现这种共同情况。
这种基于共发的过滤导致创建了一个小数据集,只考虑1-和2-hop的问题.
最后,由于大多数LLMS默认使用CoT,它们需要通过设定问题和促使模型立即用一个答案 " 填空 " 来抑制测试时间的计算行为。
他们发现桥体的具体语义是最大的性能决定因素.
例如,最佳模式在连接一个县时进行潜在的多跳推理,但在一年时失败。
这并不排除这些模型只是年年表现不佳,这是一个已知的问题(yang2025数字;yuchi-etal-2026-llms).

blocks.en:
Similarly, balesni2024lessons used synthetic data to try to bypass these practical issues with LLMs.
Their argument is similar to the use of a proxy corpus, in that synthetic data will have a low chance of being in the training data, where they stated that ‘by using synthetic facts, we rule out memorization and reasoning shortcuts as explanations for two-hop performance’.
Again, this data issue limits their study to 2-hop questions.
They found that fine-tuned LLMs fail to reason when composing two synthetic facts, and require that one fact be non-synthetic, learned from pretraining.
This result implies that memorization or neural language representation remains a confound in this setup. li2026scaling ‘resynthesized’ the data by randomly substituting entity names and numerical values.
This was done to ameliorate the related – and broader – issue of data leakage from LLM pretraining.
blocks.zh:
同样,balesni2024lesson公司利用合成数据试图绕过这些与LLMs相关的实际问题.
他们的论点与使用代理程序类似,因为合成数据在培训数据中的可能性很小,他们表示,`通过使用合成事实,我们排除了记忆和推理捷径作为双跳表演的解释'.
同样,这个数据问题将他们的研究限制在2-hop问题.
他们发现,微调的LLMs在编译两个合成事实时没有道理,要求一个事实是非合成的,从预先训练中吸取教训.
这一结果意味着记忆或神经语言的表达方式在这个设置中仍然是一个困惑. li2026s通过随机替换实体名称和数值来缩放“合成”数据。
这样做是为了改善相关和更广泛的LLM预训数据泄漏问题。

blocks.en:
We are not framing the limitations of these works negatively; rather, they are examples that demonstrate how difficult it is to control for various confounds when using LLMs with real-world data; while these issues can be alleviated, they can not be entirely ruled out, and they affect the conclusions of these works.
These examples thus justify the use of a strictly controlled setting using purely synthetic data and language models trained from scratch to avoid these confounds.
blocks.zh:
我们并不是在消极地界定这些作品的局限性;相反,这些实例表明,在使用带有现实世界数据的法学硕士课程时,如何难以控制各种困惑;虽然这些问题可以缓解,但不能完全排除,它们影响到这些作品的结论。
因此,这些例子证明使用纯合成数据和从零开始训练的语言模型来使用严格控制的设置是合理的,以避免这些混乱。

blocks.en:
lin-etal-2025-implicit found a structural shortcut that can be learnt for simple multihop addition and subtraction statements.
This shortcut arises due to an asymmetry between addition and subtraction, where the former is commutative and the latter is not.
This allows the model to learn addition and subtraction when the variable is left-side via chaining terms, which is not a viable method for subtraction when the variable is on the right-side.
This shortcut can be analyzed in relation to our work, where addition and left-side subtraction induce a latent linear graph (hence the ‘chain’ solution), where right-side subtraction induces a latent tree. 14 14 14 We disagree with their conclusion that ‘language models rely on shortcuts for implicit reasoning’ which is also implied in the title ‘Implicit Reasoning in Transformers is Reasoning through Shortcuts’. This is a very broad conclusion. While their work supports the claim that language models can learn shortcuts in lieu of implicit reasoning, and they identify a very interesting shortcut, the causes for this shortcut will not apply to most reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh:
lin-etal-2025-implective发现了一个结构快捷键,可以学习简单的多跳加减语句.
这种快捷方式的产生是由于增减之间的不对称,前者是共性,后者不是.
这允许模型在变量通过链条术语左侧时学习增减,这在变量位于右侧时并不是一个可行的减法.
这一捷径可以结合我们的工作来分析,增加和左侧的减法会诱导潜在的线性图(因此是 " 链 " 解决方案),右侧的减法会诱导潜在的树。 14 14 我们不同意他们的结论,即`语言模型依赖捷径来进行隐含推理 ' ,这在标题`变形器中的不合法理性就是通过捷径来解释 ' 中也隐含着这一点。 这是一个非常广泛的结论。 虽然他们的作品支持一种说法,即语言模型可以学习快捷方式来代替隐含推理,他们还发现了一个非常有趣的快捷方式,但这一快捷方式的原因将不适用于大多数推理任务.

blocks.en: D.3 Expressibility and Learnability of Graph and other Compositional Tasks
blocks.zh: D.3 图表和其他组成任务的可表达性和可学习性

blocks.en: There are theoretical motivations for applying small LMs to graph-based tasks. Small LMs provide a controlled environment, allowing one to probe the limits of expressibility and learnability of LMs and the underlying model, such as transformers ( pmlr-v235-back-de-luca24a ; sanford2024understanding ; khona2024toward ; cohen2025spectral ; qharabagh2026learning ) .
blocks.zh: 将小型LMs应用于基于图表的任务有理论动机. 小的LMs提供了一个可控环境,允许人们探究LMs的可表达性和可学习性极限以及基础模型,如变压器(pmlr-v235-back-de-luca24a;sanford2024 understanding ;khona2024 toward;cohen2025 光谱;qharabagh2026 learning ).

blocks.en: Expressibility concerns the question: can model M M compute task T T , which relies on a precise definition of both M M and T T . This includes the computational budget of M M . For transformers, this concerns the number of layers, the embedding dimension, and sequential computation (which is often tied to the task). Expressibility results for graph tasks are stated in terms of the number of layers and the embedding dimension, as a function of the graph size. This means one can select a model which is large enough for the task by construction, and attribute any remaining failure to learnability. This is how we select our model size ( J ).
blocks.zh: 显性涉及一个问题:可以模拟M M 计算任务 T T ,它依赖于M M 和 T T T 的精确定义. 这包括MM的计算预算。 对于变压器来说,这涉及到层数,嵌入维度,以及顺序计算(这往往与任务联系在一起). 图表任务的可表达性结果以层数和嵌入维度表示,作为图表大小的函数. 这意味着人们可以通过构建来选择一个足以胜任任务的模型,并且将任何尚存的学习失败归结为属性. 这就是我们如何选择我们的模型大小(J).

blocks.en: Learnability asks the question: can model M M actually learn task T T under learning conditions C C . A task being expressible implies that there exists a model parameterization that can solve the task, but not that the task is easily learnable, as finding that parameterization may be very difficult. The path-star task is a prime example of this, where it is easy to express ( frydenlund-2024-mystery ) , but very difficult to learn (because it is designed to be adversarial to learn) ( bachmann2024the , D.4 ) .
blocks.zh: 可学习性提出一个问题:M M模型可以在学习条件下实际学习任务T T C. 一项可表达的任务意味着存在一个可以解决任务的模型参数化,但并不表示任务容易学习,因为发现参数化可能非常困难. Path-star任务就是这方面的一个主要例子,它很容易表达(frydenlund-2024-mystery ),但学习非常困难(因为它被设计为对抗性学习)(bachmann2024the, D.4.

blocks.en:
Expressibility. sanford2024understanding developed four computational classes for transformer expressibility on graph tasks, stated over the depth L L and the embedding dimension m m with N = O ⁡ ( | 𝒩 | + | E | ) N=O(|\mathcal{N}|+|E|) .
These range from a single wide-enough layer (Depth1), to L = O ⁡ ( log ⁡ N ) L=O(\log N) with m = O ⁡ ( N ϵ ) m=O(N^{\epsilon}) (LogDepth), to either adding a polynomial number of pause tokens (LogDepthPause) or instead widening to m = O ⁡ ( N 1 / 2 + ϵ ) m=O(N^{1/2+\epsilon}) (LogDepthWide).
They then grouped graph tasks into three families: retrieval tasks such as edge existence are solved in Depth1, parallelizable tasks such as connectivity are solved in LogDepth, and search tasks are the hardest family.
Shortest path is a search task, and is solved in LogDepthWide, so logarithmic depth and polynomial width suffice without any pause tokens.
blocks.zh:
显性. sanford2024 understand为变压器在图表任务上的可表达性开发了四个计算类,在深度L和嵌入维度m与 N = O = ⁡ ( | N + | E + |) N = O ( |\ mathcal{ N }|+| E| |) 上标注.
这些范围从一个单一的宽角层(深度1),到L= O → (log Q⁡ N) L= O(\log N) 含 m= O → (N →) → (N →) m= O(N → epsilon }) (Log DepthPause), 要么添加一个多名数的暂停符号(Log DepthPause), 要么扩大为 m = O → (N 1/ 2 + + ) m=O(N^{1/2+\epsilon})(Log DepthWide).
他们随后将图任务分组为三个家族: 边缘存在等检索任务在深度1中解决,连接等并行任务在逻辑深度中解决,搜索任务是最难的家族.
最短的路径是搜索任务,在Log DepthWide中解决,因此对数深度和多名宽就足够了,无需任何暂停符号.

blocks.en:
A transformer can express various multihop reasoning tasks with k k hops using log ⁡ ( k ) \log(k) layers. This includes Khops ( pmlr-v235-sanford24a ) , shortest path on path-star graphs ( frydenlund-2024-mystery ) , and graph connectivity ( sanford2024understanding ; merrill2025a ; ye2025transformers ) . These are instances of a general phenomenon identified by liu2023transformers , who showed that a shallow non-recurrent transformer can exactly simulate any semiautomaton on a length- T T input with O ⁡ ( log ⁡ T ) O(\log T) layers, and with O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) layers when the associated group is solvable.
They called these shortcut solutions . 15 15 15 Their use of ‘shortcut’ refers to the depth of the model being smaller than the number of sequential reasoning steps, and such a solution is exact. This differs from our use of the term, which refers to a solution that exploits a spurious feature of the data and is not exact.
blocks.zh:
变压器可以使用log QQ( k)\log( k) 层来表达 kk hops 的各种多跳推理任务. 包括Khops(pmlr-v235-sanford24a),路径-星图上最短的路径(flordenlund-2024-mystery),和图连通性(sanford2024 understands;merrill2025a;ye2025 transfers). 这些是liu2023transformers所识别的一般现象的例子,他们显示一个浅非经常变压器可以完全模拟任何半自动变压器的长度-T T输入与O QQ(log QT) O(\log T)层,当关联组可溶解时与O QQ(1) O(1)层.
他们称这些捷径解决办法为 " 捷径 " 。 15 他们使用 " 捷径 " 是指模型的深度小于顺序推理步骤的数量,这种解决办法是准确的。 这与我们使用这个术语不同,它指的是利用数据中虚假的特征而不准确的解决方案.

blocks.en: Depth can be traded off against width. yehudai2026depth showed that one can trade off model depth for dimensional width when solving various graph tasks. They show that this is valuable, since width is parallelizable on GPUs, leading to empirical speedups. Their lower bounds are stated for a specific tokenization, where each token is a row of the adjacency matrix, and thus, as discussed below with bechler2026lost , expressibility results are tied to the tokenization used. This illustrates that one must be very careful when translating different results across graph tasks and experimental setups. We discuss their comparison of graph tokenizations in D.5 . yao-etal-2025-language-models proved a similar trade-off for their k k -hop task, where the product of the depth, width, number of heads, and bits of precision must grow linearly in k k . Their bound holds when the attention pattern does not depend on the query entity, and they noted that shortcuts using fewer layers exist for some relation sets.
blocks.zh: 深度可以与宽度进行交换. yehudai2026深度显示,在解决各种图表任务时,可以用模型深度来交换维宽度。 它们显示这是有价值的,因为宽度在GPU上是平行的,导致经验性加速. 它们的下限表示为特定的符号化,其中每个符号是副符号矩阵的一行,因此,如下文Bechler2026lost所讨论,可表示性结果与所使用的符号化挂钩. 这表明,在将不同的结果转换成图表任务和实验结构时必须非常小心。 我们讨论他们对D.5中的图示化的比较. yao-etal-2025语言模型证明了他们kk-hop任务的类似权衡,其中深度,宽度,头数,和精度的位点的产物必须线性增长kk. 当注意力模式不依赖于查询实体时,它们绑定的控件,他们注意到一些关系集使用较少的层的快捷键存在.

blocks.en:
london2025pause proved that including ‘pause tokens’ strictly increases the expressibility of transformers. sanford2024understanding also found that these lead to a different expressibility family. Our inclusion of the node list will act in a similar way to pause tokens, and so this change in expressibility may explain the observed change in learnability. Note that shortest path is expressible without pause tokens given sufficient width, so this is not a statement that the extra positions are necessary.
These are asymptotic regimes, and satisfying their form at a fixed graph size does not certify a particular finite model, so we cannot rule out that + N +N changes what our model can express.
What is interesting is that STAN decreases the overall token count for the edges to 1/3. Thus, this improvement can not be explained solely by raw token count.
blocks.zh:
London2025Pause证明,包括`puse acidents'严格地增加了变压器的可表达性。 Sanford2024 understand 也发现这些导致了不同的显性家族. 我们列入节点列表,也会以类似的方式暂停符号,因此这种显式变化可以解释观察到的可学习性的变化. 请注意,最短的路径是可表达的,只要有足够的宽度,没有暂停符号,所以这不是一个需要额外位置的声明。
这些是不对称制度,以固定的图表大小满足其形式并不能证明一个特定的有限模型,所以我们不能排除+N+N改变我们模型能够表达的内容.
有趣的是STAN将边缘的整体符号计数降至1/3. 因此,这种改善不能仅以原始凭证计算来解释。

blocks.en: bechler2026lost considered the expressibility of three different graph tokenization schemes for graphs: adjacency lists (per node), random walks, and spectral encodings. They show that while the latter two encodings are derived from adjacency lists, transformer models can not convert between encodings under a fixed depth, and that the different representations have different expressibility for certain graph tasks. Note that the latter two ‘tokenizations’ are more of a feature preprocessing that encodes graph-global information into each node encoding. This is orthogonal to our work, which only encodes singular edge or node information into each token (via raw edge- and node-lists), and encoding graph-global information would run contrary to our core scientific question, which is how language models can learn graph-global information from local encodings efficiently at scale.
blocks.zh: bechler2026lost)考虑了三种不同图表符号化方案对于图表的可表达性:辅助列表(每个节点),随机行走,以及光谱编码. 它们表明,虽然后两个编码来源于辅音列表,但变压器模型无法在固定深度下在编码之间转换,不同的表示方式对于某些图形任务有不同的可表达性. 请注意,后两个“tokenizations”更是一种功能预处理,将图形-全局信息编码到每个节点编码中。 这对我们的工作来说是正统的,它只将单边或节点信息编码到每个符号中(通过原始的边缘和节点列表),而将图-全球信息编码会与我们的核心科学问题相悖,这就是语言模型如何从局部编码中有效学习到图-全球信息.

blocks.en: Our model design follows from these results. These bounds imply that our tasks are expressible by small transformers, as the required depth and width grow slowly in the size of the graph and in the number of hops. We therefore use models of L = 11 L=11 layers and m = 256 m=256 dimensions or smaller ( J ), which satisfy the depth and width required at our graph sizes. Any remaining failure is then attributable to learnability rather than to expressibility.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型设计就是根据这些结果。 这些界限意味着我们的任务可以用小型变压器来表示,因为所需的深度和宽度在图表大小和跳动次数上缓慢增长. 因此,我们使用L = 11 L = 11层和m = 256 m = 256维或更小(J)的模型,这些模型满足了我们图大小所需的深度和宽度. 任何剩余的失败都归结为可学习性而不是可表达性。

blocks.en:
Learnability. A model with enough depth and width to express a task will not necessarily learn the intended solution liu2023transformers found that these ‘shortcut’ solutions are learned by standard training, but that they are brittle.
Their models failed to generalize to unseen sequence lengths and degraded under limited supervision, while a recurrent LSTM was unaffected.
They showed that a recency-biased scratchpad could guide the transformer towards the recurrent solution instead, so what is learned depends on the supervision rather than on the depth. ye2025transformers , who consider in-weights graph connectivity, noted that training models within their expressibility limits can lead to learning the underlying algorithmic solution; however, exceeding this will result in learning shortcut solutions. khona2024toward found no qualitative change in the learning dynamics of their in-weights shortest-path task as they varied the number of layers. They instead attributed failure to a simplicity bias, where the model prefers a shallower solution than the task requires. They then found a critical embedding dimension, around 20 20 for a graph of 200 200 nodes, above which their model generalized to all held-out node pairs, so width and not depth was the binding constraint in their setting. yao-etal-2025-language-models likewise found that their model performed the task by looking up one hop per layer, which is what their bound predicts when the width is held fixed. sanford2024understanding expected shortest path to require a very large model, and only their pre-trained 60 60 M-parameter model approached optimal performance, whereas we solve the harder in-context version with ≈ 6 \approx 6 M parameters trained from scratch.
blocks.zh:
学习能力。 一个具有足够深度和宽度的模型来表达一项任务,不一定能够了解预期的解决方案 liu2023 Transfers发现,这些 " 短板 " 解决方案是通过标准培训学到的,但它们是简陋的。
他们的模型未能被概括到看不见的序列长度,并在有限的监督下退化,而经常性的LSTM则没有受到影响.
他们表明,一个有恒定性的划痕可以引导变压器转向反复出现的解决方案,因此所学到的取决于监督而不是深度。 ye2025 Translaters),他们考虑量子图互联互通,指出在其可表达性限制范围内的培训模型可以导致学习基本的算法解决方案;然而,超出这一点将导致学习快捷解决方案. khona2024toward发现,他们体重最短路径任务的学习动力学没有质的变化,因为它们改变了层数。 他们将失败归结为简单偏差,模型更喜欢比任务要求更浅的解决方案. 然后他们发现了一个关键的嵌入维度,一个200个节点的图大约为20个,在20个节点的图中,它们的模型被泛指到所有被搁置的节点对,所以宽度而非深度是它们设置时的束缚. yao-etal-2025语言模型同样发现,他们的模型通过每层一跳就完成了任务,这是他们约束的预言,当宽度被固定时。 Sanford2024理解了预期最短的路径需要非常大的模型,只有他们预先训练的60个60M参数模型接近了最佳性能,而我们用从零开始训练的QQ 6\大约6M参数解决了更硬的内文本版本.

blocks.en: li2026scaling found that LLMs do not generalize to longer hop lengths, even when provided with test-time compute. xu2026depth studied how many latent planning steps a model can learn to perform. They found that transformers trained from scratch discovered at most three latent steps, while finetuned frontier models reached five and a frontier model reached seven with few-shot prompting. They also found that a strategy discovered at five steps generalized to eight steps at test time, separating the difficulty of discovering a strategy from the difficulty of executing it, and that this separation was not resolved by scale. wang2026do similarly found that the largest model was not the best, and that the optimal parameter budget scaled with the entropy of the graph search task rather than with model capacity.
blocks.zh: li2026scaling发现,LLMS并不一般化为更长的hop长度,即使提供了测试时间计算. xu2026深入研究了一个模型可以学会实施多少潜在规划步骤. 他们发现,从零开始训练的变压器在最多三个潜在步骤中发现,而微调的前沿模型则达到5个,前沿模型达到7个,只有几发提示。 他们还发现,在测试时间以5个步骤普遍到8个步骤发现了一个策略,将发现一个策略的难度与执行策略的难度区分开来,这种分离并没有通过尺度解决. Wang2026do同样发现,最大的模型不是最好的,最佳参数预算与图搜索任务的Entropy而不是模型容量相适应.

blocks.en: lee2025selfimproving showed how a ‘self-improving’ process can act as a form of extended curriculum. They show OOD length generalization by training the model on its own OOD predictions, thereby extending its in-domain distribution without extra human supervision or annotation. This technique is interesting in that it blurs the lines of what OOD means. They consider mazes, which are topologically equivalent to random trees with | 𝒩 | = 30 |\mathcal{N}|=30 .
blocks.zh: Lee2025自我改进表明, " 自我改进 " 进程如何作为扩展课程的一种形式。 它们通过对模型进行自身OOD预测的培训来显示OOD长度的概括,从而扩展其域内分布,而无需额外的人类监督或注释. 这种技术很有趣,因为它模糊了OD的含义。 他们认为迷宫在地形学上相当于随机树,其中的QQ N = 30 |\ mathcal{N}|=30.

blocks.en: How task decomposition affects learnability has been studied ( wies2023subtask ; dziri2023faith ; abbe2024how ; pmlr-v291-wang25a ) . This often concerns length or other OOD generalization ( zhou2024what ; zhou2024transformers ) . zhao2026shattered considered the learning dynamics of arithmetic and sorting tasks. They find that models learn multiple sub-skills in parallel. This is similar to our finding that models do not learn to generalize across k ′ k^{\prime} on path-star graphs, where each k ′ k^{\prime} is a sub-skill. They concluded that training data correlation and distributional shifts were the cause of this. However, that can not be the reason for failure in our case, as we only consider in-domain distributions and go to great lengths to avoid spurious correlations with the training data.
blocks.zh: 已研究了任务分解如何影响学习能力(wis2023子任务;dziri2023信仰;abbe2024how;pmlr-v291-wang25a). 这常常涉及长度或其他OOD概括(zhou2024 what;zhou2024 transfers). .zhao2026 sshattered考虑了算术和排序任务的学习动态. 他们发现模型同时学习多种子技能. 这与我们发现的相似, 模型不会在路径星图上 学习通俗化 k ' k^{\prime , 其中每个 k ' k^{\prime 是一个子技能。 他们的结论是,培训数据的相关性和分布变化是造成这种情况的原因。 然而,这不能成为我们失败的原因,因为我们只考虑域内分布,并尽其所能避免与培训数据存在虚假的关联。

blocks.en: As mentioned in Sec 1.2 , yao-etal-2025-language-models considered a synthetic natural language k ≤ 4 k\leq 4 -hop task. They empirically demonstrated that the number of unique training instances needed to learn the task grows exponentially with k k . MMHT improves this to be polynomial with k k . They called this an increase in ‘training budget’, but the growth is in the number of instances, not training steps (as is our main concern). We suggest readers consider this an ‘annotation budget’, where, despite using a synthetic dataset, they asked the question, ‘if one has a k k -hop task, how many training instances do we need to annotate?’ and answered that it grows exponentially with k k without the use of MMHT. An increase in data, even when it is ‘non-factual’, can help accelerate grokking ( abramov2025grokking ) . wang2026the showed that for some tasks, uniform data sampling is sub-optimal, and sampling from a power distribution leads to a significant improvement in learnability.
blocks.zh: 如Sec 1.2所述,yao-etal-2025语言模型认为是一种合成自然语言k 4 k\leq 4 - hop任务. 他们的经验证明,学习任务所需的独特培训次数随着kk的成倍增长。 MMHT改进为多亲子化,使用k k. 他们称这是增加 " 培训预算 " ,但增长取决于实例,而不是培训步骤(这是我们的主要关切)。 我们建议读者将此视为“注解预算 ” , 尽管使用合成数据集, 他们还是问了这个问题 : “ 如果有 k k- hop 任务, 我们需要多少培训实例来注解? ” , 并回答说, 它与 k k k 成指数增长而不使用 MMHT 。 Wang2026显示,对于某些任务来说,统一的数据采样不尽人意,从电源分布中采样会导致学习能力显著提高。

blocks.en: Compositional tasks also relate to curriculum learning due to the impact of MMHT ( frydenlund-2025-language ; yao-etal-2025-language-models ) . mordig2026rethinking found no advantages to using a difficulty-based curriculum on arithmetic and logic tasks. The benefits of a true explicit inter-sample curriculum may be masked or already provided by implicit intra-sample MMHT, for many compositional or multihop reasoning tasks. They considered that difficulty can be characterized in various ways. We believe this to be an important point that is often neglected. We also show this as the number-of-hops and task-length are different sources of difficulty (leading to both MMHT and MMLT in L.1.1 ).
blocks.zh: 由于MMHT(flordenlund-2025-languages ; yao-etal-2025-language-models )的影响,组成任务也涉及到课程学习. mordig2026 reflexing发现在算术和逻辑任务上使用基于难度的课程没有任何好处. 真正的明确跨样本课程的好处可能被隐含的MMHT掩盖或已经提供,用于许多组成或多跳推理任务. 他们认为,困难可以用各种方式来描述。 我们认为,这是经常被忽视的一个重要问题。 我们还表明,跳动次数和任务长度是不同的困难来源(导致L.1.1中的MMHT和MMLT)。

blocks.en: We recommend yuan-etal-2026-barriers as a primer on theoretical issues concerning discrete reasoning with language models.
blocks.zh: 我们推荐人民币 - etal - 2026-barriers作为关于与语言模型分离推理的理论问题的入门。

blocks.en: D.4 The Path-Star Task and Path-Star Graphs
blocks.zh: D.4 路径-星任务和路径-星图

blocks.en: Here we list works that consider either the path-star task proper, a modified version, or path-star graphs. 16 16 16 We went through each work listed on Semantic Scholar which cited bachmann2024the and filtered these for ones which build on their work. This was done in May 2026. Citations are listed in temporal order; however, publication dates are used where possible. This means that some published papers actually predate preprint-only papers when considering preprint dates. The task originally set out by bachmann2024the did not use MMHT. This is important as introducing MMHT, which can be done in various ways – and ways which may not be obvious – will significantly change the difficulty of the task ( frydenlund-2025-language ) . For example, various works introduce MMHT: ( saparov2025transformers ; frydenlund-2025-language ; prakash2025can ; patel2025insertion ; patel-etal-2026-xlm ; patel2025insertion ; bohnet2026analysis ) . Others modify or replace the graph topology ( saparov2025transformers ; frydenlund-2025-language ; lee2025selfimproving ) , or introduce other changes ( thankaraj2025looking ; pipis2025wait ) . This is often done without consideration that this itself changes the learnability of the task. See xu2026depth for a work which explicitly considers the original task without using MMHT. They find that small LMs can learn the task for k = 4 k=4 for d ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } d\in\{2,\,3,\,4,\,5\} and that certain LLMs can be finetuned to learn it consistently up to k = 5 k=5 . Interestingly, when this happens, they show that such models also get OOD generation to up to k ′ = k + 4 k^{\prime}=k+4 .
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们列出了考虑路径星任务本身、修改版或路径星图表的作品。我们浏览了《语义学者》上列出的每一部作品,其中引用了Bachmann2024, 并对这些作品进行了过滤,这些作品都以他们的工作为基础。 这项工作于2026年5月完成. 引用按时间顺序排列;但尽可能使用出版日期。 这意味着一些出版的论文在考虑预印日期时,实际上会比预印日期早. 最初由Bachmann2024规定的任务没有使用MMHT. 这一点很重要,因为引入MMHT(MMHT)可以通过各种方式实现 — — 以及可能并不明显的方式 — — 将大大改变任务难度(friendlund-2025-language). 例如,各种作品引入了MMHT: (saparov2025 transfers ; flordenlund-2025-language ; prakash2025can; patel2025 插入; patel-etal-2026-xlm; patel2025 插入; bohnet2026 analysis ). 其他修改或替换图型地形(saparov2025 transformers ; frienddenlund-2025-language ; Lee2025selfiming ),或引入其他变化(fellowaraj2025 looking ;pipis2025 Wait ). 这样做往往不考虑这本身会改变任务的可学习性。 关于未使用MMHT而明确考虑原始任务的作品,请参见xu2026深度. 他们发现小LM可以学习 k = 4 k = 4 d → {2, 3, 4, 5 } d\in\ 2,\, 3,\, 4,\, 5 } 并且某些LLM可以被微调以一致地学习 k = 5 k= 5 . 有趣的是,当这种情况发生时,它们显示这种模型也能使OOD生成达到k ' = k + 4 k + ^{\prime + 4.

blocks.en: We group the works by method (some using multiple methods): next-token prediction: ( saparov2025transformers ; lee2025selfimproving ; xu2026depth ) , multi-token prediction: ( yin-etal-2024-semformer ; frydenlund-2025-language ; gerontopoulos2025multi ; zuhri2025predicting ; mahajan2026beyond ; teoh2026nextlatent ; huang2026transformers ) , discrete diffusion: ( ye2023diffusion ; frydenlund-2024-mystery ; ye2025beyond ; patel2025insertion ; patel-etal-2026-xlm ; trainin2026discrete ; wang2026trainability ) , reinforcement learning: ( setlur2024rl ; zhou2026qsharp ; bobbili2025pita ; prakash2025can ; monea2025breadcrumbs ; wei2026provable ) 17 17 17 wei2026provable is slightly different but we included it as we believe it will be of interest to others doing work with RL. , novel architectures (sometimes to support MTP): ( yin-etal-2024-semformer ; hu2025learning ; ahn2025efficient ; mahajan2026beyond ; teoh2026nextlatent ) , and scratchpads or intermediate sequential reasoning: ( frydenlund-2025-language ; thankaraj2025looking ; alberghi2025on ; xu2026depth ) .
blocks.zh: 我们用方法(有的采用多种方法)将作品分组:(saparov2025 转换器;lee2025 自我改进;xu2026 深度),多键预测:(yin-etal-2024-semfor;flordenlund-2025 语言;gerontopoulos2025 multi;zuhri2025 预测;mahajan2026 eyond;teoh2026 extralatent;huang2026 transforms ),离散扩散:(ye2023 diffusion;florend-2024-mystery;ye2025beyond;patel-2026-xlm;train2026-discrete;wang2026-reat),强化学习:(stul2024rl;zhu2026qsharp;bobili2025pita;prakash2025can;mone2020brumi;webread;172020bread) 校对:Soup

blocks.en: We reiterate that we do not believe the path-star task or path-star graphs should be used to benchmark novel methods. Solving the task is not the point of the task; understanding why it is difficult is the point.
blocks.zh: 我们重申,我们不认为应该用路径星任务或路径星图表来衡量新的方法。 解决这项任务不是任务的要点;理解为什么困难是重点.

blocks.en:
Concurrent to this work, huang2026transformers studied the learning dynamics of MTP on the path-star task and proved that MTP and NTP induce different dynamics.
Their theoretical analysis was limited to d = 2 d=2 , k = 2 k=2 graphs and a two-layer disentangled transformer.
Their experiments used d ∈ { 2 , 5 } d\in\{2,5\} with k = 4 k=4 .
These results should be compared against the NTP results of xu2026depth , who learned graphs of this size without MTP, and against our MTP results. We encourage the reader to consult their work directly, as the methodology and scale differ substantially from ours.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作的同时,Huang2026 Transports研究了MTP在路径-星任务的学习动态,并证明MTP和NTP诱导不同的动态.
他们的理论分析仅限于d = 2 d = 2,k = 2 k = 2 图和一个双层分散式变压器.
他们的实验使用了 d {2, 5} d\\\ 2, 5} 与 k = 4 k = 4.
这些结果应当与Xu2026深度的NTP结果进行比较,后者学会了没有中期计划的这种规模的图表,并与我们的MTP结果进行比较。 我们鼓励读者直接查阅他们的工作,因为方法和规模与我们大不相同。

blocks.en: bohnet2026analysis showed an equivalence between Blocksworld and the topology of path-star graphs, where each stack in Blocksworld corresponds to an arm in a path-star graph. To identify a stack containing a target block, the model must traverse the stack to find a target block, which requires solving the same task as the path-star task. Thus, a subproblem of Blocksword is expressible as the path-star task. However, they use stacks of different sizes, thus inducing MMHT ( frydenlund-2025-language ) . Also, they only consider using reasoning-enhanced LLMs and evaluating the task via one-shot in-context learning with (non-latent) CoT. Hence, it was evaluated under very different conditions, and any insights on learnability or performance are very different.
