blocks.en: L.4 Scratchpads Substantially Change the Shortest Path Task and Break the Theoretical Multihop Reasoning Model
blocks.zh: L.4 碎纸 实质性 更改最短路径任务并打破理论多跳理性模型

blocks.en: BFS-SP reduces search to a linear traversal. Recall that our theoretical model of multihop reasoning (§ 1 ) is deliberately agnostic to topology: it makes no assumption about the structure of the latent reasoning graph. The BFS-SP breaks this assumption in two ways. First, it modifies the underlying topology to a search tree, starting at s s . Second, the latent reasoning graph reduces further to a linear chain, backtracking along this tree. This backtracking is the structure of Khops-Gen ( L.2 ). Thus, the general multihop search problem of § 1 , which requires resolving a choice node at each step among potentially many candidates in ℰ \mathcal{E} , is replaced by a traversal problem on a fixed topology where the resulting backtrack is still multihop, but it no longer involves any search. One may view this as the scratchpad not solving the original problem but rather substituting it with a different, strictly simpler problem in its place, one that is no longer a planning problem at all. Thus using a BFS-SP breaks the underlying theoretical model. This is illustrated in Fig. 31 .
blocks.zh: BFS-SP将搜索减少为线性转录. 回顾我们的多跳推理(§1)的理论模型是故意不可知论的到地形学的:它不假设潜在推理图的结构. BFS-SP以两种方式打破了这一假设. 首先,它将基础的地形学修改为搜索树,从s. 第二,潜在的推理图进一步缩小到线性链,沿着这棵树回溯。 这种回溯跟踪是Khops-Gen(L.2)的结构. 因此,§1中一般的多跳搜索问题,要求在E\mathcal{E}中可能很多候选人的每一步解决一个选择节点,被固定地貌上的逆向问题所取代,由此产生的回路仍然是多跳,但不再涉及任何搜索. 人们可能认为,这种划痕并不能解决原先的问题,而是用一个不同的、严格简单的问题代替它,一个已经不再是规划问题的问题。 因此,使用BFS-SP打破了基本的理论模型. 图31说明了这一点。

blocks.en: BFS-SP is still latent multihop reasoning/traversal. 33 33 33 frydenlund-2025-language developed scratchpads that reduce path-star graphs to linear chains, and thus required multihop reasoning but not searching or planning. 34 34 34 It is theoretically possible, though completely impractical, to create a BFS-SP which requires no multihop reasoning. The key thing here is to repeat the full current branch/path at each depth as part of the tokenization and mark these with special tokens. Then once t t is found, the model just needs to skip directly back to the start of this path and output it directly. Alternatively, one can simply do two scratchpads, the BFS-SP, then a reverse SP. Even though the backtrack removes any branching choice, the total computation performed across generating the SP and then the backtrack is still equivalent to k k hops of graph reasoning. To output the correct node following s s , the model must work back from t t . However, if we now reverse the output in generation, the task requires no multihop reasoning as each step can be produced with a single hop. Thus, such a reverse ‘solution’ works because it replaces latent computation with sequential computation. Note that because backtracking is still a multihop task, this still allows the BFS-SP to act as a testbed for evaluating MTP.
blocks.zh: BFS-SP仍是潜伏的多跳推理/逆变. 33 33 33 Frydenlund-2025-语言开发的划痕板,将路径-星图降低到线性链,因此需要多跳推理但不搜索或规划. 34 34 34 34 从理论上讲,建立一个不需要多跳推理的BFS-SP是可能的,尽管完全不切实际。 这里的关键是重复每个深度的完整当前分支/路径,作为标志化的一部分,并用特殊标志标记这些. 然后一旦 t t 被找到,模型只需要直接跳过到这个路径的开始,直接输出出来. 或者,一个人可以简单地做两个刮片,即BFS-SP,然后是反式SP. 尽管后轨删除了任何分支选择,但整个生成 SP 和 然后后轨仍然相当于 k k hops 图形推理。 要在 s 之后输出正确的节点,模型必须从 t t 恢复工作 。 然而,如果我们现在逆向生成输出,任务不需要多跳推理,因为每个步骤都可以用单跳产生. 因此,这种反向的 " 解决办法 " 起作用,因为它用顺序计算取代潜在的计算。 注意,由于回溯跟踪仍然是多跳任务,这仍然允许BFS-SP作为评估MTP的测试台.

blocks.en: Neither collapse in the original topology requires a shortest path scratchpad. We could also do this by simply ordering the edge list E E by BFS distance from s s rather than shuffling it ( ge-etal-2025-graph ) . A BFS-ordered edge list directly encodes, in its position, the same predecessor structure that the SP makes explicit. This is why we must shuffle E E before tokenization (§ 1.1 ). These understandings of the task show that a correct output is not sufficient evidence of multihop reasoning; the task must also be solved for the right reason.
blocks.zh: 原始地形的崩溃都不需要最短的路径抓痕板. 我们还可以通过简单的BFS距离s的边缘列表EE来进行排序,而不是打乱它(ge-etal-2025-graph). 一个BFS订购的边缘列表直接编码,在其位置上,与SP所明示的相同的前身结构. 因此,我们必须先洗掉EE,然后才做标记(第1.1节)。 这些对任务的理解表明,正确的输出不足以证明多跳推理;任务也必须出于正确的理由解决.

blocks.en:
Not all tokenization changes break the model: STAN and + N +N do not. It would be natural to read § 3 and § 4 as proposing the same kind of intervention as the BFS-SP scratchpad, since all three change the tokenization. They do not. The
theoretical model of § 1 forbids us from making any assumption about the topology of the latent reasoning graph. We are therefore free in our choice of surface form insofar as that choice leaves the graph intact. STAN only modifies the representation of a single edge, and edges are still provided independently of one another. The node list is likewise trivially inferred from the edge list. Neither is constructed as a function of the query; any query-conditioned structure must still be learnt by the model, whereas a BFS-SP is built from s s and t t and so supplies it directly in the input. Note there are other tokenizations that break the theoretical model, such as those that use graph-global information, such as the graph Laplacian. ( bechler2026lost ) .

blocks.en: Appendix M The k k -Lookahead Issue
blocks.zh: 附录 M K k - 头部问题

blocks.en: saparov2025transformers note that, for pathfinding tasks, the characteristic difficulty measure should be the k k -lookahead – the number of steps the model must search ahead from the start node to find the goal – not the path length | π | = k + 1 |\pi|=k+1 . These are not equivalent: the model can shortcut prediction of π \pi once all competing arms are exhausted. For example, in a path-star graph with π \pi of length 8 8 and all other arms of length 5 5 , once 4 4 hops are taken, the model can determine π \pi is the only remaining viable path by elimination, without any further search.
blocks.zh: saparov2025 Transfers指出,对于路径查找任务,特征难度度量应该是 k - lookahead – 从起始节点开始,模型必须先搜索步骤数才能找到目标 – 而不是路径长度 | = k + 1 |\pi|=k+1 。 这些不是等效的:当所有相互竞争的武器耗尽后,模型可以快捷预测 \\\pi 。 例如,在一条长度为 \\pi 8 和所有其他长度为 5 5 的路径-星图中,一旦取下 4 4 hop ,模型就可以确定 \\ pi 是唯一通过消除而存活的可行路径,无需进一步搜索.

blocks.en: A related issue arises when s s is not a choice node: the true number of required hops is then smaller than k k . If u i − 1 u_{i-1} is the first choice node in π \pi , only k ′ = k − i + 1 < k k^{\prime}=k-i+1<k hops are actually required to solve the task (§ 2 ).
blocks.zh: 当 s 不是一个选择节点时会出现一个相关问题: 所需跳数的真实数然后小于 k k k 。 如果 u i − 1 u_{i-1 } 是 \\ pi 中的首选节点, 只有 k = 页:1 - ―― i + 1 < k k^{\prime}=k- i+1 < k hops 实际需要解决此任务(§2).

blocks.en: Both issues are easy to control for in saparov2025transformers ’s setup, since they consider only a restricted variant of path-star graphs: s s is a choice node by construction, and at least one non- π \pi arm can be constructed to be at least as long as π \pi . This is much harder for general graph topologies, where we cannot freely construct 𝒢 \mathcal{G} and then force the sampled path to have these properties. Consequently, a sampled path of length k + 1 k+1 may not actually require k k hops to solve. This is a further illustration of why formally defining learnability for this task is difficult in the general setting.
blocks.zh: 这两种问题在saparov2025 Transformers的设置中都很容易被控制,因为他们只考虑路径-星图的限制性变体:ss是通过构造选择的节点,至少可以构造一个非 \\\\ \\ pi 臂,至少可以长于 \\ \ \ pi 。 这对一般的图表地形来说要困难得多,我们无法自由地构建 G\ mathcal{G} , 然后强迫被采样的路径拥有这些属性 。 因此,长度为k+1k+1的抽样路径可能实际上不需要kk hops来解决. 这进一步说明了为什么在一般情况下很难正式确定这项任务的可学习性。

blocks.en: Appendix N Multiple Shortest Paths and Semantic Label Smoothing
blocks.zh: 附录N 多种最短路径和语义标签平滑

blocks.en: As mentioned above, multiple valid shortest paths can exist for a query Q = ( s , t ) Q=(s,\,t) beyond the sampled ground-truth path π \pi . During inference, this is not a problem: we validate a generated path against 𝒢 \mathcal{G} directly rather than against π \pi . 35 35 35 This requires checking against the distance matrix of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} . During training, however, it is a problem. Under NTP, each token of π \pi is treated as the sole ground truth at that step, and CE tries to match this one-hot distribution. When multiple shortest paths exist, multiple targets are simultaneously valid at a given step, so the correct ground-truth distribution should be uniform over them. In expectation, this would not matter, since the model would still converge to the correct uniform distribution. In practice, though, we sample only a small number of graphs and paths. As such, any alternative valid paths are rarely observed. CE then pushes the model to place all mass on the single sampled path even when others are equally valid, producing a loss spike whenever a well-trained model instead (correctly) spreads mass across them. This matters because, for much of training, we are in a low-loss regime where only a handful of tokens carry any signal, and these spikes are large enough to disrupt training dynamics.
blocks.zh: 如上所述,对于Q=(s, t)的QQ(s,\,t)的查询,可以存在多个有效的最短路径,超出所抽样的地面-真实路径 \\\\\ 。 在推论中,这不是一个问题:我们验证一个针对 G\ mathcal{G} 直接而不是针对 \\\ pi 生成的路径 35 35 35 35 这需要对照 G\ mathcal{ G} 的距离矩阵 。 然而,在培训期间,这是一个问题。 在NTP下,\\ pi 的每个符号都被当作该步骤的唯一基础真理,CE试图匹配这个单热分布. 当存在多个最短路径时,多个目标在特定步骤上同时有效,因此正确的地面-真实分布应该一致于它们. 预期这不重要,因为该模式仍将与正确的统一分配一致。 在实践中,我们只抽样了少量的图表和路径. 因此,很少看到其他有效的路径。 CE随后推推模型将所有质量置于单一的采样路径上,即使其他的同样有效,只要训练有素的模型(正确)在它们之间分散质量,就会产生损失悬赏. 这一点很重要,因为对于大部分培训来说,我们处于一种低损失的制度,只有少数信使携带任何信号,而这些信使的规模足以扰乱培训动态。

blocks.en: Fortunately, the fix is simple. 36 36 36 This requires precomputing each graph’s distance matrix to construct the correct ground truths, so we need the distance matrix at both training and inference time. We treat NTP as a multi-label task (in the semantic dimension; see D.6 ): at each split point where multiple valid paths diverge, every node beginning a valid continuation is treated as a valid target, and we train with multi-label CE. See Fig. 32 for an example.
blocks.zh: 幸运的是,这个定点很简单。 36 36 36 这需要预先计算每个图的距离矩阵来构建正确的地面真理,因此我们需要在训练和推论时的距离矩阵。 我们把NTP视为一个多标签的任务(在语义维度中;见D.6):在多个有效路径相差的每一个分点,每一个开始一个有效延续的节点都被当作一个有效目标,我们用多标签CE来训练. 例见图32.

blocks.en: Then, because we use teacher-forcing, which conditions the sequence on the ground-truth path ( williams1989learning ) , this will resolve multiple valid paths at each step without requiring a structured sequential distribution. This means we do not need to model the joint distribution directly and can still factorize the joint distribution across time steps as in standard language modelling.
blocks.zh: 然后,由于我们使用教师强制方法,这为地面真相路径上的顺序(williams1989 Learning )提供了条件,这将解决每个步骤的多个有效路径,而不需要结构化的顺序分布。 这意味着我们不需要直接模拟联合分布,仍然可以像标准语言建模那样将联合分布在时间跨步中的因素化.

We do not apply this correction to the MTP loss.
Extending our rank-based MTP to multiple valid paths would require modelling ties correctly ( Frydenlund_Singh_Rudzicz_2022 ) .
While possible, it requires engineering overhead and, more importantly, we found this unnecessary in practice, given MTP’s improved training dynamics compared to NTP.
The choice node analysis of § 2 explains why the correction matters more for NTP.
A step with more than one valid continuation has more than one continuation, and is therefore a choice node.
The converse does not hold, as most choice nodes have a unique valid target, but it follows that conflicted targets can only land on the c ⁡ ( π ) c(\pi) positions that carry signal under NTP, and never on positions absorbed by the CHC.
MTP has k ⁡ ( k + 1 ) / 2 − 1 k(k+1)/2-1 terms, and these are not restricted to choice nodes, since a skip of j − i > 0 j-i>0 requires multihop reasoning at non-choice nodes as well.
The same conflicted target is therefore a smaller fraction of the MTP loss and the spike is diluted.
Note that this correction improves NTP and is therefore applied in favour of the baseline, so it cannot account for the gains we attribute to MTP.
Evaluation is unaffected, as generated paths are validated against 𝒢 \mathcal{G} for both losses.

blocks.en: As an aside, semantic label smoothing is related to MTP when considering MTP as a structured prediction task ( Frydenlund_Singh_Rudzicz_2022 ; iyer-etal-2026-beyond ; zhang2026concept ) . The key difference here is that, in the former, the multiple target tokens are across the semantic dimension, while, in the latter, they are across the temporal or sequential dimensions. However, in terms of implementation, the only change can be how the multiple targets are derived. For example, the former created a self-supervised N-gram rule to derive multiple targets of semantically related words per time step. Whereas in this work, we simply use the generalization of the self-supervision rule used in NTP to derive the multiple targets for MTP. However, both that work and this one use the same Plackett-Luce ranking loss to learn the underlying structured multi-label prediction problem. zhang2026nitp frames semantic prediction as a latent next-token prediction, where they hypothesize that future hidden-states can act as continuous supervision for the current state. This can also be seen as a temporal form of self-distillation, in which the new loss encodes planning for future predictions, thereby relating it to MTP.
blocks.zh: 另外,语义标签平滑在考虑MTP作为结构化预测任务时与MTP有关(Frydenlund_Singh_Rudzicz_2022;iyer-etal-2026-beyond ;zhang2026cept.). 这里的关键区别在于,在前者中,多个目标符号跨越语义维度,而在后者中,它们跨越时间或顺序维度. 然而,在执行方面,唯一的变化是多重目标是如何产生的。 例如,前者创建了一个自我监督的N-gram规则,以从每个时步中得出数个与闪烁相关的单词的目标. 而在这项工作中,我们只是使用NTP中使用的自我监督规则的概括来得出MTP的多重目标. 然而,那份作品和这份作品都使用相同的Plackett-Luce排名损失来了解基础结构化的多标签预测问题. zhang2026nitp帧语义预测作为一种潜伏的下位预测,其中他们假设未来的隐藏状态可以起到持续监督当前状态的作用. 这也可以看作是一种暂时的自我消化形式,其中新的损失编码了对未来预测的规划,从而将其与中期计划联系起来。

blocks.en: Appendix O Notes on Source-Side – Full-Sequence – Training with NTP
blocks.zh: 附录O 关于源代码的说明 – 完整序列– 与 NTP 培训

blocks.en: Recently, both noroozizadeh2025deep and trainin2026discrete have shown positive results when allowing the model to predict the entire input, including the source-side prefix, instead of restricting NTP to the target side. This means the model must predict that u u follows v v to form edge ( u , v ) (u,\,v) , for all edges in the randomly shuffled edge list.
blocks.zh: 最近,noroozizadeh2025deep和train2026discrete在允许模型预测包括源边前缀在内的全部输入时都显示出积极的效果,而不是将NTP限制在目标侧. 这意味着模型必须预测u u 跟随 v 形成边缘 (u, v) (u,\,v),用于随机洗涤边缘列表中的所有边缘.

blocks.en: noroozizadeh2025deep considered the in-weights setting, where all training examples come from the same graph. Here, having the loss cover the entire input makes sense, since the model can and must learn the (single) graph’s structure to complete the task. However, trainin2026discrete , like us, instead considered the in-context setting with path-star graphs, where every sample is a unique, unseen graph. This means the model cannot memorize information about any specific graph, as doing so would induce spurious correlations. They hypothesize that full-sequence training helps because the model learns the underlying generative process for creating graphs: “the model is additionally rewarded for learning to generate legal graph descriptions,” and that “forcing the model to explicitly model the graph structure rather than merely attending to it is crucial for acquiring the necessary look-ahead mechanisms.”
blocks.zh: noroozizadeh2025deep考虑了体重不足的情况,所有培训实例都来自同一图表。 在这里,将损失覆盖整个输入是有道理的,因为模型能够而且必须学习(单一)图的结构来完成这项任务。 然而,Trainin 2026discrete, 和我们一样, 考虑的是内文设置 路径星图, 其中每个样本 是一个独特的,看不见的图。 这意味着模型无法记住任何特定图表的信息,因为这样做会诱发虚假的关联. 他们假设,全面序列培训有帮助,因为模型学习了生成图表的基本遗传过程:“该模型因学习生成法律图表描述而得到额外奖励”,“强迫模型明确模拟图表结构,而不是仅仅关注它对于获得必要的前瞻机制至关重要。 “

blocks.en: We believe their hypothesis is correct, but argue the critical aspect is specifically that the graph must be ‘legal.’ If the generative process were entirely random, as in Erdős–Rényi graphs, edge generation would be uninformative, and there should be no benefit from source-side training. However, the specific topology of path-star graphs imposes constraints on the generative process, and learning to respect them, we hypothesize, forces the model to engage in auxiliary forms of MMHT.
blocks.zh: 我们认为他们的假设是正确的,但认为关键方面是具体的,即图表必须是`合法的'。 如果基因过程是完全随机的,如Erdás-Rényi图中那样,边缘生成将是无成形的,不应该从源头培训中受益。 然而,路径-星图的具体地形对基因过程造成了制约,我们假设,学会尊重它们,迫使模型参与MMHT的辅助形式.

blocks.en: Concretely, consider the original path-star task, where the number of arms d d and arm length k k (excluding the start node s s ) are fixed across graphs, so | 𝒩 | = d ​ k + 1 |\mathcal{N}|=dk+1 . This yields three legality constraints: s s must have degree d d ; every node has degree 2 if arm-interior or degree 1 if arm-final; and each arm must contain exactly k k unique nodes.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,考虑原路径星任务,即双臂d和臂长kk(不包括起始节点s s)的数量固定在横跨图上,所以QQQ=dk+1+ Mathcal{N}|=dk+1. 这产生三个合法性限制:s必须具有d d 度;如果臂前有2级,则每个节点有2级;如果臂后有1级,则每个节点必须包含准确的k k 唯一节点。

blocks.en: These degree and count constraints restrict which nodes can be selected from the vocabulary at each generation step, and satisfying them can require multihop reasoning. For instance, with | 𝒩 | = 51 |\mathcal{N}|=51 and | 𝒱 | = 100 |\mathcal{V}|=100 , learning to respect the total node budget only requires counting prior nodes in the edge list, not traversing the graph. But learning to count how many nodes have been used within a given arm does require multihop traversal. A further example which requires multihop reasoning is suppose an arm is missing exactly one edge ( u , v ) (u,\,v) , with ( ⋅ , u ) (\cdot,\,u) and ( v , ⋅ ) (v,\,\cdot) already observed elsewhere in the list: the model can use counting to detect that an edge is missing, and multihop traversal to identify that it must be ( u , v ) (u,\,v) specifically. The number of hops required depends on where this edge falls in the arm.
blocks.zh: 这些学位和计数限制限制了在每一代步骤中可从词汇中选择的节点,满足这些节点可能需要多跳推理. 例如,用QQ N = 51 |\ mathcal{ N}|=51 和 V| = 100 |\ mathcal{ V}|=100 ,学习尊重总节点预算只需要在边缘列表中计算之前的节点,而不是翻转图表. 但学习计算一个特定臂内使用过多少节点,确实需要多跳转. 需要多跳推理的另一个例子是假设一个臂完全缺失一个边缘(u, v) (u,\, v),与( , u,) (\cdot,\, u)和(v, ) (v,\,\,\ cdot)在列表中其他部分已经观察到:模型可以使用计数来检测一个边缘缺失,而多跳转来识别它必须是(u, v) (u,\,v)具体. 需要的跳动次数取决于这个边缘在手臂上落下的位置.

blocks.en: Such constraints therefore create cases which provide a learning signal that may induce MMHT. If true, this offers further evidence that any source of MMHT signal can make the path-star task learnable, at least at limited scale ( frydenlund-2025-language ) . We expect this particular signal to be minimal and not to scale ( trainin2026discrete ) , but we see it as an interesting direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 因此,这种限制产生一些案例,提供学习信号,可能诱发MMHT。 如果是真的,这提供了进一步的证据,证明任何MMHT信号的来源都能够使路径-星任务可以学习,至少是有限的尺度(flordenlund-2025-language ). 我们期望这个特定的信号是最小的,而不是规模化的(trainin2026discrete),但我们认为这是未来工作的有趣方向.
